fdroid:app.keyholm.name: Keyholm
fdroid:app.keyholm.description:
Keyholm is all about single-device passkeys (i.e. client-side discoverable credentials) whose private key is protected by secure hardware.
 You can never export or sync these passkeys. Think of Keyholm as a way to activate the built-in security key on your phone.
 target devices: phones with secure hardware (including Pixels)
 no INTERNET permission
 no Google Play Services ever
 takes advantage of latest Android version/APIs
 allows extensive control over particulars of what credentials it creates and how
 supports ES256: it's the only EC, StrongBox-backed algorithm
 supports Ed25519: it's not NIST, it's fast and safe but TEE-only
 supports ML-DSA: post-quantum! but Android 17 and TEE-only
 supports android-key attestation
 supports PRF extension
 uses QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES in order to display icons for apps that were denied passkey usage
 account list export/import for making it marginally easier to switch devices. All keys still need to be manually recreated on the new device!

fdroid:com.derpbiscuit.boop.name: Boop
fdroid:com.derpbiscuit.boop.summary: Pop a nearby person’s bubble. A tiny Boop over Bluetooth, with no Internet
fdroid:com.derpbiscuit.boop.description:
See a nearby person. Pop their bubble. They get Booped.
Boop is a small, local-only native Android app. Translucent animated soap bubbles drift in a calm little field. Decorative bubbles pop only on your own phone; named bubbles represent real nearby people who opted in. Tap a person’s bubble to send a direct Bluetooth Low Energy Boop. Their phone posts a small notification, and they can reply with one of five emoji before meeting in person.
• Procedural iridescent bubbles: grab, fling or stir empty space, with film-petal pops and quiet synthesized contacts.
• A name and accent color, without profiles, accounts or a friend list.
• Basic foreground discovery; optional Background Boops and Floating Boops are off by default.
• Contextual Bluetooth/notification permissions; overlays require a separate explicit choice.
• No Internet permission, trackers, analytics, ads, cloud, Google Play Services or proprietary backend.
• Open documented Boop BLE Protocol v1; no pairing or bonding.
• System/light/dark themes, accessible named bubbles and continuous motion independent of Android UI animation settings.
Android 12+ and BLE advertising support required. Background discovery requires Android’s persistent service notification and can be interrupted by battery restrictions or force-stop. Floating bubbles never read another app or appear on the lock screen. Nearby names and identifiers are public radio information; messages are not encrypted or authenticated. This is a playful social Boop, not secure messaging.

fdroid:com.keepnc.name: KeepNotes for Nextcloud
fdroid:com.keepnc.summary: Google Keep-inspired client for Nextcloud Notes
fdroid:com.keepnc.description:
KeepNotes for Nextcloud is a modern Android client for Nextcloud Notes featuring a Google Keep-inspired user interface (staggered card grid, Material 3 dynamic theming, interactive checklists, categories, offline-first bidirectional sync).
Features:
• Google Keep-inspired UI: Staggered grid card layout with Material 3 dynamic theming (Light & Dark modes).
• Seamless Authentication: Nextcloud Login Flow v2 support (one-click browser login without manual app passwords).
• Robust Offline-First Architecture: Local Room database acts as the single source of truth. Instant local operations without waiting for network responses.
• Bidirectional Synchronization: Fast server synchronization using etag and timestamps, with visual progress indication.
• Rich Markdown & Interactive Checklists: Clickable checkboxes with strikethrough, smart Enter key auto-completion, and quick text-to-checklist conversion.
• Biometric App Lock: Secure your notes with fingerprint, face recognition, or device PIN / pattern.
• Customizable Font Sizes: Independent font size presets for cards and editor (Small, Medium, Large, Extra Large).
• In-App Language Selection: Easily switch between English and Russian directly inside the app.
• Organization & Navigation: Navigation Drawer with categories and note counts, Category Picker, Starred / Favorites filter, and fast search.
• 100% Free & Open Source: No proprietary tracking, no analytics, no ads, no Google Play Services dependencies.
Disclaimer:
KeepNotes is an independent application and is not affiliated with, sponsored, or endorsed by Nextcloud GmbH. Nextcloud is a registered trademark of Nextcloud GmbH.

fdroid:com.tasomaniac.openwith.floss.name: Open Link With...
fdroid:com.tasomaniac.openwith.floss.summary: Open links in native apps when you're stuck in the browser! 🚀
fdroid:com.tasomaniac.openwith.floss.description:
Share the current web page when you are in a browser to open with another app!
Did it ever happen to you? You click a link (let's say a video link) and the system does not ask you anything and opens the link in the browser. And you are stuck in a web page instead of watching the video in the native app.
There are 2 options for you. You either watch the video in the web or you remember the name of the video and search it in the app. Well, not anymore.
With OpenLinkWith, you can share any webpage with it and it will ask you which applications to open the link with.
Although the original intent of the application is to direct web pages to apps, it can even be used to switch between apps. Imagine you have 2 Twitter clients in your phone. You can open a tweet in the official Twitter application and then switch to an another app with the same tweet opened. Cool, hah?
Although the problem discovered above is not huge, it is missing in the Android ecosystem. And I couldn't find anything doing this. So I wrote one. :)
If you find yourself sharing the same url over and over, you can use "Add to Home Screen" feature to add your favorite link from your favorite app to your home screen.
I hope you find this useful. Please help me by trying it and sending feedback to me.
 Note:</strong This app also fixes links for some of the most popular Android applications. Not all but most of the links from these websites will be open with respective native android apps when you share them with Open Link With.
The app uses internet to: 
- Send crash reports
- Resolve redirects of shortened links
- Find the title of the link while using "Add to Home Screen"
The application is open source and the source can be found here:
https://github.com/tasomaniac/OpenLinkWith/
Icon is from:
https://www.iconfinder.com/icons/216215/flow_switch_icon#size=512

fdroid:com.unicornsonlsd.finamp.name: Finamp
fdroid:com.unicornsonlsd.finamp.summary: An open source music player made for Jellyfin
fdroid:com.unicornsonlsd.finamp.description:
Finamp is a free Jellyfin music player for Android, iOS and Desktop. It allows you to stream and download the music you own. It has a modern but thought-through design, a ton of features, is customizable, and respects your privacy !
You need access to a Jellyfin server (https://jellyfin.org) or you won't be able to use Finamp at all !
Finamp comes with a bunch of features, including these:
- Gapless playback
- Shallow library browsing, to quickly get into your music
- Volume normalization (aka "ReplayGain") for tracks and albums
- Lyrics, time-synced lyrics, and even word-by-word cue highlighting
- Flexible transcoding options
 - Choose between AAC, OPUS, Vorbis, and FLAC codecs
 - Supports downmixing & lossless transcoding to FLAC, for maximum compatibility
- Dedicated offline mode with automatic connectivity detection
- A powerful download system that does it all
 - Download individual tracks, albums, entire artists & genres, or your whole library
 - Download all your favorites in one go
 - Download the newest additions to your library
 - Transcode all downloads to take up less space on your device
 - Customizable download locations
 - And keeps all of these downloads up-to-date automatically as things change on the server
- Advanced playback options:
 - Choose between shuffling or playing in order
 - Choose if you want to play now, add to "Next Up", or after everything else
- Android Auto & Apple CarPlay support
- Desktop & Tablet Support with a split-screen layout
- A Customizable Home Tab
- List views & grid views with adjustable density
- Adaptive app color theme based on your system colors
 - (i.e. "Material You" & equivalents for other platforms)
- Easily switch to a previous queue from hours or days ago
- A radio feature that always keeps the music playing with something related
 - And you get to choose between 5 different modes to cater to your listening habits
- AudioMuse integration (https://github.com/NeptuneHub/AudioMuse-AI) for an enhanced radio mode powered by sonic analysis
 - You'll have to set up AudioMuse and install the AudioMuse Jellyfin plugin to use this in Finamp
- Solid customization options, including tabs that can be hidden and reordered
- Support for several languages
- Jellyfin 12+ compatibility
 - But should also work on older versions down to 10.8.x!
- and a lot more!
Have a feature request or want to report a bug? Head over to our GitHub and open an issue there: 
https://github.com/finamp-app/finamp/issues
Finamp is a third-party client for Jellyfin, we have no official ties to the Jellyfin project, but want to see the Jellyfin community thrive. 
Install Finamp today to enjoy your music, on your terms.
Thank you for using Finamp!

fdroid:cz.mod42.diktafon.name: Diktafon: Voice Memos on Tape
fdroid:cz.mod42.diktafon.summary: Voice memos on cassette tapes — transcribed & summarised offline, on device.
fdroid:cz.mod42.diktafon.description:
Diktafon is a voice recorder built around one idea: capturing a thought and finding it again later should feel effortless.
Your memos live on cassettes — one tape per topic, like "shopping", "kitchen renovation" or "book ideas". Each cassette plays as one continuous tape of your recordings, in order, just like the real thing.
 SIMPLE TO USE 
Controls you already know, inspired by real tape recorders. Open a cassette, press record, talk — no naming, no forms, no network needed. Rewind to find it again.
 MODERN 
Automatic transcriptions and summaries: every memo is transcribed, every cassette summarised and titled. Tap any word in a transcript and the tape jumps right there.
 COMPLETELY PRIVATE 
Everything is computed on your device. No accounts, no cloud, no ads, no analytics — your voice never leaves your phone. The only network use is a one-time download of the on-device models (Wi-Fi recommended; about 2 GB for the default models, up to 3 GB for the largest — or just 0.2 GB if you skip summaries).
 SPEAKS YOUR LANGUAGE 
Twenty languages: Arabic, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Czech, English, French, German, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Persian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, Ukrainian and Vietnamese — in recordings, summaries and the app itself. The spoken language is detected for each memo, so one tape can freely mix languages.
 FREE & OPEN SOURCE 
No cost, no ads, no lock-in. MIT-licensed — read the code, build it yourself, make it yours: https://github.com/jaromiru/diktafon
 AND THE LITTLE THINGS 
• Gapless playback with a colour-coded tape bar and an optional soft chime between memos.
• Export any cassette — or all of them — as a single archive with the audio and readable text inside; import only adds, never overwrites.
• Light & dark themes, cassette colours, per-memo copy and delete.
A note on quality: transcription and summaries come from small models running entirely on your phone. Their quality is being actively worked on and will improve in future updates.
Diktafon works best on 64-bit phones with 4 GB of RAM or more.

fdroid:io.bloco.snowflake.name: Snowflake Volunteer
fdroid:io.bloco.snowflake.summary: Help people in censored countries access the Internet without restrictions
fdroid:io.bloco.snowflake.description:
Help people in censored countries access the Internet without restrictions.
What is Snowflake?
Snowflake allows people to connect to the Tor network in places where Tor is blocked by routing your connection through volunteer proxies located in uncensored countries.
Similar to VPNs, which help users bypass Internet censorship, Snowflake disguises your Internet activity as though they’re making a video or voice call, making you less detectable to Internet censors.
How does Snowflake work?
Snowflake uses a technology called WebRTC, which is commonly employed by videoconferencing software. This helps mask your use of Tor from censors by making it appear as though you’re on an audio or video call instead.
Learn more at https://snowflake.torproject.org
Is this safe for me?
There is no need to worry about which websites people are accessing through your Snowflake app. Their visible browsing IP address will match their Tor exit node, not yours (since you’re an entrypoint).
Can I circumvent censorship using this app?
No. If you want to circumvent censorship, you need to download a Tor-powered app such as Tor Browser or Orbot and select Snowflake on the app’s settings.

fdroid:io.github.halilkhrmn.dpimech.name: DPIMech
fdroid:io.github.halilkhrmn.dpimech.summary: Open sites your provider blocks with DPI – only for the apps you choose, no root
fdroid:io.github.halilkhrmn.dpimech.description:
Some internet providers block sites and apps (Discord, Roblox, YouTube…) with DPI (deep packet inspection). DPIMech gets around it on your phone with ByeDPI , which changes how the first packets of a connection look so the provider's filter does not recognise them.
 Not a VPN service. Android's VPN feature is only used to catch traffic on the phone. Every connection still goes straight to the site: nothing passes through anyone else's server, your IP address is not hidden, and sites blocked by IP address stay blocked.
 Features:
 Setup wizard: pick the sites, DPIMech tests your connection and turns on the setting that works.
 Whole phone or only the apps you pick. Strategies are tested with your sites, then work for all of the apps' connections. In whole-phone mode every app's DNS goes to the DNS server chosen in Settings.
 Strategy Lab: tests strategies against real sites with confirmation rounds and shows which one works on your provider.
 Automatic strategy: on a new network it finds and remembers what works there.
 Encrypted DNS (DNS over HTTPS) for the bypassed apps, and an optional QUIC block so browsers and YouTube use TCP.
 Home screen with live traffic, average ping of your sites and DNS counts; the notification shows the same.
 Widgets (one per profile if you like), launcher shortcuts that turn a profile on and open its app, Quick Settings tile.
 Strategies shared with the desktop app (Windows, Linux, macOS), updated without a new release, plus a community list.
 DNS blocking check, watchdog that restarts the engine, logs and problem report.
 No root, no Google services, no ads, no analytics. English, Türkçe, Русский, فارسی, العربية.
 Network use: to know which provider a network belongs to (for the per-network strategy), DPIMech asks ipwho.is , which sees your IP address. This happens on each new network only with the automatic strategy, otherwise only when you run a test, and can be turned off in Settings. Strategy and site lists come from GitHub; encrypted DNS goes to the DNS server you choose.
 Android allows one VPN at a time, so another VPN or a VPN-based ad blocker cannot run together with DPIMech.

fdroid:net.gmartin.paperlessngx_uploader.name: Paperless NGX Uploader
fdroid:net.gmartin.paperlessngx_uploader.summary: Upload documents to a Paperless-NGX server using the native share intent
fdroid:net.gmartin.paperlessngx_uploader.description:

fdroid:org.nitri.opentopo.summary: Online client for maps from OTM project, import GPX and show own location
fdroid:org.nitri.opentopo.description:
OpenTopoMap Viewer is an open-source Android app for exploring topographic maps, viewing tracks and planning routes. Use it for hiking, cycling and discovering places, with detailed terrain maps and your own waypoints.
MAPS AND LOCATION
• Choose from OpenTopoMap, OpenTopoMap-R, Top-O-Map, OpenStreetMap, OpenHikingMap and Freemap.sk.
• Add Waymarked Trails overlays for hiking and cycling routes.
• Follow your location, return to it quickly and rotate the map using the compass or GPS bearing.
• View coordinates and elevation information.
TRACKS AND WAYPOINTS
• Open GPX files to display tracks, routes and waypoints.
• Inspect track distance, elevation profiles, descriptions and waypoint details.
• Choose track colors and zoom to imported content.
• Enable KML/KMZ import to display additional map content.
MARKERS AND NEARBY PLACES
• Long-press the map to save a marker, then move, edit or delete it.
• Add names, descriptions, colors and optional labels.
• Import and export markers as GPX waypoints.
• Browse nearby Wikipedia places and show selected results on the map.
OPTIONAL ROUTE PLANNING AND PLACE SEARCH
Configure your own OpenRouteService (ORS) API key to search for places and calculate routes between markers. Choose profiles for driving, cycling, walking, hiking or wheelchair routing. Adjust waypoints on the map and inspect the resulting route and elevation data.
OFFLINE MAP TILES
Previously cached tiles can be viewed without an internet connection. You can also import a prepared OpenTopoMap tile ZIP into the cache and configure its location and size. Offline coverage depends on the tiles available on your device; uncached areas and zoom levels require an internet connection.
MAKE IT YOUR OWN
Keep the screen on while viewing the map and adjust map display settings. The interface is available in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian and Dutch.
Online map loading, Wikipedia lookups and ORS services require an internet connection. ORS routing, place search and optional elevation lookup require an API key and are subject to the service's usage limits.
OpenTopoMap Viewer is licensed under Apache 2.0. The F-Droid edition contains no ads.

fdroid:org.openhab.habdroid.beta.name: openHAB Beta

fdroid:org.openhab.habdroid.beta.description:
openHAB - "empowering the smart home" - vendor and technology agnostic open source home automation

openHAB is a Java-based open-source home automation platform that integrates and combines a vast range of different smart home systems and technologies into one single solution.

 Supported Products 
Over 200 specific add-ons provide support for brands, devices, technologies and communication protocols. Examples are Z-Wave, Philips Hue, Amazon Echo, Chromecast and Sonos. Discover all available add-ons and supported devices and/or functions at: https://www.openhab.org/addons/

 Open Source Community 
The openHAB open source initiative strongly supports its vibrant community. The forum with over 13,000 registered users is a place to find guidance, help and inspiration. Join the openHAB community forum over at https://community.openhab.org.
When you find an issue please report it in the forum or at https://github.com/openhab/openhab-android/issues.
If you want to translate the app into your language join us at https://crowdin.com/project/openhab-android.

The openHAB Foundation e.V. is a nonprofit organization with the mission to educate the public about the possibilities and benefits of free and open smart home solutions. Learn about the mission and the services of the foundation under https://www.openhabfoundation.org.

Privacy policy: https://www.openhabfoundation.org/privacy.html#android-app

fdroid:studio.coldstream.waste_works.summary: A casual recycling clicker: take trash apart, find valuables, equip your worker
fdroid:studio.coldstream.waste_works.description:
A casual resource clicker for the hoarder in you, or for your inner waste management system. Get some discarded products and recycle them by disassembling each item. Find out what is valuable, rare or not. Pocket any items worth saving, and equip special items to discover their properties and hidden bonuses to your attributes. At the end of the day, what matters is a sense of purpose, and perhaps a sweet cup of coffee together with fellow colleagues.
Waste Works is free, temperate regarding gamification, and contains no ads, and we want to keep it that way. No in-app purchases, no tracking, no network access.
 Features 
 A conveyor belt that keeps bringing trash bags, artefacts (fridges, scooters, old gadgets) and organic waste
 Disassemble items into their parts, and collect coins, rings and other valuables
 Six recycling bins (paper, resin, glass, chemicals, fiber and clay) to fill and level up
 Equip your worker with hats, gloves, boots, tools and more; each item has its own attributes, rarity and hidden bonuses
 Upgrades: bigger work grids, faster conveyors, recycling certificates and robotic sorter arms that work for you
 Outfit Saves: your outfit and backpack survive a reset
 Music and sound effects, and a recycling manual for new workers
 How to play 
Drag unwanted waste back to an empty slot on the belt to get rid of it. Tap trash bags and artefacts on the board to disassemble them, and tap valuables to collect them. Drag resources to their matching bins. Keep the board and the belt from filling up: when there is no room left, parts fall off and cost you money.
Waste Works is in early development, so expect updates, and maybe a bug or two.
Icons: game-icons.net (CC BY 3.0). Music: Eric Matyas, soundimage.org. See CREDITS.md in the source repository.

apple-macos:6809288474.name: Syncer — Clipboard on Keyboard
apple-macos:6809288474.description:
Your clipboard, right inside your keyboard.
Copy something on your Mac or any other computer — then paste it straight from the Syncer keyboard on your iPhone. No app-switching. No emailing links to yourself. Your clipboard simply follows you to every device.
WHY SYNCER
• Paste from your keyboard — the Syncer keyboard puts your synced clipboard inside any text field on your phone. Tap to insert; no jumping between apps.
• One clipboard, every device — your iPhone, iPad, Mac and the other computers you use all share a single clipboard.
• Encrypted end-to-end — every clip is sealed on your device before it leaves, and only your devices hold the keys. Our servers relay data they have no key to open.
• Searchable history — find anything you've copied. Keep it from 1 to 30 days (7 by default); it auto-expires after that.
• Passwords stay put — Syncer automatically skips items your device marks as sensitive, so passwords and secrets don't sync.
• Encrypted backups — protect your history with a PIN and restore it on a new device. We only ever hold ciphertext.
• Passwordless sign-in — a one-time email code, or Google / Apple. No password to remember.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Install Syncer on your devices.
2. Pair them in seconds by scanning a QR code.
3. Copy on one device, paste on any other — from the keyboard on your phone.
MADE FOR PEOPLE WHO COPY A LOT
Developers moving code and commands between a laptop and phone. Writers and students moving links, quotes, and notes. Anyone tired of shuttling text between devices by hand.
YOUR PRIVACY
We can't read your clipboard — the encryption makes it impossible. We don't sell data, show ads, or build a profile of what you copy. Analytics are strictly opt-in.
Syncer — one clipboard, every device.

fedora-packages:ghc-mwc-random/ghc-mwc-r.description: A library for generating high quality random numbers that follow either a uniform or normal distribution. The generated numbers are suitable for use in statistical applications. The uniform PRNG uses Marsaglia's MWC256 (also known as MWC8222) multiply-with-carry generator, which has a period of 2^8222 and fares well in tests of randomness. It is also extremely fast, between 2 and 3 times faster than the Mersenne Twister. fedora-packages:ghc-safe/ghc-safe.name: ghc-safe
fedora-packages:ghc-safe/ghc-safe.description: A library wrapping 'Prelude'/'Data.List' functions that can throw exceptions, such as 'head' and '!!'. Each unsafe function has up to four variants, e.g. with 'tail': * 'tail :: [a] -> [a]', raises an error on 'tail []'. * 'tailMay :: [a] -> /Maybe/ [a]', turns errors into 'Nothing'. * 'tailDef :: /[a]/ -> [a] -> [a]', takes a default to return on errors. * 'tailNote :: /String/ -> [a] -> [a]', takes an extra argument which supplements the error message. * 'tailSafe :: [a] -> [a]', returns some sensible default if possible, '[]' in the case of 'tail'. This package is divided into three modules: * "Safe" contains safe variants of 'Prelude' and 'Data.List' functions. * "Safe.Foldable" contains safe variants of 'Foldable' functions. * "Safe.Exact" creates crashing versions of functions like 'zip' (errors if the lists are not equal) and 'take' (errors if there are not enough elements), then wraps them to provide safe variants.

fedora-packages:gloo/gloo-openmpi.name: gloo-openmpi
fedora-packages:gloo/gloo-openmpi.description: Gloo is a collective communications library. It comes with a number of collective algorithms useful for machine learning applications. These include a barrier, broadcast, and allreduce. Transport of data between participating machines is abstracted so that IP can be used at all times, or InifiniBand (or RoCE) when available. In the latter case, if the InfiniBand transport is used, GPUDirect can be used to accelerate cross machine GPU-to-GPU memory transfers. Where applicable, algorithms have an implementation that works with system memory buffers, and one that works with NVIDIA GPU memory buffers. In the latter case, it is not necessary to copy memory between host and device; this is taken care of by the algorithm implementations. This package can use openmpi as a backend.

Hotstar Ad Blocker is a user-friendly extension that strictly removes all ads on Hotstar providing you with a seamless streaming experience.
Overview
Hotstar Ad Blocker removes all types of ads on Hotstar. This is a free tool that enhances your Hotstar streaming experience by blocking all the advertisements. Hotstar Ad Blocker is the most efficient and fast way to remove and skip the ads from Hotstar.
Features: -
Here are the unique features of the Hotstar Ad Blocker extension:-
- This is a lightweight extension that does not impact your device’s speed.
- You will be able to watch Hotstar without any commercials.
- The extension works automatically right after you install it and blocks all ads without any exceptions.

Rule AdBlocker is a lite addon that let you easily block ads, and all unwanted contents with regular expression matching.

firefox-addons:2748959.summary: WorthEPenny automatically finds the best coupons and Cash Back when you shop online.
firefox-addons:2748959.description:
Tired of searching for coupon codes before checkout? Let WorthEPenny do the work for you! Our extension automatically applies the best coupon codes at checkout and unlocks Cash Back on thousands of stores—so you save money without the hassle.
🏷️ Automatic Coupons at Checkout

By installing and using the WorthEPenny browser extension, you agree to WorthEPenny’s Terms of Use ( https://www.worthepenny.com/pages/terms-of-use.html ) and Privacy Policy ( https://www.worthepenny.com/pages/privacy-policy.html ).

firefox-addons:2988900.name: OpenMediaTools
firefox-addons:2988900.summary: Send images and screenshots to OpenMediaTools and open them instantly in the right browser-based media tool.
firefox-addons:2988900.description:
OpenMediaTools for Firefox lets you send user-selected images and screenshots straight to OpenMediaTools.
Features:
- Right-click images and open them directly in OpenMediaTools
- Send screenshots of the visible page
- Select a custom page area and send only that part
- Open image tools such as compression, upscaling, background removal, watermark removal, and format conversion
- Choose the extension language independently from the browser UI
The add-on does not inject ads, does not modify your homepage, search engine, or new tab page, and does not collect analytics.
Data handling:
Only content the user explicitly selects, such as a right-clicked image or a user-triggered screenshot, is transferred to openmedia.tools to prefill the chosen tool page. The extension stores only the selected interface language locally in browser storage.

firefox-addons:439596.name: Pin Unpin Tab
firefox-addons:439596.summary:
Pin Unpin Tab can pin or unpin a tab by:
- a long left mouse click anywhere on the webpage (an arguably more efficient alternative to the no longer possible double-click on tab)
- a keyboard shortcut
- a click on the pin icon on browser toolbar
firefox-addons:439596.description:
Note that double-click on a tab (active or not) to pin/unpin is not going to be possible due to the limitations of the WebExtensions technology. Only Mozilla can fix it, not me. Look here and here for more details. Instead, use the (arguably) more efficient alternative - a long left click anywhere on the webpage, which is also customizable in the add-on preferences. 
Pin Unpin Tab is a Firefox WebExtension to pin or unpin a tab by
- a long left mouse click anywhere on the webpage (an arguably more efficient alternative to the no longer possible double-click on tab). This option can be enabled or disabled on the add-on's preferences page. The minimum duration to hold down the click also can be set. This approach will not work on AMO webpages and the Firefox pages (eg., about:addons). 
- a keyboard shortcut Alt-P (Ctrl-Shift-P on macOS), which Firefox allows to customize. See the guide at: https://github.com/jyshb/pin-unpin-tab/issues/17 
- a click on the pin icon on browser toolbar. The icon gels well with the default light and dark themes
 Credits 
Icons made by Smashicons from www.flaticon.com is licensed by CC 3.0 BY

Enhancer for YouTube™ is the ultimate tool to supercharge your YouTube experience with a host of highly customizable features, making it smoother and more enjoyable. Whether you’re looking to fine-tune playback settings or customize the look and feel, this YouTube enhancer gives you complete control to tailor YouTube to your needs.
Key Features:
Video Playback:
• Quickly adjust playback speed, quality, volume, and more with the mouse wheel or keyboard shortcuts.
• Playback Speed: Set a default playback speed and adjust it anywhere from 0.07x to 16x while watching.
• Playback Quality: Set a default playback quality for videos, playlists, and embedded videos.
• Volume Booster: Boost volume and bass for louder, clearer sound (up to 10x audio boost).
• Enhanced Loop Mode: Repeat specific parts or the entire video effortlessly.

Appearance and Themes:

• Cinema Mode: Dim everything around the player to keep your focus on the video.
Video Player:

• Mini Player: Keep watching while reading comments so you never miss a moment.

Other Features:

And more!
Get the most popular YouTube enhancer now and transform the way you watch YouTube forever!

Study language by actually using it in a conversation. Chat, learn new words, study grammar and play language games.
PRACTICE CONVERS
bluejetty:00015211:ios.description:

Study language by actually using it in a conversation. Chat, learn new words, study grammar and play language games.
PRACTICE CONVERSATION IN ENGLISH
- Practice casual day-to-day interactions: greeting, chatting about your day, weather, etc.
- Practice asking and answering questions, telling about yourself, your family, your likes and dislikes
- Discuss various topics like travel, movies, hobbies, art, jokes, curious facts and many more
LEARN GRAMMAR
- Take daily lessons: Andy will give you a short grammar explanation and test your understanding
- If you make a mistake Andy doesn’t just tell you the right answer but tries to explain why it is correct

LEARN NEW WORDS

- Andy reminds you to review the words you’ve learned before you forget them
AND MORE
- Andy is always available, you can chat for 5 minutes or 5 hours
- Work on your listening and pronunciation skills with audios of the messages 
- Small and funny games that help you to learn new words and grammar
- Feels like you’re talking to a real person, Andy is friendly, curious and amusing
- Talking to a bot is easier than talking to a person, bot doesn’t judge you and you don't feel shy

bluejetty:00135358:ios.summary: As featured in Forbes, NBC, Money, People, Insider, and Variety, Pawp is a modern vet clinic that puts an expert in your back pocket so you’re never alone when it comes to your pet’s health. Pawp’s pet care membership provides dogs, cats, a
bluejetty:00135358:ios.description:
As featured in Forbes, NBC, Money, People, Insider, and Variety, Pawp is a modern vet clinic that puts an expert in your back pocket so you’re never alone when it comes to your pet’s health. Pawp’s pet care membership provides dogs, cats, and their parents unlimited access to a team of veterinary doctors and nurses who are available 24/7 via video and text. Pawp’s care team uses empathy and expertise to provide a personalized care experience for dogs and cats whether they’re sick, healthy, or in-between. Ask a vet anything about your pet’s health, nutrition, and behavior and receive real-time advice you can trust.
CONNECT WITH A VET 24/7 & TALK TO SOMEONE YOU CAN TRUST
Chat with our expert team of veterinary doctors and nurses from the comfort of your home — or anywhere — day or night. Pawp offers on-demand pet advice meaning there’s no weeks-long wait to get an appointment. Get vet help when your pet needs it, don’t wait for office hours.
GET UNLIMITED APPOINTMENTS & FOLLOW UP ON YOUR SCHEDULE
You can text or video chat with licensed veterinary professionals as many times as you need to. Ask a vet your everyday pet questions as well as seek advice for urgent and emergency issues. Get a second opinion that isn’t the search engine. Ask follow-up questions when they come to your mind.
ASK A VET ANYTHING — WHETHER IT’S URGENT OR YOU NEED A GUT CHECK
Pawp’s care team is filled with knowledgeable and understanding pet professionals in areas like health (vomiting, diarrhea, injury, infections) as well as nutrition (weight loss, food choice, allergies), and behavior (new puppy and kitten questions, cat hiding, or dog spraying).
GET PERSONALIZED & ACTIONABLE PLANS FOR ONGOING CARE
We make sure your pet’s care doesn’t stop when their Pawp visit is over. Our care team will make sure you have the tools you need to give your pet the care they deserve. Each visit results in actionable (and achievable) tasks you can complete to make sure your pet’s ongoing health remains a priority. These can include exercise recommendations, vet-approved resources, and relevant products our experts swear by.
HOW PAWP WORKS
- Download the Pawp vet app
- Become a Pawp member
- Talk to a vet whenever you need
- Get ongoing support, treatments, and advice
- Give your pet the quality pet care they deserve
Privacy Policy: https://pawp.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://pawp.com/tos

bluejetty:00114797:ios.description:
Click X – Classic Mahjong Tile Matching Puzzle
Click X is a relaxing yet challenging mahjong solitaire game that blends classic tile matching with modern design. Featuring large tiles and an easy-to-use interface, it’s the perfect puzzle game for both phone and tablet. Whether you’re looking to relax or keep your mind sharp, Click X is designed especially for older adults and puzzle lovers of all ages.
How to Play：
Simply match identical tiles to clear the board. Tap or slide two matching tiles that are free (not blocked by others), and they will disappear. Clear all tiles to win the game!
Game Features：
●Classic Mahjong Solitaire – Play hundreds of levels with traditional tile sets.
●Innovative Twists – Special tiles add a fresh challenge to the classic mahjong puzzle.
●Large & Clear Design – Big tiles and text for comfortable play.
●Mind Training Mode – Fun puzzles designed to boost memory and focus.
●Relaxed Gameplay – Play mahjong without timers or score pressure.
●Combo Rewards – Match tiles consecutively to unlock exciting effects.
●Helpful Boosters – Use free hints, undo, and shuffle anytime.
●Offline Play – Enjoy mahjong puzzles anytime, anywhere, no Wi-Fi needed.
●Multi-Device Support – Smooth experience on both phone and tablet.
Click X is the free mahjong solitaire puzzle that combines relaxation and brain training. If you love tile matching games, puzzle games, or classic solitaire mahjong, this game is made for you.
Download Click X now and start your mahjong journey today!

bluejetty:00081754:ios.description:
Welcome to Sofra:
 Cooking game - the perfect game for cooking lovers of any age. The peculiarity of the game is that you can repeat all the dishes yourself at home thanks to detailed recipes. The game will reveal the talent of a chef in everyone. The player's main goal is to cook a certain dish, following the recipe from the book. 
Main features of the game:
- Cozy unique design, which will allow you to plunge into the nice cute atmosphere of a home kitchen anywhere in the world.
- Ability to play for people of any age. In the game, you will find recipes of any complexity, from the simplest to the level of superchef.
- Simple interface that allows you to easily prepare your favorite dishes.
- The possibility of developing the story, up to opening your own restaurant.
- Kitchen and character upgrade, which will allow you to try yourself not only as a chef but also as a designer.
- A recipe book that can help you with the choice of a dish every day.
The player has to prepare the dishes according to the recipe. This requires the player to be logical and experiment in the cooking process. The player will have to collect stars and achievements, improve their cooking skills, and advance the story of the game.
Unlock additional content with various in-app purchases:
1. Get 4 exclusive levels + remove ads for $3.99
2. Get 15 levels each month and connect with your team + remove ads with auto renewable monthly subscription for $7.99
3. Get 10 exclusive levels + remove ads for $14.99
Privacy Policy - https://sofragame.com/privacypolicy

bluejetty:00088410:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00088410:ios.description:
Learn Thai alphabet and words with your hands, not just your eyes.
Draw Thai script on screen. Type Thai words with your keyboard. Build muscle memory through interactive learning that actually sticks. While other language learning apps let you guess and move on, Learn Thai Alphabet & Words makes you practice Thai characters for real – because that's how you actually learn to read and write in Thai language.
WHY ACTIVE PRACTICE WORKS BETTER
Your fingers learn Thai script alongside your eyes, building muscle memory that flashcards can't touch. When you physically draw ก or type สวัสดี, your brain creates stronger connections than passive recognition ever could. It's the difference between knowing Thai characters and actually using them.
WHAT YOU GET:
- Complete Thai alphabet with proper character recognition
- 500+ carefully selected Thai words with native pronunciation
- Multi-choice exercises to build recognition before testing recall
- Word collections – import and customize content however you want, or add your own
- Full offline access – download once, learn anywhere
- No accounts, no subscriptions – buy once, own forever
REAL RESULTS, FAST

KEY BENEFITS
Time just about any type of race using the Webscorer app

No limit on number of racers
Racers with bib numbers, or with racer names only
No internet connection required to time a race & get results
INNOVATIVE GRAPHICAL TIMING INTERFACE
Four timing views
+ Normal view: tap once to record both time & racer

Easy to correct mistakes, edit results in place

Post results to Webscorer.com directly from the device
Download results from Webscorer.com

Follow a live race timed by Webscorer PRO

Supported race start types

+ Wave start
+ Interval start
+ Individual start
+ Pursuit start
Races with multiple distances and categories
Import CSV, XLS or TXT start lists
Integration with Webscorer online registration

Record lap times

Fastest lap race

Results by category
Results by gender

Team results
Multi-day results series

Predicted-time race
Age-adjusted results

Time-based handicaps
Percentage handicaps
Penalty-adjusted results

Name sync

+ 2nd device records names in order of finish

Bib sync
+ One device records time stamps
+ 2nd device records bibs in order of finish
+ The devices sync data over Bluetooth or an internet connection
Multi-device splits
+ Point to point races
+ Multi-stage races
+ Mid-race split times
Use multiple devices at finish
+ One master / multiple helper devices
+ All timing finishers on the same race
+ Merge results during or after race
AUTOMATED TIMING
RFID chip timing
+ Supports inexpensive off-the-shelf RFID timing hardware
+ Easy manual taps for missed detections
+ Flexible ways to configure chip IDs, including Bib = Chip ID
NFC chip timing
+ Use timing device as NFC reader
+ Or use an external Bluetooth reader
+ Supports multiple readers per checkpoint
Photocell / Start gate
+ Use a Bluetooth photocell for time stamps
+ Or connect to a external timer with attached photocell
+ Supports all popular timer manufacturers

Winner of the RISING STAR Awar
bluejetty:00021309:ios.description:
ABBYY Business Card Reader –The World’s Fastest Business Card Scanner & Contact Management App for iPhone and iPad! 
Recommended by The New York Times, CNN, The Telegraph, Computer Business Review, Macworld. 
Winner of the RISING STAR Award in the Mobile Star Awards 
ABBYY Business Card Reader easily & simply captures & stores contact from business cards in 25 languages to your iPhone and iPad. The recognized data can be saved in either your device contacts or the app digital storage.
KEY FEATURES
• QUICK AND ACCURATE SCANNING
ABBYYs optical character recognition technology provides quick & accurate recognition of all contact information: names, organizations, phone numbers, e-mail addresses, etc. 
• AUTO-CLICK PHOTO FEATURE
Automatically focuses on the business card, detects its edges, crops any extraneous background & captures an image of the card all by itself. 
• EASY CHECK OF RECOGNIZED DATA
The app highlights “unusual” characters with blue color and displays the original image so that you can quickly confirm the output of the app.
• APPLE WATCH APP. You won’t need to reach for your iPhone or iPad to remember somebody’s name. View contacts and make phone calls right from BCR on your Apple Watch! 
• AUTOMATIC NORMALIZATION OF PHONE AND EXTENTION NUMBERS
BCR will automatically put in all the missing parts so that you can reach the contact even if the country code was omitted in print. 
• AUTOCOMPLETION OF ADDRESSES
BCR corrects any typos and fills in the missing address fields so you can easily find it on the map.
• MANUAL BACKUPS. Manual backups to archive and restore to another device.
• Export contacts to Salesforce Leads (premium account required). BCR can export business cards to Enterprise, Unlimited, and Performance Editions of SF license. Professional Edition does not allow BCR export. 
• Set up voice commands in Siri Shortcuts app to open business cards by voicing the name of the owner.
• Spotlight Search to find business cards from BCR 
• Export business cards to MS Excel in .CSV format.
• Smart Facebook and LinkedIn search: connect social media account to the business card and auto upload photo of contact from Facebook.
• Search in iPhone Maps for the address of your contacts.
• Exchange digitally and forward recognized contacts via e-mail as VCard or JPEG files or via SMS as a plain text.
• Share your contacts using QR code.
• Support 25 languages including recognition of multilingual cards.
- French
- German
- Greek
- Japanese
- Indonesian
- Italian
- Korean
- Norwegian (both Bokmal and Nynorsk)
- Polish
- Portuguese (Portugal)
- Portuguese (Brazil)
- Russian
- Spanish
- Swedish
- Turkish
- Ukrainian
The free version provides 10 card recognition. Enable Premium to get unlimited functionality:
• Unlimited business card recognition
• Export to Excel
• No ads
Premium Account auto-renewable subscription allows using all functions of this app. Subscription length periods: 1 month with 7 days free trial, and 1 year. The subscription is automatically renewed at the end of the period unless you choose to cancel the subscription at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. You can manage your subscription and switch off the auto-renewal by accessing your Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription to that publication. 
Read us:
abbyy.com/blog/mobile
Facebook.com/ABBYYsoft
Twitter @ABBYY_Software
YouTube.com/ABBYYvideos
Privacy Policy abbyy.com/privacy
Terms of Use abbyybcr.com/en/eula
Looking forward to your feedback on the App Store!

bluejetty:00145738:ios.description:
Photo Enhancer - AIPhotor
Photo Enhancer is an easy-to-use photo editor that allows you to enhance your old, pixelated, and blurry photos into high definition with just one tap. AIPhotor uses AI technology to unblur, restore, and enhance any of your photos, turning them into crystal clear HD photos and revitalizing them. You can easily enhance a blurred portrait photo cropped from a larger photo, as well as revitalize your old family photos and reminisce together!
BEST FEATURES OF PHOTO ENHANCER - AIPHOTOR
ENHANCE PHOTO: Upload your blurry photo, an old selfie, or take a photo of your old picture with the camera. Photo Enhancer - AIPhotor will turn it into crystal clear HD in just a few seconds.
- Sharpen and unblur out of focus pictures
- Repair old, blurry, scratched photos
- Upscale images and improve photo resolution to stunning HD quality.
REMOVE BACKGROUND PHOTO: AIPhotor helps you automatically cut out pictures with AI technology, remove the background, and make transparent background PNG pictures in high quality.
- Background remover: This is an easy-to-use background remover app that helps you remove backgrounds from photos and make transparent background PNG pictures in one second. Its advanced AI cutout tool will cut out your picture automatically.
- Background photo editor: Want to change the background for your photo? Try this PNG maker to remove the background from photos first, and then you can change the background you like for it.
- Cutout photo editor: Use this advanced cutout photo editor to erase the background perfectly with this PNG maker. It is also a background photo editor and nature photo editor designed for you to make artworks easily and quickly.
About permissions:
To enhance your photos and make transparent background PNG pictures, AIPhotor needs the “Storage” permission to access photos and files on your device.
To enhance photos and erase the background, Photo Enhancer needs the “Camera” permission to take pictures.
Terms of Service: https://aiphotor.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://aiphotor.com/privacy

Você também terá acesso ao histórico de telemetrias, para saber a que momento os evento foram acionados.
Com o aplicativo GConnect você terá seu carro na palma de sua mão, com mais segurança e confiabilidade, podendo acessar dados dele a qualquer hora e em tempo real.

bluejetty:00115196:ios.description:
In Boat Escape, you’ll experience an innovative gameplay that cleverly combines line-connecting and path-planning mechanics. Your task is to connect dinosaurs of the same color by tapping on them according to the level objectives, helping them board the boat safely and begin their escape journey!
Level Challenges
Each level features unique goals that require you to use your wisdom and strategy to find the best way to connect the dinosaurs and ensure all of them get on the boat safely. As you progress, you’ll encounter more dinosaurs and increasingly varied layouts, testing your observation skills and logical thinking.
Endless Mode
In Endless Mode, you’ll face continuous challenges and strive to achieve higher scores. Each successful connection and dinosaur boarding brings a sense of accomplishment.
Reward System
Completing levels allows you to collect diamonds, coins, tickets, and other generous rewards.
Embark on a line-connecting adventure, help the adorable dinosaurs board the boat, and make a successful escape from danger!
Notice: All in-game rewards are managed solely by the game's development team and have no affiliation with Apple Inc.

bluejetty:00083130:ios.description:
AnyWidget: Lock Screen Widget is an essential application that helps you make personalize Lock Screen and beautify the themes of iPhone. 
In iOS16, You can now add customize widgets to your Lock Screen to glance at information like the launcher, shortcuts, time, date, calendar, progress, text, icon, photos, and more.
# Lock Screen Widget Type
● App Launcher
AnyWidget provides hundreds of popular apps and system apps List for you. You can now create an APP shortcut to the iPhone Lock Screen interface, and start the app with one click. 
● Shortcuts
You can also add shortcuts by entering shortcut name, Web Link, App Scheme. After adding it to the Lock Screen, you can open it with one click.
● Date Progress
Just enter starting date and end date, and immediately record the progress of important events. The progress data is clear at a glance, allowing you to master the date progress in real time.
● Days Counter
Enter the date when the anniversary begins, the app will count the days automatically. Widgets can now be edited to count down to a single event or count up from a special day in the past. Never miss every important days.
● Icon & Text
Customize your lock screen with text, characters, emojis, and photos.
# Lock Screen Widget Size
● Circular
● Rectangular
● Inline
More features waiting for you to explore! If you have any suggestion or feedback, please contact us.
E-Mail: anywidget@outlook.com
Twitter：@Mangos_Li
Official Web: www.deltalab.top/lockscreen
VIP Member Subscription Features
- Subscription periods are 1 month. Every 1 month your subscription renews, you can get unlimited access to all the PRO features.
- If you choose to purchase a subscription your payment will be charged to your iTunes account. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Users can manage or unsubscribe in iTunes & App Store account management in the phone system settings.
Privacy Policy: https://www.deltalab.top/lockscreen/privacy
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

bluejetty:00160812:ios.description:
Dr. Jim Stoppani is the leading authority on exercise science, sports nutrition, and supplementation. Over the past 15+ years, Dr. Stoppani has helped millions of people change their lives through science-based nutrition and supplement plans and expertly designed training programs.
He owns and operates the ground-breaking, award-winning sports nutrition company JYM Supplement Science as well as the Internet's most advanced fitness website, www.jimstoppani.com. His personal and company mission is to change lives through proper training, nutrition and supplementation, all based on the latest scientific research, while always following the motto of "Do the Right Thing." 
Prior to creating JYM Supplement Science in 2013, Dr. Stoppani was a Research Fellow at the Yale School of Medicine, followed by an 11-year tenure as Senior Science Editor at Muscle & Fitness, FLEX and Muscle & Fitness Hers magazines. He has since become one of the most trusted, reliable sources of fitness information on the Internet. The JYMARMY Facebook group page – a community of passionate individuals who follow Dr. Stoppani's training, nutrition and supplement plans – is one of the largest and most engaging online groups, with over 60,000 members.
The Jim Stoppani App allows you exclusive access to thousands of articles, training programs, videos, and diet plans. You get access to his website and App, but most importantly, you'll have the ability to tap his knowledge and get feedback from Dr. Stoppani 24/7. You can integrate all of your information from HealthKit to track your burned calories during workouts, and also take advantage of the App's detailed reps and weight tracking system to see your progress and save historical information.
Dr. Stoppani is changing lives, one person at a time. Join the movement now!
You can use in-app purchase to easily subscribe right from your phone, your iTunes account will be automatically charged after confirming your subscription.
Subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of your subscription.
Your iTunes account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end your subscription period.
You may manage your subscription after purchase and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your iTunes Account Settings.
For Privacy Policy please go to http://www.jimstoppani.com/privacy-policy and Terms and Conditions at https://www.jimstoppani.com/terms

Stay Up To Date - Find park hours and real-time updates for wait times at popular attractions and a daily schedule of showtimes.
Smart Exploration - Navigate with the GPS-enabled map to find the best routes throughout the property. View ride height requirements and accessibility information, dining menus, shop offerings, and more. Place food orders at park restaurants from within the app.
Your Day, Your Way - Save the attractions you and your family want to experience and check them off as your day unfolds.

bluejetty:00187490:ios.summary: Yardi Maintenance Mobile augments the functionality of Yardi Maintenance. Yardi Maintenance Mobile allows maintenance techs to access their assigned work orders from the field. They can add technician labor and inventory to work orders and
bluejetty:00187490:ios.description:
Yardi Maintenance Mobile augments the functionality of Yardi Maintenance. Yardi Maintenance Mobile allows maintenance techs to access their assigned work orders from the field. They can add technician labor and inventory to work orders and record time, notes, and complete work orders in real-time. They also have the ability to create new work orders as needed.
Yardi Maintenance Mobile requires that clients install Yardi Maintenance Plug-in 10.1 (for Voyager™ 60) or Yardi Maintenance Plug-in 3.0 (for Voyager™ 7S) or greater.
• Assigned work orders appear on the maintenance technician’s device instantly 
• Completed results update the Yardi Voyager™ record automatically
• Yardi Maintenance Mobile can operate in areas without a cellular or wireless connection
• Yardi Maintenance Mobile will synchronize data once the connection is reestablished
ABOUT YARDI MAINTENANCE
Yardi Voyager Maintenance Management provides the tools you need to perform and track daily maintenance for your properties with unparalleled ease and efficiency. Streamlined, user-friendly workflows employ intuitive dashboards, calendars, and alerts to speed the maintenance process and ensure that you provide consistently outstanding service to your tenants.
Voyager Maintenance Management also provides seamless integration between resident data and Yardi’s powerful GAAP-based accounting system. Accurate, up-to-date financial information, as well as a complete audit trail, is always at your fingertips.

bluejetty:00161671:ios.name: 5K Runmeter Run Walk Training
bluejetty:00161671:ios.summary: 5K Runmeter is the most advanced application for training ever designed for a mobile device. Built from the ground up for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and iCloud, it makes your iPhone a powerful fitness computer — with maps, graphs, splits, in
bluejetty:00161671:ios.description:
5K Runmeter is the most advanced application for training ever designed for a mobile device. Built from the ground up for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and iCloud, it makes your iPhone a powerful fitness computer — with maps, graphs, splits, intervals, laps, announcements, zones, training plans and more. 
• Obsessively complete... a killer app — Wired
• Records a wealth of data — Macworld
• Clean, easy-to-use — New York Times
Experience core features and dependability for free, then upgrade to Elite to add advanced features.
iPhone powered
• Records an unlimited number of workouts — years of workouts only take up the space of a few songs.
• No website login required.
• Swipe across the stopwatch to see pages of stats, maps, and graphs - completely configurable.
• View your workouts on a calendar, and by routes and activities.
• View bar and pie charts summarizing all your workouts.
• Analyze your workouts on your iPad, updated with your latest data using iCloud.
Plan
• Includes 5K, 10, half, and marathon running plans.
• Design your own training plans.
• Synchronize your plan with your iPhone calendar and your online calendars.
Track
• Exclude stopped time with automatic stop detection.
• View terrain and traffic maps with Google Maps.
• Record heart rate, bike speed, bike cadence, and bike power with sensors.
• Records steps all day and cadence during workouts. 
• Automatically record the weather.
• Start and stop with your earphone remote.
Train
• Supports cycling, running, walking, skating, skiing, and many other activities.
• Keep on track with extremely configurable interval training, zones, and targets.
• Set up repeating intervals, pyramid intervals, or tempo workouts.
• Hear announcements that keep you in the zone.
• Analyze your split, interval, and zone performance.
Hear 
• Select from more than 120 configurable announcements including distance, time, speed, elevation, and heart rate.
• Hear stats automatically at time or distance intervals, or on-demand with your earphone remote.
Race
• Compete against your previous workouts along a route.
• See your virtual competition on a map and in graphs.
Analyze Online - See abvio.com/explorer 
• View the Workout Explorer on your computer or on your iPhone.
• Shared by email, Twitter, Facebook, Strava, or MyFitnessPal. 
• View within the app on any Info page for a workout.
• View your graph, splits, intervals, zones, and more.
• Select a zone to see your map path drawn with zone colors.
Share
• Uses HealthKit to export or import your workouts in the Health app and to read heart rate and biometric data.
• Use email, Facebook, Twitter, Strava, and MyFitnessPal to share your workouts online.
• Automatically keep family and friends notified of your location and progress.
• Share your workout calendar with your friends and coaches.
Import/Export
• Import by tapping on a GPX, TCX, FIT or KML link or file in Mail or Safari.
• Export detailed CSV, GPX, TCX, FIT or KML files for use in maps, graphs, and social fitness sites.
Apple Watch enhanced - See abvio.com/applewatch 
• Set up, start, stop, lap and finish a workout all from the Apple Watch. 
• Intensely configurable pages track any of more than 220 statistics.
• Splits and laps/intervals pages keep you seeing the trends.
• Force touch to start, stop, lap, or access settings from any page.
Your Elite subscription contributes to ongoing development and our responsive customer support. Payment will be applied to your iTunes account on confirmation or at the end of trial. Subscription will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime in your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription. 
Terms and Conditions: https://abvio.com/terms

PIZAP FEATURES
PHOTO EDITING
- Crop, resize, touch up, retouch, and enhance photos
- Apply filters, effects, frames, borders, stickers, and text
- Adjust color, tone, and layout with simple editing tools
- Use cutout and background tools for creative edits
COLLAGES, MEMES & SOCIAL POSTS

- Make memes, quote graphics, stories, profile images, and posts

- Add layers, graphics, outlines, shadows, and text bubbles
- Create flyers, presentations, website graphics, and more
- Save and share finished designs from your device
UPGRADE TO PIZAP PRO
- 7-day free trial
- Unlock premium tools and content
- Remove ads
- Use on all of your devices

bluejetty:00182534:ios.description:
Tick Tock: A Tale for Two is an eerie cooperative puzzle game for two players. Each player needs a copy of the game on their own mobile device (phone or tablet) to play. You can also play cross-platform with a Nintendo Switch or a computer (PC or Mac).

***
You and your friend are trapped in a mystical clockwork world. As time ebbs away you must solve increasingly complex puzzles to escape. Cooperation is key as neither of you have the full picture! Play on two devices, local or remotely, all you need is a voice connection.

bluejetty:00138115:ios.description:
سلفة شركة تمويل من خلال التقنية المالية تتوافق عملياتها مع أحكام الشريعة الإسلامية وتقدم تطبيق للتمويل الطارئ والسريع للأفراد على مدار الساعة ويستغرق الإيداع للتمويل 24 ساعة فقط على أي بنك أو مصرف داخل المملكة العربية السعودية ـ بحيث يمكن طلب مبالغ تمويلية صغيرة تتراوح ما بين 1,000 ريال إلى 30,000 ريال- وفترة سداد تصل إلى 24 شهر وبطريقة سهله. يمكنك طلب التمويل من أي مكان في المملكة العربية السعودية عبر تطبيق سلفة.
لماذا تعتبر سلفة للتمويل الأفضل في تمويل الأفراد؟
طلب التمويل بطريقة إلكترونية بالكامل
تمويل فوري وسريع على مدار الساعة
متوافق مع أحكام الشريعة الإسلامية
بدون تحويل راتب أو كفيل أو حضور
فترة سداد مرنة تصل إلى 24 شهرًا
إيداع التمويل على أي بنك أو مصرف
وكذلك بإمكان الأفراد المستثمرين الاستثمار عبر تمويل أفراد آخرين من خلال سوق التمويل في تطبيق سلفة والحصول على عوائد مالية مغرية جراء الاستثمار في التمويل والذي يوزع بشكل شهري وبنسب عالية الربحية. حيث يعتبر هذا النوع للتمويل بين الأفراد جذاب حيث يستطيع الفرد أن يسلف فرد آخر ويحصل على توزيعات شهرية مغرية وبمبالغ استثمارية صغيرة تبدأ من 100 ريال فقط! 
سلفة تساعد الأفراد على تلبية وإتمام احتياجاتهم الطارئة والمستعجلة. تستخدم سلفة التكنولوجيا المالية لغرض تطوير الخدمات المالية وتسهيل التعاملات وسرعة اتخاذ القرار، بالإضافة إلى إمكان وتحسين الخدمات المالية لمستوى أفضل.
 شركة سلفة هي شركة مساهمة مغلقة تعمل تحت إشراف ورقابة البنك المركزي السعودي بسجل تجاري رقم 1010577762 وتعتبر الشركة الأولى في تقديم التمويل الإستهلاكي المصغر للأفراد عبر التقنية المالية (Fintech) وكذلك تعتبر أول منصة للتمويل الجماعي بين الأفراد.

Precisely isolate speech from background noise and convert it into editable text, freeing you from manual splicing.

Effortlessly edit speech on transcripts and generate it in the original voice, ensuring consistency and coherence throughout your content.
- Change Voice While Preserving Emotion and Tone

- Authentic Voice Cloning
Accurately replicate any voice with our cutting-edge technology, ideal for contents that value consistency, personalized content with emotional connections.
- Professional Voice Overs
Generate voice overs effortlessly by typing text directly on the timeline or by recording and fine-tuning spoken content to achieve flawless results.
- Effortless Video Dubbing
Streamline the dubbing process with our intuitive interface, which guarantees perfect synchronization and simplifies traditional complexities.
- Editing Per Sentence
Tailor words, tone, pitch, or switch voices on sentence basis with ease and flexibility.
With the powerful features outlined above, Vozo Voice is ideally equipped to handle a vast range of video and audio projects, from vlogs, motivational videos and redub videos to marketing materials, educational content, podcasts, cartoons, films, and audiobooks.

bluejetty:00174418:ios.name: Disc Golf Caddy Pro
bluejetty:00174418:ios.summary: Disc Golf Caddy Pro, powered by DiscGolfCourseReview (DGCR) app offering score tracking and the most current and comprehensive disc golf course information, including course descriptions, locations (with driving directions), hole/par detail
bluejetty:00174418:ios.description:
Disc Golf Caddy Pro, powered by DiscGolfCourseReview (DGCR) app offering score tracking and the most current and comprehensive disc golf course information, including course descriptions, locations (with driving directions), hole/par details, maps for almost every disc golf course, 100,000+ course photo,s and 60,000+ course reviews for over 6000 courses (and growing!).
Record your rounds/scorecards and upload them directly to your Scorebook on DGCourseReview.com for score analysis and safe keeping.
You can even upload your friend's rounds to the site and your friends can download their rounds on their own devices later! Track your scores, putts and penalty throws for each hole and keep holes notes for all the players in your group!
Wondering if a disc golf tournament is nearby? Use the app's tournament search! Out of town and lost your go-to driver or mid? The app's shop search has you covered!
Disc Golf Caddy Pro, powered by DGCourseReview, is the most comprehensive and current source of disc golf information available on iPhone.
Features and benefits include:
* Upload or sync yours or your friends scorecards directly to DGCR for backup and scoring analysis.
* Friends can sync rounds submitted to DGCR from other devices to their own device. No need to email scorecards and enter scores manually!
* Share an image of your round with friends via email, facebook, text or more!
* Uploading rounds to DGCR automatically enters you into our monthly disc giveaway! (see details on site)
* Edit your rounds on the site and sync the updated scorecard with your device.
* Round ratings for all your rounds and an overall player rating!
* Import all your rounds entered or backed up on DGCR onto any device with the DGCR app. Getting a new phone doesn't mean you have to lose your scoring data!
* Import rounds from other popular apps using the Round Importer on DGCR and sync those with the DGCR app.
* Rounds on DGCR are stored on our main server and are also backed up on another offsite server on a 5 day rolling backup schedule.
* Integrates directly with DGCourseReview to provide you with up to the minute course, tournament and shop information!
* Search for courses using a standard search form, a proximity (GPS) search or via a map interface.
* Filter your course searches using criteria ranging from hole count to the rating on DGCourseReview to how wooded a course is (among many other filters!)
* Vote on course reviews as your read them!
* Update Course Conditions from the course!
* Mark courses as played right from the app (immediately reflected on your DGCR account online)!
* Search for shops using a standard search form, a proximity search or via a map interface.
* Search for tournaments using a standard search form, a proximity search or via a map interface.
* Comprehensive tournament information including which courses will be used, registration fees, flyers, and more!
* Overall and course level score stats including average putts, best score, eagles, birdies, pars, bogies... and whatever comes after bogies!
* Much, much more!
FAQ's
- To import your rounds from DGCR, tap Stats -> Menu -> Import All Rounds from DGCR
- Your played courses list will be downloaded from DGCR the first time you go to the "Played Courses" list when starting a round
Official Support: http://www.dgcoursereview.com
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00184676:ios.description:
Build your empire one city at a time in this new tap idler sure to make you money hungry! Tap to make money, tap to upgrade your city’s business buildings, and tap some more! Unlock, hire, and collect as many Advisors and Bizbots as you can to upgrade your business value, build your cities faster, and earn a stash of cash as you rise from rags to riches! From the creators of Coin Dozer, Taps to Riches will have you tapping everywhere you go!
- Expand your empire into multiple cities with unique challenges
- Hundreds of hilarious Advisers who add valuable business bonuses! Collect them all!
- Dare to reset your progress and take advantage of Bizbots, a precious resource that give you even more money bonuses per tap!

Taps to Riches is a unique city building simulation game with tap and click mechanics. Upgrade businesses in game to make money and earn extra cash as you venture into new cities. 
Start from the bottom as a newly freed villain with big dreams of once again achieving world domination. Tap your way into riches and money by upgrading buildings and investing in your city. The more cash you invest in businesses the more money they produce for you. Hire valuable Advisors to unlock special business bonuses, and use Bizbot resources for even more cash bonuses!

bluejetty:00156304:ios.name: BoundaryCare Watch-Based GPS
bluejetty:00156304:ios.summary: BoundaryCare improves the independence and safety of vulnerable individuals, ranging from aging in place to cognitive or developmental issues (like Alzheimer’s or other dementias, ASD, Down syndrome, and ALS). Designed to keep caregivers in
bluejetty:00156304:ios.description:
BoundaryCare improves the independence and safety of vulnerable individuals, ranging from aging in place to cognitive or developmental issues (like Alzheimer’s or other dementias, ASD, Down syndrome, and ALS). Designed to keep caregivers in the loop and provide the tools they need to keep their loved ones safe and healthy, BoundaryCare is the only app using the Apple Watch’s top-flight capabilities to power alerts and other information to caregivers’ iPhones and their other devices.
**FEATURES**
**Fall Detection**
Rely on theApple Watch’s industry-leading fall detection technology, with BoundaryCare alerting caregivers instantly when a fall is detected – and helping caregivers decide what to do next.
**Geofencing and Location Updates**
Set up safe boundaries for your loved ones and receive prompt notifications when those boundaries are crossed. With real-time location tracking, you can always know where your loved ones are, reducing the risks associated with wandering or elopement.
**Health Metrics**
Keep an eye on health vitals like heart rate, blood oxygen (with supported Apple Watches), sleep quality, and activity levels. Caregivers can receive alerts about any sudden changes that might need further attention.
**Reminders and Messages**
Schedule reminders and messages to be delivered to your loved one’s Apple Watch at regular times throughout the day or week. Whether it’s time to take medication or to visit a friend, help them structure their day on their own terms.
**Communication**
The Apple Watch can make and receive phone calls, so you can check on your loved one in real time. It can even be set up to auto-answer calls, so you can start speaking to your loved one even if they’re not able to pick up themselves.
**Easy to Use**
Enjoy the intuitive interface, easy for both caregivers and loved ones to use. Loved ones wearing an Apple Watch running BoundaryCare don’t need to do anything at all, and caregivers can easily see key information on their dashboard.
**Share the burden**
BoundaryCare allows you to add as many caregivers as you want – for free. Create a caregiving group to share the responsibility.
**Highly Individualized**
Customize settings to ensure that the app suits your individual needs. Take advantage of Apple Watch’s additional configuration features for your loved one – don’t leave them stuck with a stigmatizing and generic hardware of alternative alerting solutions.
**Customer Support**
Our dedicated team is always ready to assist you. Whenever you have a question or need help with the app, we're just a message away.
**1 Month Free Trial**
Try BoundaryCare free for one month to make sure it works for you. Afterwards, subscriptions start at $25/month, a much lower price than other leading alerting systems.
BoundaryCare is more than just an app – it's a comprehensive platform designed to transform the way you care for your loved ones. By providing crucial support for those at high risk for falls or medical issues or living with dementia, ASD, or Down syndrome, BoundaryCare ensures that loved ones can enjoy their freedom and independence, while caregivers gain peace of mind. Why wait? Download BoundaryCare today and share the burden of caregiving.
Website: www.boundarycare.com
Terms of Service: https://www.boundarycare.com/terms-and-conditions
Disclaimer: Continued use of location services while the app is in the background can drain the battery. BoundaryCare will never sell or share your sensitive data.

bluejetty:00083038:ios.description:
Δ Find your lost Headphones, Fitbit, Fitness Tracker, Earbuds and many more Bluetooth devices...
Δ The radar will locate BLE devices in your area
Δ Then you can find your device by using the proximity signal
More info:
1. Start the application and watch the radar find the Bluetooth device around you.
2. Select your device and walk in the direction that increases the intensity signal. That is the zone where you need to head to. 
3. Walk slowly and take your time. You'll find it! 
Extra: you can also give your device a custom name instead of the automatic system number.
You are not the first one to loose your earbuds or Bluetooth device. It happens all the time. So breathe deeply and use the app to find it back.
Download and start looking for your device now. Do not wait before it runs out of battery!
Disclaimer: 
- The radar is powerful. If it uncover too many devices, we suggest you power OFF as many Bluetooth devices as possible so you can focus on the devices you look for.
- Your Bluetooth device need to be powered, ON and within a detectable range. So walk around until you think the radar located your device.
- BLE stands for Bluetooth Low Energy. It is a communication protocol used by many devices to convey information wirelessly.
- The app works with many different devices. If it does work with a particular one, contact us and we'll have a look.
- We are not linked with any companies mentioned here in any way. We only tested the app with these devices.
- Fitbit® is a registered trademark or trademark of Fitbit, Inc. and/or its affiliates in the United States and other countries.
- Extended use of this app can decrease battery life rapidly.
SUBSCRIPTION:
We offer 2 auto-renewing subscriptions:
- Length: weekly and monthly
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- You will be able to access the Premium features of the app for the duration of the subscription
- Subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the cost of the chosen package.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period
- You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription setting through your Apple account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged. Please visit https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039 for more information on how to proceed.
- You may turn off the auto-renewal of your subscription via your Apple Account Settings. However, you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period
- Any unused portion of a free-trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
Privacy Policy:
https://planecubes.com/privacy/
Terms of Use:
https://planecubes.com/terms/

Abandon the ship, I repeat abandon the ship! Women and children first! The ship is not sinking, but I intend to accelerate it to the limit and jump off the giant ramp just to enjoy the spectacular catastrophe!

It may be crazy, but normality is boring and our game is definitely not! After all, why play sensible realistic games when you can jump an aircraft carrier off the headland and smash it to pieces in downtown Manhattan!

Take control of one of the many ships and boats of all kind, and try to reach your destination before gravity gets you. Discover new ships, and interesting locations.

Before starting the session, we recommend closing your eyes for a few seconds and listening to the surrounding environment to establish a connection with it.
Always start the session with simple questions such as: "Is anyone here?" or "can I talk to someone?", to gradually approach you.
Be respectful in the use of this tool and try not to make them angry and not to insult them because there could be consequences.

bluejetty:00022376:ios.description:
Animal Care Centers of NYC (ACC) app allows you to search for adoptable pets right from your iPhone & iPad. As the largest open-door shelter in the Northeast, ACC has 300 to 500+ animals available for adoption on any given day. 
This app is perfect for those who are looking for a new companion animal and want the most-up-to date list from which to select their new pet. bluejetty:00087378:ios.description:
Do you like capybaras? A brand new puzzle elimination game themed around capybaras is here!
The adorable capybaras are almost late for school, so hurry up and pack their lunchboxes for them. Tap on a capybara to move it to a lotus leaf, collect dumplings of the same color to fill the lunchboxes, and you can clear the level once all the capybaras have their lunchboxes packed. There are quite a few capybaras waiting to go to school, so you need to use your brain and plan a reasonable route to solve the congestion. Additionally, collecting dumplings can summon different capybaras, and the capybaras you have obtained can be placed in the dorms to create a unique dorm of your own.
Join the capybara community with your friends, enjoy the fun of elimination in a smart start, and embark on a strange adventure!
