bluejetty:00060258:android.description:
Vivo Empresas is Vivo's app for your business. With it, you can manage mobile accounts, products and services that your company uses. 
It is the most practical way for you, the company manager, to find self-service options. In the app, you can download the 2nd copy, the simple or detailed invoice, activate or deactivate international roaming, manage lines and chips, monitor consumption and start technical support. 
And there's more: check out and redeem benefits for you and your business through Vivo Valoriza Empresas. 
If you are an employee of a company that uses Vivo's mobile lines, you can monitor your line's consumption and, if necessary, purchase additional internet data and voice packages through the app. 
Check out the app's features and services to make your daily life easier: 
◉ Accounts and invoices 
Copy the barcode and check account details and mobile line payments 
◉ International roaming 
Activate or block the use of your company's mobile phones outside Brazil 
◉ Vivo Values Companies 
Redeem exclusive benefits for you and your company 
 ◉ Technical support 
Start technical support for mobile lines and some fixed services, such as telephone and internet, and check the technical visits you have already requested 
◉ Aura 
Get your questions answered with Vivo’s virtual assistant 
For collaborators 
◉ Consumption 
Monitor internet consumption on your mobile line 
◉ Vivo UP 
Purchase additional packages and keep your mobile line connected 
◉ Vivo Values Companies 
Exclusive discounts and benefits for you and even your pet 
◉ Technical support 
Start technical support to resolve problems on your mobile line 
Important information: 
◉ The app requires an internet connection to work; 
◉ Browsing the app is free for Vivo Empresas customers connected to our network. In other words, you can use it without consuming internet from your data allowance; 
◉ To take advantage of Vivo Empresas, always update the application with the latest version; 
◉ Share with us your experience using the app. Your opinion helps us know what we can improve.

bluejetty:00062404:ios.description:
Lexis - learn English effectively and memorize words forever. Speak freely when traveling and at work.
- Lessons are personalized just for you
- New words and repetition in each lesson
- Learn over 3,650 words per year
No cramming! Learn when you are comfortable, improve your level of English, and get all the benefits from being fluent in English - comfortable travel and more confident at work!
We will show new words in each lesson and remind you of past ones. A unique algorithm based on Hermann Ebbinghaus's “forgetting curve”. Effortlessly, words will go from your short-term to long-term memory. You will be surprised how effectively this method will affect the result.
- Simple and convenient functionality to help focus on effective learning.
- Choose what you want to learn, just brushing words up or down
- For effective memorization, just 5 minutes per day is enough
- In the course of learning the words become more difficult, in accordance with your level
Follow the progress and enjoy the new victories in the "Statistics" section. We will help you keep the pace because this is half the success!
Good luck! ;)
If you like the app, you can subscribe to our services, which will renew automatically.
We have multiple subscription options to choose from, starting as low as $3.54/month:
- Your iTunes account will be charged at confirmation of your purchase and auto-renews for the same price and duration period as the original one/three/six-month package;
- Auto-renew may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase and must be turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period;
- No cancellation of the current upgrade plan is allowed during your active period.
Privacy Policy: https://lexis.ltd/privacy
Terms and Conditions: https://lexis.ltd/terms

A comprehensive set of tools for any musician:
* Chord Progression: Create beautiful chord progressions with full flexibility - use inversions, sus2, sus4, 7th, 9th, and more. Enjoy live playback as piano or synth, or send MIDI directly to your macOS computer!

* MIDI Keyboard - Transform your phone into a MIDI keyboard for your macOS computer (compatible with macOS Catalina and newer).
* Notation Practice: Practice reading notes in both treble and bass clefs.
* Interval Practice: Practice recognizing and comparing musical intervals by ear.
* Chord Calculation: Help you learn how to calculate chords and progressions.
* Voice & Ear Training: Simple, effective tools for voice practice and ear training.
* Harmonic Match - helps you mix tracks in key while DJing.
* Guitar Chords - helps you find and browse guitar chords.
* Guitar Tuner - helps you tune your guitar to the most popular tunings.
Plus, enjoy the macOS version included with your purchase!

bluejetty:00186069:ios.description:
Voice Record Pro 7 is a professional voice recorder based on powerful engine of Voice Record Pro, but with a more flat design. With recorded files you can:
- Export to and import from Google Drive™ 
- Export to and import from DropBox 
- Export to and import from Microsoft® OneDrive 
- Export to and import from Box Cloud
- Export to SoundCloud 
- Export to FTP server 
- Export to any hosted Web based Script
- Send to other devices via Bluetooth 
- Download directly to PC using built-in web server via local WiFi connection
- Upload from PC using WiFi connection
- WebDav support using WiFi service
- Convert to a movie clip and export to Photo Albums 
- Post as a Movie Clip to YouTube
- Export to other apps on your device that can handle the audio file 
- Import from other apps 
- Send Audio or Movie by email 
- Send Audio or Movie by SMS/iMessage
- Add notes to records 
- Add photo to records 
- Add bookmarks to records 
- Modify ID3v2 tags
- Append a record to another record
- Split a record into multiple parts
- Join multiple audio records into one
- Apply effects to the recorded or imported file including:
 - Echo
 - Volume/Gain
 - Pitch & Speed
 - Reverb
 - Distortion
 - 3/6/10 Band Equalizer
Additionally you can: 
- Convert the records to other formats
- Trim the records 
- Duplicate the records 
- Append records 
- Protect the app with a passcode

Dive into the ancient art of the Samurai with our state-of-the-art app. Engage in an immersive 3D experience as you craft custom Samurai swords, including the revered
bluejetty:00160681:ios.description:
Forge Your Samurai Legacy: Craft Custom Katana & other Samurai Swords
Dive into the ancient art of the Samurai with our state-of-the-art app. Engage in an immersive 3D experience as you craft custom Samurai swords, including the revered Katana. Choose from a variety of options to create a blade that speaks to your soul. Once your Samurai sword or Katana is forged in the virtual world, our master swordsmiths will bring it to life with unrivaled craftsmanship.
Immerse Yourself in Stunning Visuals 
Revel in lifelike 3D graphics inspired by real Katana & Samurai swords.
Witness your Katana taking shape in real-time previews.
Save and modify your Samurai sword designs anytime.
Take Full Control Over Your Samurai Sword Creation
Get hands-on with intuitive controls to zoom, spin, and rotate your Katana sword.
Design your Samurai sword in three Japanese atmospheric environments.
Enjoy an effortless and fun creation process.
Unleash Exclusive Discounts & Special Offers
Enter the Samurai’s Inner Circle with our VIP club for monthly coupons and exclusive Katana offers.
Discover hidden discounts on Samurai sword sets.
Earn rewards and benefits as an honored affiliate.
Choose Your Blade - A Samurai Is Known By His Sword
Select from various steel types for your Katana, including 1060 carbon steel, 1095 carbon steel, 9260 Spring steel, T10 tool steel and Tamahagane steel.
Customize your Samurai sword’s blade by folding to create intricate layers and patterns.
Achieve an authentic Hamon line on your Katana through clay tempering.
Adorn Your Samurai Sword With Custom Fittings
Choose from hundreds of Tsuba (Handguard), Habaki, Seppa, Fuchi, Kashira, and Menuki designs.
Feature animals, warriors, nature, or mythological creatures on your Katana, handcrafted from materials of your choice.
Enhance and Accessorize Your Samurai Sword
Make your Samurai sword unique with engraved text, images, different polishing styles, and naturally dyed colored blades.
Display or carry your Katana in style with custom bags, stands, and boxes.
Exciting New Sword Types!
While Katana swords are the soul of Samurai warriors, this update will also allow you to craft:
- Wakizashi - The sidekick of the Katana, perfect for close-quarter combat.
- Tanto - A compact blade for swift actions, known for its piercing strength.
- Nodachi - The mighty battlefield sword, wielded by Samurai for its impressive range and cutting ability.
- Nagamaki – A traditional Japanese sword with an elongated handle, designed for sweeping strikes.
- Ninjato – Favored by legends of the ninja, this straight blade is known for its speed and ease in handling.
- Shirasaya Katana - A Katana with a natural wood mounting to protect the blade, representing simplicity and elegance.
- Shirasaya Wakizashi - Similar to its larger counterpart, but in the versatile Wakizashi size.
- Shirasaya Tanto – Combining the compact and sharp Tanto blade with a simplistic wood mounting for protection and style.
Forge Your Samurai Masterpiece Today!
Your journey as a modern-day Samurai begins now. Download and wield the power to create a legacy with your very own custom Katana or any other Samurai sword.

bluejetty:00138717:ios.description:
スタスト 星の島の物語はファンシーな色味が幻想的な世界を舞台に、ゆる〜い雰囲気の海の仲間たちを集めたり、島の模様替えやアバターの着せ替えをしたり、どこか波長の合う友人たちと、気軽におしゃべりできる素敵な空間を作たり、釣りを楽しめたりとのんびりと遊ぶことができる。 島やアバターは豊富なアイテムにより思い通りのコーディネートが可能。
きらめく海に浮かぶ、あなただけの島を作りましょう。
釣りをして可愛い海のお魚たちを集めたり。島に好きなアイテムを置いてみたり。
自由に着せ替えをしてみたり、誰かとボーっとしながら癒やされてみたり。
心満たす幻想的な世界—スタストが、あなたを待っています。
癒やしの世界へ
•スタストの幻想的な世界では可愛いキャラクター達が暮らしています。ちょっと疲れた日のあなたへ。スタストの世界で癒やされてみるのはいかがでしょう。
•シンプルだからゲームをあまりしない人でも安心。気軽に始めてみましょう。
•誰かと話したい時。スタストの世界が好きな人と気軽におしゃべりができます。
•可愛い着せ替えや空間アイテムがいっぱい
•釣りなどの多種多様な遊び要素
海の仲間と遊ぼう
•集める: 釣りをしてたくさんの海の仲間を集めましょう。
ショップで売っている餌を使うと、レアな仲間が手に入るかも？
 • 遊ぶ海の仲間を連れて、お出かけすることができます。一緒に泳いで釣りをして、癒しの時間を過ごしましょう。
 • 仲を深める: アイテムを使って海の仲間たちを育成して親密度を上げることができます。親密度が上がると背中に乗せてくれる仲間が現れたり、もっとたくさんの交流を楽しめるようになります。
・泳ぐ魚: 集めた海の仲間たちは、川や水族館に放すことができます。お気に入りの仲間たちの姿をいつでも鑑賞することはもちろん、一緒に泳ぐこともできます。
自由度の高い着せ替えや模様替え　
・可愛くて魅力的なアイテムがたくさん登場します。髪型、洋服、アクセサリー。家具に島全体の空から植物までカスタマイズ可能。
・スタストでしか体験できない、自由度の高い着せ替えと模様替えができます。あなたの好みに合わせて、あなただけの見た目を作りましょう。

Legacy of Kings: Plague Era – Can you survive the Great Sickness?
The once-mighty empire has fallen. A devastating pandemic has swept through the realm, leaving a toxic green contagion in its wake. This is no longer just a game of building
bluejetty:00095863:ios.description:
Legacy of Kings: Plague Era – Can you survive the Great Sickness?
The once-mighty empire has fallen. A devastating pandemic has swept through the realm, leaving a toxic green contagion in its wake. This is no longer just a game of building—it is a battle against the Black Death. In this idle tycoon, you are the last hope. Rebuild a kingdom from the ruins of a dark apocalypse. Clear the infestation from your lands, manage resources amidst the sickness, and restore life to a world choked by disease. Whether online or offline, your mission to cure the land continues. 
WHY YOU’LL LOVE LEGACY OF KINGS 
Fight the epidemic: Accept vital quests to clear the infection from tiles. Watch the toxic clouds lift as you push back the contagion. 
Gritty atmosphere: Explore a world of boarded-up houses, lonely graves, and shadows of rats circling ruined castles.
Idle strategy: Your empire grows even when you’re offline—perfect for fans of deep management and survival. 
From ruin to Royalty: Take over a dilapidated castle and transform it into a fortified sanctuary against the outbreak. 
Enhance your strategy, manage your resources with finesse, and heal the world before the Black Death takes it all. 
Will you rise from the ashes, or fall to the infection?
Indonesian Rating: This app has received an IGRS rating of 13+.
Optimized for iPhone 13+ | Highly recommended for smooth gameplay and peak performance.

bluejetty:00160389:ios.description:
The NASB Bible delivers a highly accurate and word-for-word translation of the Holy Scriptures, trusted for serious Bible study and teaching. This audio Bible app allows users to listen and read simultaneously, making it ideal for both learning and devotion. With offline Bible access, verse highlights, bookmarks, and structured navigation, it supports deep study sessions and daily reading habits. Designed for clarity and precision, this Christian Bible app ensures a seamless experience for those seeking truth and understanding in God’s Word anytime, anywhere.
Features -
Daily Verse: Set reminders to receive daily Bible verse notifications.
MY LIBRARY: Access your highlighted verses, notes, and bookmarked Scriptures in one place.
Old & New Testaments: Read both the Old and New Testaments within one app.
Verse Editor: Create beautiful Bible verse posts using different backgrounds and share them with others.
Nearby Churches: Discover churches near your location.
Books: Explore a collection of Christian eBooks.
Wallpapers: Browse a beautiful collection of inspiring wallpapers.
Videos: Watch videos on Jesus, hope, wisdom, motivation, gratitude, healing, and more.
Festive Calendar: Explore Christian festivals and feast days.
Popular Verse: Discover Bible verses by topics such as love, fear, peace, and more.
Customise Your Bible: Personalise your reading experience by adjusting fonts and text colours.
1000 Praises: Explore a devotional collection celebrating God's names and attributes.
Bible Quotes: Share Bible quotes in both image and text formats.
Bible Quiz: Test your knowledge of the Bible through engaging quizzes.
Bible Stories: Explore timeless and inspiring Bible stories for readers of all ages.
Help Desk: Submit support requests and attach photos to provide additional details.
Dictionary: Explore a searchable, Bible-based dictionary for easy reference.
Dream Meanings: Discover Biblical and Christian perspectives on dream meanings.
Word Highlights: Highlight specific words or letters for deeper reflection.
App Activity: Track your reading streaks, time spent, refreshes, and overall app usage.
Search: Quickly find Bible verses, chapters, and topics.
Products: Explore Bible-related products available within the app.
VerseBot: Get AI-powered explanations of Bible verses with convenient copying and sharing options.
Bible Verse Clips: Enjoy short, inspirational Bible clips shared by the community.
Prayer Request: Submit prayer requests and receive support from the community.
Nearby Events: Discover Christian events and gatherings near your location.
Chapter-Wise Video Learning: Watch videos that help you gain a deeper understanding of individual Bible chapters.

bluejetty:00100174:ios.description:
The professional trucking app that connects independent CDL holders with freight opportunities. Similar to Uber Driver, but for the trucking industry. Join thousands of driver partners earning with Homeland's freight marketplace.
Continuous GPS (every 15 min, even when the app is closed - with your consent) keeps dispatchers up-to-date on every load.
KEY FEATURES:
• Smart Load Matching – Get matched with profitable freight based on your location
• Real-Time GPS Updates – Automatic location sharing every 15 minutes keeps dispatch informed
• Direct Dispatcher Chat – Message, share photos, upload PODs instantly
• Professional Tools – Digital paperwork, one-tap status updates (Arrive, Depart, Deliver)
• Background Operation – Works while you drive, respecting FMCSA regulations
---
HOW TO BECOME A PARTNER:
1. Download app and tap "Apply to Join Our Team"
2. Submit your information
3. Our team verifies your credentials and safety record
4. Start receiving load opportunities upon approval
We approve drivers who meet standard industry requirements:
+ Valid CDL (Commercial Driver's License)
+ Clean safety record
+ Insurance verification
+ Background check clearance
Already approved? Sign in with your email to start earning.
WHY DRIVERS CHOOSE HOMELAND:
• Consistent freight opportunities
• Competitive pay direct to your bank
• Professional dispatch support
• Technology that understands trucking
BUILT FOR LONG-HAUL REALITY:
Background GPS sharing (with your permission) means dispatch stays updated during your 8-11 hour drives without you touching your phone - keeping you compliant and safe.
---
PRIVACY & CONTROL:
• Location (every 15 min, even in background): Only shared when you set status to "Available Now" or "Driving Homeland Load"
• Camera & Photos: Used only when you choose to scan documents or photo PODs - nothing accessed automatically
• Notifications: Load offers and important alerts
• All data encrypted in transit and never sold
---
Join the growing network of independent CDL holders partnering with Homeland Transport Inc.
Need help? Contact support@homelandtransportinc.com
Official website: https://homelandtms.com/
Privacy Policy: https://homelandtms.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://homelandtms.com/terms

bluejetty:00170924:ios.description:
LFC Live: for Mersey Reds Fans is an unofficial football app for the fans of Liverpool! With comments, blogs and chats.
You will get every piece of information about the club in an instant! From the latest news, live scores and match analysis to game schedule, results and goal notifications – all the important info for a true fan.
Our app is free, as fast as Salah and helps you follow the team anytime and anywhere.
There is so much you can do:
Join the fan community. Take part in hot discussions, leave your comments and opinion.
Receive match updates, live scores and results.
Read all the breaking news related to the Club, including confirmed transfers, rumours and potential new signings.
Study which team has the best chances to win the match.
Adjust your notifications for live scores and results, lineups, kick-off time, yellow and red cards.
Try our blogging platform. You can create your own posts and publish them inside the app.
Read through match previews and tactical analysis.
Study post-match reports, editorial columns and opinions.
Watch videos. Unfortunately, we can't broadcast any live games. However, we deliver video highlights when we can, as well as players’ best performances of the season and more.
Find calendar and standings for all the major leagues and cups.
Dive into detailed team statistics and players' careers.
See who has the best performance on the pitch in today's match.
Follow penalty shoot-outs in matches.
Turn on the dark mode.
Share your emotions with other fans!
You can easily keep an eye on leagues and cups where the club takes part – Premier League, Champions League, League Cup, FA Cup and friendly matches.
More features will come with our next updates, so stay with us!
For all the statistics lovers out there, we are happy to offer extended data, including:
Updated match centre. More team information is now displayed during any match. Including head-to-head info.
Players' injuries.
Information about players on loan.
Coach career as a player.
Transfer prices.
We have finally added an option to disable ads in the application with a paid subscription. The following options are available:
Disable ads for 1 year.
Disable ads for 1 month.
Free trial for 7 days.
Our application isn't an official one, it isn't created for or otherwise related to the club. It is being developed and supported by fans for other fans.
We are open for cooperation. You can contact us with any questions or suggestions at support.90live@tribuna.com.
Download LFC Live: for Mersey Reds Fans now and keep the spirit of Anfield with you everywhere you go! You'll Never Walk Alone!

bluejetty:00186942:ios.description:
We know that parents who play an active role in a child’s education can help them achieve educational success. With the support and involvement of parents; students have fewer behavior problems, obtain better academic performance, and are more likely to graduate secondary school. 
That’s why allowing parents to follow their child’s daily progress, track teacher-given feedback and teacher-awards, exchange messages with teachers, and gain insights into areas that they may need a helping hand, helps position them for success. With these insights, parents can have a greater positive influence on their child's learning and development - all of this through a simple-to-use app.
WHAT YOU’LL FIND INSIDE:
UPDATES TAB
A snapshot of what happened at school today, and what is still pending so parents can give their children a helping hand. 
PERFORMANCE TAB
Gives parents a daily view across all subjects, lessons, and activities that their child has covered as well as other teacher-given awards and feedback. View your child’s progress across each subject and quickly see the performance in real-time. 
MESSAGING
Teachers and school administrators can communicate directly with their student’s Guardians with one-to-one messaging, general announcements, and can send other news and useful information about their children.
WEEKLY REPORT
The weekly report provides a greater breakdown of how your child has performed on a week-to-week basis, the awards achieved, and possible areas of improvement.

bluejetty:00159127:ios.description:
*** Featured on Product Hunt! ***
Weather Hippie is a fun free weather app that allows you to stay ahead of extreme weather conditions in your area. With the recent unpredictable weather conditions experienced across the country, Weather Hippie is your trusty buddy that will give you reliable, real-time weather updates and alerts. Travel safe, stay protected and keep your loved ones secure under the watchful eye of Weather Hippie – plus he’s pretty cool to have around. 
Why Use Weather Hippie:
▸ Notifications
Receive forecasts for the upcoming day each morning and severe weather alerts.
▸ Accurate weather updates to the minute: 
Dark Sky’s super accurate weather data gives you quick access to your current, hourly, and daily forecasts. 
▸ Rain Alerts, accurate alerts for upcoming precipitation (Premium users only)
▸ Siri Shortcuts
Retrieve weather forecasts from Siri
▸ Radar Maps
Live and interactive weather radar maps
▸ Real-time alerts directly from National Weather Service NOAA, UK's MetOffice and Environment Canada:
Feel secure in knowing that all updates are verified and direct from National Weather Service NOAA, MetOffice and Environment Canada’s robust database. You will receive notifications the minute there are new alerts, updates to existing alerts or emergency weather trends.
▸ Air quality readings from AirNow and Environment Canada.
▸ Today widget with the current forecast.
▸ Support for multiple cities 
▸ Beautiful UX/UI:
Enjoy a modern, clean and intuitive design so that you can easily locate the information you are looking for. Receive updates on a clutter-free platform – Weather Hippie designed this with you in mind ... he is your buddy after all.
▸ Certainty in weather uncertainty:
Weather Hippie is a free reliable app created for users to ensure they are safe when weather conditions are unsafe. With the everchanging climate, staying on top of weather network alerts has become increasingly important. Weather Hippie informs in a fun, safe, accurate way so that you can go about your day knowing he’s got your back.
He’s hip, he’s cool and he’s real-time – download Weather Hippie today. 
BATTERY AND STORAGE OPTIMIZED
▸ Super small app size
⊘ NO background location tracking, ever.
Weather Hippie uses auto-renewing subscriptions. The Premium subscription provides additional feature

bluejetty:00169283:ios.description:
Tired of wondering who’s on the other end of your job applications? With the Randstad app you can stop waiting for someone to respond and take control of your job search with FREE 24/7 access to jobs near you, delivered right to your iPhone or iPad.
Find flexible jobs near you with this new self-service option. Our Randstad app is rapidly expanding across the US. If you do not currently see jobs in your area, we’ll be there soon! 
WHY CHOOSE randstad: jobs for workers
- get 24/7 access to jobs near you 
- real time updates of job openings that you are qualified for
- you decide what job(s) to take and what shifts to sign up for
- know the hourly pay rate, company, location, and job requirements upfront
- easy access to upcoming shifts and assignments
- confirm shifts or call off if you are no longer able to work
- rate clients after completing a shift
DO IT ALL FROM THE APP:
Start a new job right! Everything is easy from your iPhone or iPad including: background checks (if needed), identity verification, and more. Receive all of the benefits of being a Randstad employee without the wait.
OTHER BENEFITS AT YOUR FINGERTIPS:
- enter hours worked and break times
- easily view pay stub info
- push notifications and reminders
- invitations to accept shifts from previous clients
- keep your contact info up to date
- refer a friend and earn a referral fee
Your next career move is literally in your hands. Download the app and get started right away!
¡Disponible en Español!

bluejetty:00161139:ios.description:
Can’t fall asleep? White Noise Deluxe is an easy-to-use sound machine designed to help you sleep like a baby. Choose from hundreds of soothing sounds, including white noise, gentle rain, ocean waves, and the steady hum of a fan. Play your favorite sound or mix up to 10 sounds to create the perfect soundscape for falling asleep and staying asleep.
CREATE YOUR PERFECT SLEEP SOUNDSCAPE
• Mix up to 10 sounds at once
• Adjust each sound to build your ideal bedtime mix
• Save favorite mixes and listen offline
• Explore 100+ immersive sleep scenes and community-created mixes
• Create public or private mixes
BUILT FOR BEDTIME
• Set a sleep timer with a gentle fade-out
• Keep sounds playing in the background or with your screen locked
• Use a comfortable dark interface at night
• Take your familiar sleep routine with you to hotels, flights, and new places
• Create a calm bedtime environment for adults, babies, and kids
SLEEP SOUNDS, COLOR NOISE & MORE
• White Noise, Green Noise, Brown Noise, Pink Noise & more - find the noise that feels right for your bedtime
• Rain & Thunder - light rain, heavy rain, rain on a tent, thunderstorms
• Ocean & Water - waves, streams, rivers, waterfalls
• Fan & Machines - box fan, air conditioner, hairdryer
• Nature - forest, wind, birds, crickets
• Home - dishwasher, washing machine, ticking clock
• Travel - train, airplane, car
• Brainwaves - immersive brainwave tracks for bedtime
• Sleep Music - calming music for winding down
• And SO much more!
SLEEP SOUNDS FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
White Noise Deluxe makes it easy to create a calm, familiar bedtime environment for adults, babies, newborns, infants, toddlers, kids, and older children. Choose a simple white noise or fan sound, play relaxing rain or ocean waves, or create a custom mix for bedtime and naps.
Whether you’re sleeping at home, soothing a baby at bedtime, helping a toddler settle down for a nap, or trying to get comfortable in a hotel or on a flight, your favorite sleep sounds are always close by.
DISCOVER & SHARE SLEEP MIXES
Explore sleep soundscapes created by the community, save your favorites to your library, and create channels of your own. Keep them private or share them with other sleepers.
UNLIMITED ACCESS TO ALL FEATURES
• You can subscribe for unlimited access to all features within White Noise Deluxe.
• Subscriptions are billed weekly, monthly, or annually at the rate selected, depending on the subscription plan.
Privacy Policy: https://whitenoisedeluxe.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://whitenoisedeluxe.com/terms
Turn bedtime into the calmest part of your day with White Noise Deluxe.

bluejetty:00092555:ios.summary: Quality care shouldn't be a privilege. Mochi Health is an online telehealth marketplace where you choose your doctor, your pharmacy, and your treatment — all under one transparent, flat-rate membership. No middlemen. No hidden fees. No wait
bluejetty:00092555:ios.description:
Quality care shouldn't be a privilege. Mochi Health is an online telehealth marketplace where you choose your doctor, your pharmacy, and your treatment — all under one transparent, flat-rate membership. No middlemen. No hidden fees. No waiting.
HOW IT WORKS
 1. Complete a short health intake on your own schedule
 2. Choose a board-certified provider by specialty and background
 3. Get a personalized care plan — GLP-1, skincare, hair loss, nutrition, and more
 4. Message your doctor or care team anytime. 24/7 support included
"I’ve had a really good experience with Mochi Health so far. The process is straightforward, communication is consistent, and everything feels organized and professional. I didn’t feel lost or confused at any point, which is a big deal when it comes to online healthcare. From ordering to delivery, everything has been reliable, and I feel supported without it being overwhelming. It’s convenient, efficient, and honestly takes a lot of stress out of managing things on my own." 
-Verified App Store Review
WEIGHT LOSS
Access weight loss medication — prescribed by licensed US doctors and shipped directly to your door. 50% of Mochi patients lose at least 10% of their body weight within six months. Fixed pricing. No surprise fees when your dose increases.
· Compounded semaglutide injection (once-weekly)
SKINCARE
Personalized treatments formulated for your skin, not a one-size-fits-all shelf product.
· Acne & breakout treatments
· Anti-aging & retinoid formulas
· Hyperpigmentation & melasma creams
· Rosacea management
HAIR LOSS
Prescription-strength treatments for hair thinning and loss, reviewed by licensed providers who take the full picture into account.
· Topical minoxidil & finasteride
· Oral hair loss medications
· Scalp treatment formulas
MENOPAUSE
Find relief from perimenopause and menopause symptoms: hot flashes, night sweats, low libido, and hormonal shifts. Mochi also supports women navigating PCOS and hormonal imbalances that are too often dismissed elsewhere.
· Hormone replacement therapy (HRT)
· Estradiol patches & topicals
· Progesterone support
· PCOS & hormonal imbalance treatment
MENTAL HEALTH
Personalized treatment plans for anxiety, depression, and stress management. Fully online with ongoing provider support.
· Anxiety & depression medication management
· Ongoing provider messaging & check-ins
· Personalized care plans
LONGEVITY
Explore treatments designed to help you understand and optimize your long-term health.
· NAD+ therapy (injections & nasal spray)
· Peptide treatments
· Wearables integration
SEXUAL HEALTH
Access treatments for erectile dysfunction, low libido, and other sexual health concerns. Discreetly, affordably, and without the waiting room.
· Erectile dysfunction medication
· Low libido & hormone support
· Discreet, direct-to-door delivery
Thousands of medications, delivered. Compare pharmacies by medication, turnaround time, and ratings. Access GLP-1 treatments, skincare medications, and more. All shipped directly to your door. Switch pharmacies whenever you want.
Everything in one place. Manage your care, talk to your provider, and order medication. All from the Mochi Health app. Available in all 50 states. Join Mochi today.
All professional medical services are provided by licensed physicians and clinicians affiliated with independently owned and operated professional practices.

bluejetty:00182688:ios.name: Primal Hunter: Titans Hunting
bluejetty:00182688:ios.summary:
Epic winter hunting is finally on iOS! 
Primal Hunter: Shooting Game is an intense hunting simulation that is completely true to life and breathtaking, where your mission is to stay alive. You're a hero who has landed on a distant, hidden,
bluejetty:00182688:ios.description:
Epic winter hunting is finally on iOS! 
Primal Hunter: Shooting Game is an intense hunting simulation that is completely true to life and breathtaking, where your mission is to stay alive. You're a hero who has landed on a distant, hidden, and untouched huge island inhabited by dinosaurs. In this exciting dinosaur game, one of the best dinosaur games, kill the most ferocious animals in history and progress from a shy wildlife observer to a stealthy and ruthless T-Rex hunter.
Encounter ancient beasts long thought extinct, from the docile herbivorous: Wooly Mammoth, Archaeopteryx, Triceratops, Brachiosaurus, Apatosaurus (Brontosaurus), Ankylosaurus, Stegosaurus, and Parasaurolophus! to the terrifying Sabertooth, carnivorous: dinosaur king Tyrannosaurus (T. Rex), Velociraptor (Raptor), Carnotaurus, Spinosaurus, Mosasaurs, and Pterodactyl. All dinosaurs are rendered in full 3D with high-resolution textures, realistic Jurassic models, and terrifying roars!
In this survival simulator, embark on the primeval hunting expedition of a lifetime - there are 30+ levels with increasing difficulty, and load up on firepower with destructive weapons like the pistol, revolver, machine gun, assault rifle, and shotgun with increasing power. You’ll need a great arsenal and a proficient shooter strategy to kill these ruthless, bloodthirsty dinosaurs.
Primal Hunter: Shooting Game features:
• Huge 3D world open for exploration
• True-to-life hunting experience based on dynamic physics
• 3D animals, from the common Saber-tooth Tiger, Woolly Mammoth, to the primeval gigantic animal, Tyrannosaurus rex.
• Hunting weapons to be used for smart hunting
• HD graphics
• Easy control and Rhythmical game sounds
Primal Hunter: Shooting Game supports high resolution for an optimal gaming experience on both phones and tablets.

bluejetty:00070981:ios.summary:

A new adventure begins with Bibi.Pet; the watchwords are Expl
bluejetty:00070981:ios.description:
Big news from Bibi.Pet! - Starting today, one subscription unlocks this app, Bibi World, and all the other apps in the Bibi.Pet Explorer series. Start playing and discover more!
A new adventure begins with Bibi.Pet; the watchwords are Exploration and Fun!
This app is the first part of a new series of Bibi.Pet in which children can freely interact in the contexts and express their imagination creating stories that are always different.
The starting point is the Bibi.Pet house, where it’s possible to play in your own room with lots of toys, cook delicious snacks in the kitchen and take a refreshing shower in the bathroom. Then it’s off to the garden among the fruit trees, the vegetable garden and the tree house. 
You can use the tractor, the skateboard or repair the car in the garage.
Lots of other activities are waiting for you in this easy and fun game in which curiosity is stimulated through exploration and interaction with the various objects available.
And as always, Bibi.Pet will accompany you as you discover all the educational activities available.
Suitable for ages 2 to 5 and designed together with experts from the educational field.
The funny little animals that live there have particular shapes and speak their own special language: the Bibi’s language, which only children can understand.
Bibi.Pet are cute, friendly and scatterbrained, and can’t wait to play with all the family!
You can learn and have fun with them with colors, shapes, puzzles and logic games.
Features:
- 9 different contexts
- Cook your favorite dishes
- Have a bath and brush your teeth
- Play in your room with lots of toys
- Grow fruit and vegetables
- Drive the tractor
- Educational games for children over 2 years of age
- Lots of different games for learning while having fun
--- DESIGNED FOR LITTLE ONES --- 
- Absolutely no adverts 
- Designed to entertain children aged from 2 to 6, from little to big!
- Games with SIMPLE rules for children to play alone or with their parents. 
- Perfect for children at play school. 
- A host of entertaining sounds and interactive animation. 
- No need for reading skills, perfect also for pre-school or nursery children. 
- Characters created for boys and girls. 
--- TRANSPARENCY & SAFETY ---
Bibi.Pet takes your family's digital safety seriously. We are fully dedicated to protecting your children's data online by rigorously following the compliance standards set by COPPA (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Rule) and KidSAFE.
• Privacy policy: https://www.bibi.pet/privacy
• Terms of use: https://www.bibi.pet/terms_of_use
--- Bibi.Pet Who are we? --- 
We produce games for our children, and it is our passion. We produce tailor-made games, without invasive advertising by third parties. 
Some of our games have free trial versions, which means you can try them out first before purchases, supporting our team and enabling us to develop new games and keep all our apps up-to-date. 
We create a variety of games based on: colors and shapes, dressing up, dinosaur games for boys, games for girls, mini-games for smaller children and many other fun and educational games; you can try them all! 
Our thanks to all the families who show their trust in Bibi.Pet!

bluejetty:00131726:ios.name: Fishing Planet
bluejetty:00131726:ios.summary:
Fishing Planet® is a highly realistic first-person online multiplayer fishing simulator. Developed by avid fishing enthusiasts to bring you the full thrill of actual angling on your iPhone and iPad.
Free-to-Play on all platforms and just a
bluejetty:00131726:ios.description:
Fishing Planet® is a highly realistic first-person online multiplayer fishing simulator. Developed by avid fishing enthusiasts to bring you the full thrill of actual angling on your iPhone and iPad.
Free-to-Play on all platforms and just a download away!
Fishing Together with other players on the same boat. Our ocean fishing yachts can accommodate 2, 3, or 4 friends simultaneously.
Compete online with other players in events (tournaments) and competitions with personal scores, achievements, leader boards and top-players lists.
Highly realistic world of fishing on your screen:
■ 200+ species of fish with complex AI driven behavior depending on seasons, climate, time of day, water current, bottom type, water and air temperature, wind and more.
■ 26 scenic waterways with photorealistic graphics from all around the world with their own climate conditions, landscapes, bottom topography and vegetation. All waterways are based on real locations.
■ Freshwater and saltwater fishing with their own features for realistic and immersive experience.
■ Four types of fishing - float, spinning, bottom and saltwater trolling.
■ Thousands of tackle and lure combinations with unique physical and hydrodynamic properties provide realistic biting and striking reactions. Each fish species attacks and fights based on real-life behavior.
■ Dynamic weather – day/night alternation, change of seasons, different weather conditions (rain, fog, bright sunshine), storms on the ocean.
■ Dynamic water graphics that change depending on wind, current and depth. Splashes, waves and ripples on the water create a fully realistic fishing experience. Immersive environment sounds that enhance players' experience.
■ Rideable kayaks and 3 types of motor boats, each with unique speed, durability and other parameters and features.
■ Ocean fishing yachts come equipped with rod holders for trolling and fish storage for massive ocean catches. These yachts feature unique Fish Finder 360 technology to help locate fish in the vast ocean.
Join the ultimate fishing adventure with the Fishing Planet® game and experience the most realistic and immersive fishing simulator available!

bluejetty:00120708:ios.summary: The UWorld Medical app is the gold standard in medical exam preparation - delivering elite QBank content for USMLE® (Step 1, Step 2 CK, Step 3), COMLEX® (Level 1, Level 2), Medical Boards (ABIM®, ABFM®), PA exams (PANCE®, PANRE®), and NEET-
bluejetty:00120708:ios.description:
The UWorld Medical app is the gold standard in medical exam preparation - delivering elite QBank content for USMLE® (Step 1, Step 2 CK, Step 3), COMLEX® (Level 1, Level 2), Medical Boards (ABIM®, ABFM®), PA exams (PANCE®, PANRE®), and NEET-PG, all in one powerful, connected platform. 
Everything you need to pass, including practice questions, medical articles, flashcards, assessments, and analytics, all in one place and available anytime, anywhere. 
Why Choose UWorld?
 - All-in-one exam prep—QBank, medical library, flashcards, and analytics in one place 
 - Trusted by 5+ million medical students and clinicians worldwide 
 - Questions designed to match or exceed real exam difficulty 
 - Explanations that strengthen clinical reasoning and concept mastery 
Features include
 - Thousands of exam-level practice questions that match and often exceed real exam difficulty 
 - In-depth, clinically focused explanations for every question and answer choice to strengthen clinical reasoning, test-taking strategy, and concept mastery
 - Rich medical illustrations and visuals that simplify complex topics
 - Realistic clinical scenarios and case-based questions that mirror actual exam formats and improve diagnostic decision-making
 - An integrated medical library with curated, high-yield content for deeper understanding and long-term retention
 - Customizable practice tests by system, subject, rotation, or exam
 - Powerful active learning tools including smart flashcards, spaced repetition, and a digital notebook
 - Advanced performance analytics and insights to identify weak areas, track progress, and improve your scores
Supported Exams & Curriculum:
 USMLE® (Step 1, Step 2 CK, Step 3) – Medical students and residents (US)
 COMLEX® (Level 1, Level 2) – Osteopathic medical students (US)
 ABIM® – Internal Medicine Board Certification (US)
 ABFM® – Family Medicine Board Certification (US)
 PANCE® – Physician Assistant National Certifying Exam | PA students and graduates (US)
 PANRE® – Physician Assistant National ReCertifying Exam | Practicing PAs (US)
 Clinical Curriculum – Core rotations including Internal Medicine, Surgery, Pediatrics, and OB/GYN (Global)
 Coming Soon: NEET-PG – Postgraduate Medical Entrance Exam (India)
UWorld’s mission is to transform how medical students and clinicians learn, preparing you not just to pass your exam, but to practice with confidence. Built by a team of practicing physicians and clinical educators, every question reflects real-world scenarios you'll face on exam day, in residency, and throughout your career. More than 5 million medical students, residents, and healthcare professionals worldwide trust UWorld, making it the most widely used QBank for USMLE®, COMLEX®, ABIM®, ABFM®, PANCE®, PANRE®, and NEET-PG preparation. 
Your progress syncs seamlessly across devices so you can study anytime, anywhere. For the best experience, connect to Wi-Fi to download and access your QBank and study materials.
Study smarter. Retain more. Score higher.
Already have a UWorld subscription? Download the app and log in with your existing email and password.
Need help or have feedback? Contact us at support@uworld.com
Explore all exams and learning tools at https://medical.uworld.com/
Privacy Policy: https://www.uworld.com/privacy_policy.aspx

bluejetty:00039981:ios.description:
We are Trust, Singapore’s digital bank backed by a unique partnership between Standard Chartered, one of the world’s most trusted banks with more than 160 years experience in Singapore, and FairPrice Group, the nation’s leading grocery retailer for almost 50 years. With a combined heritage in driving prosperity and making life better, we want to add to the everyday life by building Trust with every person in Singapore.
GET STARTED
Open an account and get your digital card issued within minutes.
Apply easily for a Trust card using Myinfo to pre-fill your application.
GET THE FIRST CREDIT CARD IN SINGAPORE TO OFFER STOCKBACK
1 Freedom card. 4 reward choices. You decide!
Earn 3% Stockback, 1.3 Miles per S$1 locally and abroad, up to 1.5% Unlimited cashback, or up to 15% Bonus cashback when you spend. With Stockback, you can turn your everyday spends into fractional shares of US stocks and US ETFs.
MEET YOUR PERFECT TRAVEL COMPANION
Goodbye, FX fees. Hello, stress-free travels! Whether it’s shopping in Tokyo or on your favourite overseas websites, you’ll score the best rates from us. And we’re all about transparency too. We take Visa’s exchange rates and pass them on to you with no hidden markups. Start using Trust card today as your perfect travel companion wherever, whenever!
GET A NTUC LINK CREDIT CARD WITH UP TO 21% SAVINGS
With a minimum monthly spend, NTUC Union Members can enjoy up to 21% savings with the FairPrice Group. For everyone else, get up to 15% savings on your everyday needs.
ALSO SIGN UP FOR A SAVINGS ACCOUNT WITH HIGH INTEREST
Earn high interest rate on your deposit balance. Plus, enjoy savings on spend with Trust debit card. Insured up to S$100k by SDIC.
INVESTING MADE EASY AND SIMPLE
Build your wealth in Stocks, ETFs and Mutual Funds. Start with as little as US$10 for stocks & ETFs and S$100 for Mutual Funds. No custody, platform or settlement fees, and no sales charges for Mutual Funds. TrustInvest is an investment product and not a bank deposit. All investments involve risks and are not insured by the SDIC. This advertisement has not been reviewed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore.
GET INSTANT LOAN IN 60 SECONDS
Get your loan approved instantly within seconds with Credit Card and enjoy attractive interest rates.
A BETTER DIGITAL CARD EXPERIENCE
With just one tap, you can instantly switch between debit and credit to suit your spending needs. And with a numberless physical card (without the expiry date or CVV printed on the card), this reduces the risk of compromising your card.
GET REWARDS EVERY DAY
Earn Linkpoints on eligible card spend and unlock coupons and stamp cards at your favourite merchants. Our Trust App has a smart tracker too! You’ll know exactly where you are against your reward targets in real-time so you need never miss out on bonus rewards again.
SAFETY IS OUR TOP PRIORITY
Get instant transaction notifications. We also monitor transactions and online payments 24/7 to keep your account secure. Trust also offers strong encryption and biometric login – all to protect your account and personal information.
CUSTOMER SERVICE THAT PUTS YOU FIRST
We are available 24/7. Whenever you need help, reach out to us via the in-app chat or call.
You can also call us on 313-TRUST (313-87878).
Terms and conditions apply. For more information, visit trustbank.sg
PS, Users in India, Indonesia, Philippines, Thailand or any other countries where the Trust Bank app is not available will have to download our app from the Singapore app store or any other country app store where it is available.
_______________________________________________
Registered address: Trust Bank Singapore Limited - 77 ROBINSON ROAD #25-00 ROBINSON 77 068896

TeamSpeak is an advanced voice chat and communication app that enables groups of people to communicate and share information with each other via the internet or through pri
bluejetty:00119656:ios.description:
Voice Chat Communication used by Professional Gamers.
---------- 
TeamSpeak is an advanced voice chat and communication app that enables groups of people to communicate and share information with each other via the internet or through private networks, whether they are using smartphones or desktop PCs/Macs.
FEATURES:
● Ad & Spam Free
● Low data usage
● Minimal CPU Usage
● Advanced Permission Controls
● Offline/LAN functionality
● Use on public or your own private server
● Use Anonymously
● Synchronise your bookmarks across devices
● Push-To-Talk (PTT) and voice activation
● Connect to multiple servers & channels
● Send and receive group and direct messages
● Identity and contacts management
● See detailed channel and player information
● Get player status notifications
● Universal app for iPhone/iPod/iPad
The preferred voice chat solution for online gamers, friends and family and small businesses world-wide. TeamSpeak lets you chat with fellow team mates, discuss strategy in real-time, or facilitate online events.
TeamSpeak can be run on either your own private server where you can securely connect with and chat to your guild, clan or colleagues. Or jump on one of the many public servers and channels.
TeamSpeak3 for iOS is optimized to enhance your mobile device experience and keeps you connected with your peers while you're on-the-go. 
To communicate with other users using TeamSpeak, you must be connected to a TeamSpeak 3 server (directly connecting to users is not possible).
To view a list of public servers, download the TeamSpeak desktop client and choose Connections > Server List.
To join a private server, contact your clan/guild/group's administrator for the information you would need to connect.
Our team of developers are constantly working on improving the solution and to add new features to give you an even better experience.
If you find a specific bug or crash issue please let us know. In most cases our developers will find and squash bugs or fix crash issues quickly, especially if you can aid us with information regarding your hardware or environment, and how to reproduce the issue. You may even get a reward!

bluejetty:00021033:ios.name: Navy War: Submarine Simulator
bluejetty:00021033:ios.summary: Take the helm in Navy War, a naval combat game built around team battles. Command warships in a historical naval combat experience inspired by World War I and World War II. Choose a destroyer, cruiser, or heavy ship, coordinate fire with yo
bluejetty:00021033:ios.description:
Take the helm in Navy War, a naval combat game built around team battles. Command warships in a historical naval combat experience inspired by World War I and World War II. Choose a destroyer, cruiser, or heavy ship, coordinate fire with your squad, and fight across tropical, taiga, arctic, and desert waters.
JOIN MULTIPLAYER GAMES IN A 6X6 FLEET
Team up with five allies and enter a multiplayer games match against a rival squad. Use a multiplayer sea battle to pressure a flank, turn a fleet multiplayer attack into a naval multiplayer push. Each Team Deathmatch lasts 12 minutes, so call targets and earn points through damage and eliminations.
MASTER SHOOTING GAMES WITH NAVAL GUNS
Practice the lead in shooting games where artillery rewards timing and positioning. Turn naval shooting games into controlled engagements by tracking a target and adjusting aim for distance. Use naval gun games tactics, launch torpedoes, and win a sea gun battle through smoke.
LEAD ACTION GAMES FROM THE HELM
Take control of a ship and make naval action game decisions around speed, cover, and firing angles. Use a sea action game approach to steer between islands and force a fleet action. Scout, support, or hold a lane with heavy artillery.
WIN ONLINE GAMES AND CLIMB TOURNAMENTS
Enter online games with a goal and turn results into progress on regional and global tables. Combine a naval force attack with sea force support, choose a navy fleet route or an online fleet games route, and finish an online sea battle in online naval combat. Compete in clan leagues from Bronze through Diamond.
BUILD YOUR FLEET IN SIMULATION GAMES
Shape each vessel in simulation games focused on fleet combat and choices. Improve eight modules: caliber, loading, aiming, fire control, hull, emergency systems, engine, and steering. Use a naval simulation game routine to compare range and reload, tune a naval simulation build for speed, apply fleet simulation game planning, and test a sea simulation game build.
COMMAND YOUR FLEET AND CHOOSE A CLASS
Select from more than 80 ships across destroyer, cruiser, and heavy ship classes, then assign one captain to strengthen three parameters. Build a warship games lineup, test a warship battle approach, and keep a warship fleet ready for maps. Change speed, armor, reload, range, turret traverse, or resistance bonuses.
LOAD TORPEDOES, MINES, AND ROCKETS
Build a naval warfare loadout and use more than main guns to control the water. Turn naval war pressure into a flank attack, place mines to deny a route, and use sea warfare positioning to reveal an enemy course. Add rockets, sonar, countermeasures, nets, paravanes, buoys, and smoke.
CUSTOMIZE THE FLEET FOR THE FIGHT
Equip nearly 190 permanent camouflage patterns to improve damage absorption, around 150 decals to tighten shell grouping, and more than 180 flags to increase acceleration. Make a battleship games setup, choose a battleship war game role, and use battleship strength where the enemy needs to break through.
CROSS THE SEA AND CONTROL THE FLEET BATTLE
Move through eight maps set in tropical islands, taiga, arctic waters, and desert seas, with day and night versions that change visibility. Read a fleet battle, use a naval fleet battle formation, and turn a fleet clash into a fleet fight. Earn experience and unlock chat and clan access.
Choose your class, upgrade modules, and enter a 6x6 match where every maneuver creates an opening. Coordinate artillery, torpedoes, mines, rockets, sonar, and defenses, then adjust your captain or ship setup. Install Navy War and join a naval combat game built for direct control and competition.
Play for free, with optional in-app purchases.

bluejetty:00090419:ios.description:
BabyPage helps parents to complete baby books, pregnancy journals, and child memory books, quickly and easily. All too often, precious memories fade before you can document them and BabyPage wants to change that! 
Baby books – BabyPage helps you record each chapter of your child’s story with photos and personalized content. bluejetty:00188169:ios.description:
All praise due to Allah The lord of the universe and peace be upon Prophet Muhammad (Sm).
The ultimate success of Men is in Deen which has been established based on 5 basic elements.
1. Perfection of Eman
2. Performing all righteous deeds according to Sunnah
3. Earning sustenance in Halal way
4. Fulfil the right of parents and all the creations
5. Own self rectification (Tazkia)
And being the Ummati of the Final Messenger Muhammad (Sm) it is our special responsibility to do the work of DAWAH & Tablig.
To act on above mentioned duties we have to make effort in 3 ways:
1. Tablig (propagation of Deen)
2. Talim (learning and teaching)
3. Tazkia (rectification of own self)
Till date the effort of the Sahaba RA. has been carried out for the establishment of Deen through lectures, writings of Ulama. This App is our little contribution into that establishment.
To continue this all the Ulama e Haqqani make three types of efforts and they teach the people these three. Hence some put more emphasis in Tablig, some in Talim and some in Tazkia. The purpose of this App is to unite all three effort in one line.
Special App Features:
- Quran Text
- Quran Pdf
- Quran audio Mp3
- Sura Yasin
- Sura Ar Rahman
- Various quran tafsir
- Above 5000 Islamic Bangla Bayan
- Sahih Bukhari
- Sahih Muslim
- Other books of Sahih Hadith (bangla translation)
- Above 600 Islamic Books/Kitab (Bangla, Urdu, English)
- Books of Qawmi Madrasa
- Befaq Board Books
- Islamic Lecture
- Islamic articles
- Bangla waz mp3
- Bangla waz Olipuri
- Ijtema boyan
- Ijtema audio
- Bayan of Tablighi jamaat
- Chormonai waz

Não perca a chance de se tornar um viajante inteligente. Baixe o "Mundo com Milhas" agora e descubra como realizar suas viagens dos sonhos sem comprometer seu orçamento.

bluejetty:00127584:ios.description:
CIC BANQUE : COMPTE EN LIGNE, EPARGNE & ASSURANCES
Accédez à votre banque en ligne avec l’app CIC : compte bancaire, carte virtuelle, crédit, épargne, bourse… Recevez aussi nos notifications et alertes anti-fraude sur votre mobile.
Retrouvez tous nos produits et services bancaires : compte & carte ado, assurance, crédit immobilier, emprunt pour financer un achat auto ou vélo, prêt étudiant, assurance multirisque habitation, badge télépéage ou paiement Wero… Simulation directement sur l’appli.
Notre mission : vous conseiller pour gérer, épargner et investir votre argent. 
Découvrez Culture Fi’CIC pour parler argent et gestion de budget ou Homji, notre solution d’accompagnement travaux de rénovation énergétique
L’APP POUR GERER SON COMPTE ET SON BUDGET EN TOUTE SÉCURITÉ
Connectez-vous à votre espace client grâce à vos identifiants, ou par empreinte biométrique ou reconnaissance faciale.
- Accès gratuit à vos comptes en ligne CIC, RIB et IBAN
- Suivi de vos comptes bancaires et comptes épargne
- Catégorisation de vos dépenses et gestion de budget
- Envoi d’ordre de virements entre vos comptes ou vers vos bénéficiaires
- Ajout de bénéficiaire
- Simulation de crédit, prêt, épargne ou crédit conso pour connaitre nos meilleurs taux 
- Confirmation Mobile pour sécuriser un achat internet, un paiement en ligne ou un virement depuis l’app CIC
- Déplafonnement et mise en opposition de votre carte bancaire CIC
- Paiement mobile, Apple Pay et wero (service disponible via CIC Pay)
- Payweb Card CIC pour générer un numéro de carte bancaire virtuelle pour tout paiement internet ou achat en ligne
- Géolocalisation d’une agence CIC ou distributeur d’argent à proximité
- Contact et envoi sécurisé de documents confidentiels avec votre conseiller
- Activation de l’option « je voyage » lors de voyage à l’étranger
- Rubriques d’assistance : urgence, FAQ, assistant virtuel, ou recherche d’opération.
VOS PRODUITS ET SERVICES BANCAIRES SUR UNE SEULE APP
ASSURANCES CIC
- Consultation de vos documents et contrats d’assurance
- Simulation de devis d’assurance automobile, logement, vélo, trottinette, assurance retraite, santé…
- Déclaration et suivi de sinistres automobiles ou habitation
EPARGNE & GESTION DE PATRIMOINE
- Préparer un projet ou épargner grâce aux livrets CIC : livret d’épargne populaire, livret A, livret jeune, plan épargne logement, épargne salariale, assurance retraite, PEA-PME ou compte rémunéré… 
- Souscrire une assurance vie pour bénéficier d’une fiscalité avantageuse
PRÊT & CRÉDIT 
- Simuler un financement travaux, crédit immobilier, crédit auto, achat vélo électrique, prêt étudiant pour financer des études supérieures…
ASSURANCE SANTÉ & MUTUELLE
- Gestion des dépenses de santé et suivi du remboursement des soins
- Simulation des remboursements de certains actes médicaux
COMPTE BANCAIRE POUR ADO - 10-17 ans 
1 compte jeune - 1 carte bancaire - 1 application
Votre ado apprend à gérer son argent sous le contrôle des parents :
- Suivre son compte en temps réel
- créditer son compte par virement immédiat
- Être notifié à chaque opération débit ou crédit sur le compte
- Bloquer temporairement sa carte jeune
- Activer/désactiver certaines fonctionnalités (paiement internet, retrait et opération à l'étranger)
BOURSE & FINANCE
- Accès direct au cours de la bourse, actu trading et valeurs des actions du CAC40 pour bien investir
- Consultation de votre portefeuille de titres
- Envoi et suivi d’ordres sur les valeurs Euronext…
NOTRE ENGAGEMENT RELATIONS CLIENT
- Contact par messagerie sécurisée
- Prise de rendez-vous avec un conseiller (en visio, agence ou par téléphone)
- Notification des actualités CIC ou de votre agence
- Accès à l'annuaire des numéros utiles et coordonnées agence
Un problème technique ou fonctionnel ? Contactez-nous :
- par Mail : filbanque@cic.fr (préciser qu'il s'agit de l'app CIC iOS)
- par Téléphone : 09 69 39 00 22 (Appel non surtaxé)
Retrouvez-nous sur Facebook, X, Instagram, Linkedin ou Youtube.

Play #1 Classic Solitaire/Klondike Solitaire/Patience Game! Solitaire Arena 3 offers exciting, thrilling, and challenging matches with additional power-ups to maximize your chances at winning.

=================
Sick and tired of playing boring solitaire games with no pizzazz? Download Solitaire Arena 3, the #1 solitaire card game, featuring all-exciting tournaments, thrilling matches, and an extremely user-friendly interface. 
Solitaire Arena 3 plays just like classic solitaire games (Spider Solitaire and FreeCell), but with an upgraded twist of drawing 3 cards instead of 1. Play solitaire with friends or against real-time opponents from across the globe for the ultimate challenge.
Enjoy the game’s modern and crisp graphics, smooth transitions, and attractive power-ups for the ultimate game experience.

- Daily rewards

- One-on-one challenges
- Power-ups

- Hints: Use hints to help you strategize your way through any match.
- Unlimited Undos: Fix your last move with the game’s unlimited undo ability; undo as many times as you like until you’re satisfied.
- Magic: Reveal hidden cards and use them to your advantage.
DOWNLOAD Solitaire Arena 3 today!
Love the game? LIKE US on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Solitaire3Arena/

bluejetty:00184644:ios.description:
The TitanTV app for iOS is a free, online TV listings guide. The app is a streamlined version of the fully featured desktop site, TitanTV.com. 
The app provides easy access to channel lineups, listings and program information for broadcast, cable, satellite, and many popular over-the-top streaming services. Visitors who choose to become TitanTV members (Membership is free), may use the desktop version of TitanTV to create customized lineups that may also be viewed in the app. 
Take your TV listings with you on the TitanTV app. 
Features:
-Location-based tech determines where you are and provides lineups and listings specific to that location
-Schedule grid displays a customizable number of hours of programming in both Portrait and Landscape modes
-14 days of schedule and programming information are available 
-Press a channel's call sign column to view a 24-hour daily view of that channel's schedule 
-Press a program's grid cell to view its expanded episodic information, cast and crew, ratings, and other details
-Easily add other channel lineups to view listings from another programming source or a completely different location 
-Fully featured Search function
-Mark selected programs as a Favorite and future airings of it will be flagged in the grid
-Reminder functions create notifications about upcoming selected programs
This app is a free online television listing guide containing lineups and schedules for local broadcasters and any cable, satellite, or major streaming service you may subscribe to. It is not a mechanism for watching/streaming/recording programs through the app

bluejetty:00088336:ios.name: Soula: Women's Mental Health
bluejetty:00088336:ios.summary:
Soula is the AI companion made for women: she learns how you feel today — and brings what helps, in minutes.
No blank page, no searching, no "where do I even start." A 20-second check-in — and the right support is already in front of you:
bluejetty:00088336:ios.description:
Soula is the AI companion made for women: she learns how you feel today — and brings what helps, in minutes.
No blank page, no searching, no "where do I even start." A 20-second check-in — and the right support is already in front of you: one practice, one thought, one small thing that fits the day you're actually having.
WHAT IF I DON'T HAVE WORDS FOR IT? You don't need any. The check-in is taps, not essays — sleep, mood, emotions, body. Soula meets you where you are, even when all you've got is "I don't know. Everything."
WILL I HAVE TO REPEAT MY STORY? No. Soula remembers — what kept you up last week, how your cycle shapes your mood, what actually helped. You never start from zero. And some mornings, she reaches out first.
WHY WOMEN? Because most tools were built for "everyone" — which too often means not for you. Soula is built around how women actually carry stress: the mental load, the PMS days, the nights your brain won't shut off. Your cycle and how you feel are connected — Soula sees it.
IS THIS THERAPY? No — and we won't pretend it is. Soula offers support and understanding, not therapy or medical care, and she is not a replacement for a doctor or a licensed professional. If you're in crisis or thinking about harming yourself, please reach out to people trained for this, right now: in the US, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline).
You're not alone — today, and in every season.
Support: support@soula.care
Terms of Use: https://soula.care/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://soula.care/privacy-policy/
IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER
Soula is a self-care, mindfulness, and emotional wellness app intended for personal reflection and general wellbeing purposes only. Soula is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, therapy, or healthcare services of any kind.
The app is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, prevent, or manage any medical, psychological, or mental health condition. Any insights, conversations, reflections, recommendations, or wellness practices provided within the app are informational and supportive in nature only and should not be considered professional medical or psychological advice.
Soula is not a replacement for licensed healthcare professionals, mental health providers, therapists, psychologists, psychiatrists, or medical treatment. Users should always consult a qualified healthcare professional regarding any medical, psychological, emotional, or mental health concerns, diagnoses, or treatment decisions.
If you are experiencing a medical emergency, mental health crisis, severe emotional distress, suicidal thoughts, or any urgent health condition, contact emergency services or a licensed healthcare professional immediately.

bluejetty:00061513:ios.description:
Zoho Vault is a robust password manager designed to help you securely store, autofill, generate, share, and manage sensitive information—all from a single, encrypted vault. Access your confidential data anytime, anywhere, whether you're using an iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, or MacBook. 
Built entirely on the cloud, Zoho Vault seamlessly integrates with your existing apps for a smooth, secure experience. IT teams gain centralized visibility and control to prevent data breaches, ensure compliance, and implement zero-trust security. 
For over a decade, tens of thousands of businesses have trusted Zoho Vault as their password management solution for its simplicity, strong encryption, and affordability, making it a truly dependable choice for modern workplaces.
Zoho Vault for personal and business use cases
- Securely store and manage passwords and other sensitive information like bank details, documents, and more in an encrypted vault.
- Embrace passwordless authentication with advanced passkey compatibility.
- Generate strong, unique passwords instantly across all of your devices with the password and passphrase generator.
- Autofill usernames, passwords, addresses, payment details, and TOTP codes for quick logins.
- Autofill and auto login to websites on popular browsers, including Ulaa, Safari, Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Vivaldi, Brave, and Opera.
- Strengthen security by enforcing multi-factor authentication (MFA).
- Skip the master password and access your vault using biometrics, Zoho OneAuth, Windows Hello, TouchID, Passkey, and YubiKey.
- Ensure regulatory compliance with tamper-proof audit trails and detailed security reports.
- Keep your data safe with encrypted backups to email and cloud services like Google Drive, Dropbox, and OneDrive.
- Benefit from enhanced integrations with Zoho and third-party applications.
Advanced security features
- Implement the principle of least privilege with granular role-based access controls for secure sharing.
- Enforce strong password complexity and expiration rules through built-in password policies, ensuring continuous regulatory compliance.
- Gain real-time insights into your security posture with a security dashboard and proactive dark web monitoring to detect compromised credentials.
- Enhance security by restricting access based on IP address and geographical location.
- Empower developers with robust API and Command Line Interface (CLI) tools for custom integrations.
Best password manager for iOS
- Switch between personal and business accounts with multi-account support.
- Autofill details quickly and securely with Zoho Vault.
- Instantly search passwords and data via Apple Spotlight.
- Use Siri voice commands to manage passwords hands-free.
Security and compliance 
- Data is encrypted with AES-256 on your device before transmission—your master password is never stored, even by Zoho.
- Secured through regular third-party audits, white-hat testing, and internal security assessments.
- Built on our own tech stack and data centers to ensure your data remains private and exclusively yours.
- Fully aligned with GDPR, HIPAA, CCPA, and other global data protection standards.
Plans and pricing
Free: Sign up for our powerful free password manager app for iOS and enjoy unlimited storage and device access at no cost.
Standard: $1 USD/user/month and $10.80 USD/user/year
Professional: $5 USD/user/month and $54 USD/user/year
Enterprise: $8 USD/user/month and $86 USD/user/year
Flex: Customized, volume-based pricing
Subscription details
Pricing varies by region. Subscriptions are charged to iTunes and auto-renew unless canceled 24 hours prior. Manage auto-renewal in Account Settings. Secure your business with Zoho Vault password management solution, trusted by thousands. Download now!
For questions or feedback, email us at support@zohovault.com or support@eu.zohovault.com (for EU users).

bluejetty:00090689:ios.summary:
Your Fitness, Rewarded.
Deeply Intelligent. Truly Rewarding.
Plan workouts, log your training, and keep nutrition in one place with Workit. Build a gym or home routine around your goals, follow your program, and see your progress over time
bluejetty:00090689:ios.description:
Your Fitness, Rewarded.
Deeply Intelligent. Truly Rewarding.
Plan workouts, log your training, and keep nutrition in one place with Workit. Build a gym or home routine around your goals, follow your program, and see your progress over time.
A WORKOUT PLAN FOR YOUR ROUTINE
Create a personalized program around your goals, experience, equipment and training days. Preview upcoming exercises, follow demonstrations, and swap exercises when your routine needs a change.
SEE THE MUSCLES YOU WILL TRAIN
Your workout card highlights the muscles in the day's planned exercises. Open your program from the card, start your workout, or return to the active Workout Player. Rest days include an easy-walking suggestion.
LOG SETS, REPS AND WEIGHTS
Use the workout journal to record completed sets, repetitions and weights. Review saved sessions, recorded workout time, lifting volume and weekly recaps. Keep your training history close to your next workout.
WORKIT AI, READY TO HELP
Ask questions about training and nutrition, build or adjust a workout program, and get help logging meals. Review proposed changes before applying them.
CALORIES, MACROS AND MEALS
Track calories, protein, carbohydrates, fat and water. Describe your meal or add a food photo for a nutrition estimate, then review the draft before saving. Manual entry and the recipe catalog are also available.
ACTIVITY AND APPLE HEALTH
Connect Apple Health to see available steps, active energy, sleep and heart-rate readings alongside your training. Explore 7-day and 30-day views of your recorded activity. Health features depend on available data and permissions; heart-rate measurements require a compatible source.
IPHONE AND APPLE WATCH
Log workouts on iPhone or follow them from your wrist with the Workit Apple Watch app. Keep completed workouts and your training journal connected.
REWARDS AND CHALLENGES
Explore fitness challenges and rewards for eligible activity. Availability, eligibility and reward terms are shown in the app.
A subscription is required to use Workit. AI nutrition values are estimates for you to review. Workit provides general fitness and wellness guidance, not medical diagnosis or treatment.
Terms and Conditions: https://workit.fitness/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://workit.fitness/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00120548:ios.name: Calculator SC-323PU
bluejetty:00120548:ios.summary: The SC-323PU is a multi functional calculator. It is designed in a way, that it simulates the visual and operational aspects of a true pocket calculator, such that the user will be immediately familiar with its interface. A complete operati
bluejetty:00120548:ios.description:
The SC-323PU is a multi functional calculator. It is designed in a way, that it simulates the visual and operational aspects of a true pocket calculator, such that the user will be immediately familiar with its interface. A complete operation manual is included within the App.
The SC-323PU offers the following calculator modes for different tasks:
- SCIENTIFIC CALCULATOR
- UNIT CONVERTER and UNIT CALCULATOR
- LOGIC CALCULATOR (n-base conversion)
• Full operating instructions are included in the App (visible when device is in landscape orientation).
• All modes share the same memory contents, and calculation value, so that the different calculator modes can be used in one calculation task.
• Pasteboard support (copy and paste)
• Algebraic logic for calculation entry.
• Priority of calculations according to a given mathematical formula.
• 30 levels of parentheses or pending operations.
• Variables and memories to store values and use in calculations.
• Floating decimal point calculations with 20 digits mantissa and 2 digits exponent.
• Calculations: Four arithmetic calculations, constant calculation, memory calculations, trigonometric and inverse trigonometric functions, hyperbolic and inverse hyperbolic functions, conversion of angles and time, reciprocals, square roots and cubic roots, X-th roots of Y, squares and powers, logarithmic and exponential functions, factorials, permutations, combinations, conversions of coordinates.
• AER (Algebraic Expression Reserve) for repetitive calculations of expressions and formulas.
• Complex number calculations.
• Different display modes selectable: floating point decimal, fixed point decimal, scientific notation and engineering notation.
• DEG/RAD/GRAD selector key.
• Fraction calculations.
• Time calculations.
• Frame rate calculations.
• 47 physical constants.
• Unit converter and currency converter.
• Calculations with mixed units.
• The calculator is shipped with 84 physical units and 16 SI prefixes predefined.
• Exchange rate of currency units will be updated automatically from internet.
• Additional units can be defined by user.
• Single and two lines view modes optimized for different conversion tasks.
• Conversions between 4 base systems HEX, DEC, OCT, BIN.
• Boolean operations AND, OR, XOR, NOT, bit shift operations.
• Conversion from “little endian” to “big endian” format and vice versa.
• Handling of 8, 16, 32 and 64 bit signed and unsigned numbers including overflow calculations.
Also on your Apple Watch! You can do basic calculations, tip calculations, unit and currency conversions and even scientific calculations directly on your wrist. Designed with large keys for best usability on the small screen.

bluejetty:00042214:ios.description:
SacRT Flex is your go-to app for getting around Sacramento. 
How it works:
-Enter your pickup and dropoff locations and we’ll tell you if there’s a trip available at that time. 
-Book SacRT Flex rides directly in the app or by phone for you and any additional passengers
-Easily book trips to and from to popular fixed route stop locations, or other Points of Interest
-Never miss your ride with live arrival times for your bus and ride tracking for your on demand journey.
-There may be others on board, or you may make a few additional stops along the way! 
What we’re about:
- SHARED: Our algorithm helps you see the best public transit journey available at that time. In the SacRT Flex service, you’ll be matched with others headed in the same direction. This combines convenience and comfort with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a shared ride. Transit at its best.
- ACCESSIBLE: All vehicles are wheelchair-equipped so you will always be matched with a vehicle that fits your needs.
- SUSTAINABLE: Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make Sacramento a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating.

bluejetty:00065922:ios.description:
Garnering Critical Acclaim from Around the World!
Dark Summoner, a Dark Fantasy Social Game Gem!
Downloaded over 9 million times worldwide!
Overwhelming Quality Recognized Around the Globe!
***********************************************************
【Game Introduction】
Bring about an end to the war that's plunged the world into chaos!
Summon powerful Rare Monsters and power them up to be mighty warriors for your cause.
Form Clans with your friends and aim for the top rank!
■Featuring artwork by many famous Japanese and international artists!
A large number of artists from Japan and other countries have contributed to the game.
Gorgeous illustrations and intense CG movies deepen the game experience.
■Features over 5,000 Monsters!
Featuring more than 5,000 types of monsters designed by famous artists!
Monsters are frequently added! Get them all to complete your collection!
■Power up your monsters!
Make sacrifices to the monsters you've collected to create the strongest team.
Raise epic monsters and become the best!
■Team up with friends to defeat legendary Dark Lord Raid Bosses!
Summon legendary Dark Lords using items gathered from completing missions.
Cooperate with friends to defeat the Dark Lords and their unbelievable power!
Defeated Dark Lords will join your team!
■Form Clans with your friends!
In the newly implemented Clan System,
create and develop Clans with your friends to gain bonuses!
Battle against your Clan mates in future in-game events!
Secure your spot in history alongside your friends!
■Craft Relica that can influence the outcome of Battle!
Monsters aren't the only vital part of Battles!
Gather Magic Crystals to Craft powerful Items,
and equip them to boost your stats!
There are endless combinations! Find the one that suits your play style!
■Only have a few minutes free? That's OK!
The game is playable even if you only have a few minutes to spare.
Play at your own pace -- on the train to work or school, before bed, whatever fits your lifestyle!
■New free events and updates added monthly!
New events and content are added to the game each month.
Dark Summoner is constantly evolving!
***********************************************************
※This game is playable on iOS 15.0 and higher.
※The game may not run if your device's time and date settings are not correct.
※The game's initial load time may take a few minutes in areas with a weak network connection.
In such cases, please wait for the load to complete and do not close the application.
※A Wi-Fi connection is recommended for the optimal Dark Summoner experience.

• Monthly or annual subscription available.

• You may not cancel the current subscription during the active subscription period.
