bluejetty:00136876:ios.description:
Recommended by CNN and Lonely Planet, this is Hong Kong's best subway map! Up-to-date with all the metro lines; Works offline; Routeplanner, GPS, Street maps; English and Chinese included.
Download the app completely free! The free app is ad-supported. Upgrade to VIP features if you'd like to get extra features, remove ads and support future development!
WHY EXPLOREMETRO?
1. Fully up-to-date
Accurate metro map, includes every station on every line. Free updates for future station openings and timetable changes.
2. Designed for iPhone
Our gorgeous maps have been fully redesigned for all iPhone devices. Runs on all iOS11-14 devices.
3. Designed for iPad 
Specially redesigned interface for the larger iPad screen with split screen. Drag and drop station names, tips, maps and timetables into other apps.
4. Street maps for every station 
Need to get your bearings at a station? Integrated Street maps show you metro exits and nearby streets for every station.
5. Route-planner 
A really easy route-planner. Get route and time information for any journey with just three taps.
6. "Find my nearest station" 
Using your GPS, see a list of the closest metro stations to your current location.
7. Works offline 
Everything works without an Internet connection. Search stations and plan routes on the go.
UPGRADE TO VIP FOR EVEN MORE FEATURES
I've been developing this app for 10 years. Upgrading to VIP helps support future development of the app. VIP users get additional features, like NO ADS, accurate prices for every journey, first/last train times, offline street maps, tips at every station, and a general warm fuzzy feeling.
REVIEWS
CNN Travel: "These maps are very easy on the eye and simple to navigate. They work offline and also include free updates of stations that have yet to be completed, operating hours and schedules." 
Lonely Planet: "Easy to use, up to date and work offline. Very handy, especially when they've run out of paper maps at the stations."
SUGGESTIONS
We'd love to hear your comments and suggestions on ways to improve the app. Please contact us via support@exploremetro.com, as we can't respond to comments left in the reviews

• Interactive map with nearby registry information
• Access publicly available government registry data
• View available profile details and location information
• Save recent searches for quick access

• Search history is stored only on your device.
• We do not sell or share your personal information.

• Subscription required to unlock premium features
Help make informed decisions for yourself and your family by accessing publicly available registry information in one convenient place.

bluejetty:00133515:ios.description:
◆Game Features
-SAVOUR VISUALS
The game features an ink wash painting visual style. All Ninja realm’s landscapes are full of vitality. Immerse yourself in this ink world and enjoy a lingering refreshing sense of combat. 
-UNRAVEL THE MYSTERIES
Ninja, Samurai, Oni, and the upheavals intertwine behind a deep intrigue. As a young Ninja, you shoulder the responsibility to take on the bosses and solve the puzzles to reveal the truth of Ninja Realm.
-CHALLENGE THE IMPOSSIBLE
Push yourself to the limits throughout whimsical stages;
Fight against Bosses with unique Ninjutsu;
Confront challenges together with skillful Ninjas and ignite your passion;
Equip Weapons and Relics to strengthen yourself； 
Enjoy the most tactic multiplayer combat running experience ever.
-RUN WITH FRIENDS 
Ninja Realm is one full of love and warmth;
Run alongside bunches of like-minded friends and help each other out;
Join with clan members against Bosses to reap abundant rewards;
Become a sophisticated mentor and help your apprentices better survive in Ninja Realm.
◆Background Story
300 years ago, Oni from the Oni Domain opened the Rasho Gate and invaded this land. In the blink of an eye, the earth collapsed, and the people of this land plummeted into the abyss.
To rebuild the people's homes and restore peace and order, two heroes built the country - The land of Sunbreak. One of them became the Supreme Ruler of this new land and is known as the Samurai Daimyo, whereas the other went on to protect this country in the shadows and has retreated out of the public eye ever since.
As for now, the Samurai, the ruling class, had for years fallen into the decadence of their greed for power. Scared of the mighty power of Ninjas, they schemed to bring the Land of Sunbreak to the brink of war. Even the Oni sealed hundreds of years ago are now ready to make nasty troubles...
As a young Ninja, you will witness the centuries-old feud between the Ninjas and the Samurai, confront the mysterious Onis in the dark, meet a rebellious genius ninja in an infinite spiral of destiny, and uncover the suspense and conspiracy by your own hands...
The new era of blood and fire is coming soon, is your ninja spirit ready to burn？

bluejetty:00115785:ios.description:
* Welcome to Cozy Girl Life: Coloring Book *
Step into a calm, cute, and zen world of relaxing games, digital art, and self-expression. Cozy Girl Life: Coloring Book is a comfy coloring book for adults and teens where every tap brings color therapy, stress relief, and soft aesthetic vibes.
This calming drawing app invites you to explore the quiet, cozy life of a creative girl. Whether you're enjoying comfy days at home or dreaming of peaceful lifestyle moments, each coloring page offers a unique escape filled with cute details, zen flow, and mindful energy.
* Why Cozy Girl Life is more than just a coloring app: *
- # Relaxing and aesthetic drawings # - Color bedrooms, cafes, hobbies, and cozy scenes 
- # Designed for stress relief and color therapy # - Embrace calm through cute, thoughtful art 
- # Simple tools for all skill levels # - Whether you're a beginner or into digital art 
- # 100% hand-drawn # - No AI, just authentic cozy creativity 
- # Flexible options # - Choose from palettes, gradients, and custom colors 
- # CozyHub community # - Share your vibe, connect, and enjoy happy coloring 
Inside this relaxing game, you'll discover coloring pages built for comfort, creativity, and calm. From comfy bedrooms to soft outdoor adventures, each image is made for slow, joyful coloring. The clean outlines and cozy aesthetic make this not just a simple coloring book, but a relaxing and inspiring digital space.
Use it daily for stress relief, mindfulness, and self-care. This cute drawing app was built to support color therapy and a calm lifestyle. It’s ideal for fans of relaxing games, aesthetic games, and cozy moments. The experience feels like journaling with color — and every page brings more zen.
Whether you’re into coloring games for adults, simple coloring books, or just looking for a calm app to brighten your day, Cozy Girl Life offers comfort through creativity. It blends girl games energy with peaceful vibes and comfy coloring book style.
As a cozy and creative drawing game, it's not just about colors — it's about finding joy in small routines. Add it to your wellbeing toolkit, and return to it anytime you want a calm, safe space to unwind and focus. Coloring can be a form of gentle reflection, perfect for anyone seeking emotional balance and inner peace.
* Connect through CozyHub *
Post your finished drawings in CozyHub, get inspired by others’ cozy art, and be part of a kind, cute community. Share your favorite aesthetic, your color palette, or just your mood — CozyHub is built around happy coloring, digital warmth, and gentle support.
* Features to love: *
- Soft and aesthetic drawings with cute lifestyle moments 
- Ideal for stress relief, color therapy, and relaxing games 
- Many cozy scenes for comfy days and peaceful dreams 
- Simple interface for coloring for adults, teens, and calm souls 
- Great for mindful routines, happy coloring, and a little zen every day 
Whether you’re relaxing at home, sipping a coffee, or winding down after a long day — Cozy Girl Life: Coloring Book invites you to pause, breathe, and color your world.

"I've been in law enforcement for 20 years and I have found a lot of apps that helped me do my job. However this one surpasses them all. Best law enforcement app yet." - NC Police Officer
"Top 15 Mobile & Tablet Police Apps" - CriminalJust
bluejetty:00177363:ios.description:
"I've been in law enforcement for 20 years and I have found a lot of apps that helped me do my job. However this one surpasses them all. Best law enforcement app yet." - NC Police Officer
"Top 15 Mobile & Tablet Police Apps" - CriminalJusticePursuit
Free 10-21 app users can:
- Call citizens from local numbers
- Receive and respond to callback requests
- Direct citizens to dispatch for immediate assistance
10-21 Police Phone Professional subscribers can:
- Set your outbound caller ID to "LAW ENFORCEMENT"
- View the citizen's caller ID in callback requests
- Send an automatic follow up message via SMS
- Retain call records for the life of your subscription
10-21 (radio code for "make a phone call") is a Police App for making free* calls to citizens that GET ANSWERED. Calls are made from local (not blocked) numbers without revealing your personal number. Stop getting sent to voicemail!
For example, if you call a citizen in Miami area code (305), they will receive an incoming call from a local (305) number, regardless of where you are. They are more likely to answer that call on your first try.
If the citizen calls back, rather than bugging you off-duty, they will be prompted to "Press 1 to Request a Call Back" (via Push Notification) or "Press 0 to Reach a Dispatcher" (connects to a non-emergency number that you provide).
When citizens request a call back, you receive a Push Notification on your phone rather than a phone call. At your convenience, simply tap the notification to initiate a call back out to the citizen.
*Calls are made over a VoIP data connection and do not use your cellular minutes. While the data used is minimal, data usage fees from your provider may apply.
Terms of Use: https://app.10-21.com/terms/phone

If the citizen calls back, rather than bugging you off-duty, they will be prompted to "Press 1 to Request a Call Back" (via Push Notification) or "Press 0 to Reach a Dispatcher" (connects to a non-emergency number that you provide).

When citizens request a call back, you receive a Push Notification on your phone rather than a phone call. At your convenience, simply tap the notification to initiate a call back out to the citizen.

*Calls are made over a VoIP data connection and do not use your cellular minutes. While the data used is minimal, data usage fees from your provider may apply.

bluejetty:00187956:ios.description:
The Business Digital Mobile Connect app turns your smartphone into a seamless extension of your Verizon Business Digital Voice office phone by allowing you to make and receive calls from your business telephone number. • Display your business telephone number on outbound calls made from the app. 
• Take in-progress calls from desktop phone to app.

• Manage call features, such as call forwarding and business continuity. 
• Initiate My Room conferencing and chat sessions (Premium users only). 
Download the Business Digital Mobile Connect app, and stay in touch with your business when you’re on the go.

bluejetty:00016412:ios.description:
Get the latest Florida lottery results within minutes of the draws taking place. This easy-to-use app includes the following lotteries:
Florida Lotto (including Lotto Double Play)
Powerball (including Powerball Double Play)
Mega Millions
Fantasy 5 (Midday and Evening)
Cash Pop
Jackpot Triple Play
Pick 2 (Midday and Evening)
Pick 3 (Midday and Evening)
Pick 4 (Midday and Evening)
Pick 5 (Midday and Evening)
Florida Lotto, Lotto Double Play, Powerball, Powerball Double Play, Mega Millions, Fantasy 5, Cash Pop, Jackpot Triple Play, Pick 2, Pick 3, Pick 4 and Pick 5 also include a full breakdown displaying the number of winners and amount paid out for each prize level.
The following features are also included:
Ticket Checker
----------------------------
Enter and save your chosen numbers to see if you have won or to see how often they have come up in the past. You can also label your tickets – great if you play multiple lines or if you run a syndicate. The ticket checker also highlights prizes won on each ticket as well as calculating the total for each lottery. Only play lotteries on certain days of the week? Not a problem, you can exclude your checked tickets from draws you do not play.
Customizable Notifications
----------------------------
Get notified instantly when the latest lottery results and prize breakdowns become available. The App allows you to customise notifications for specific lottery games and you can also choose which days of the week you play. Want to know when the jackpot has rolled over or has reached a certain amount? Just head to the Notification section of the app to set up your alerts. There is also the option to set notifications at times that suit you - great for reminding you to purchase tickets before the draw.
Random Number Generator
-----------------------------
Stuck for numbers? Use this handy tool and let the app choose your numbers rather than having to rely on house numbers and anniversary dates!
Results Archive
----------------------------
Access to the full archive of results dating back to the first draw of each lottery.
Settings
----------------------------
Customise which lotteries display in the app and in which order.
Support
----------------------------
If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve this app, please get in touch at contact@lottery.net.

-----------------------------
Stuck for numbers? Use this handy tool and let the app choose your numbers rather than having to rely on house numbers and anniversary dates!


Results Archive
----------------------------
Access to the full archive of results dating back to the first draw of each lottery.


Settings
----------------------------
Customise which lotteries display in the app and in which order.

----------------------------
If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve this app, please get in touch at contact@lottery.net.

bluejetty:00179128:ios.description:
Plan a better aquarium before you buy a single fish.
My Aquarium Guide helps you check compatibility, avoid overcrowding, and find fish that actually fit your tank.
Trusted by aquarists with 14K App Store ratings, My Aquarium Guide makes it easier to start your first tank or improve the one you already have.
What you can do in the app:
- Build a freshwater or saltwater tank
- Get starter fish suggestions for your first setup
- Catch compatibility and stocking issues early
- Browse 1,000+ fish profiles with care details
- See fish info like temperament, size, diet, pH, temperature, tank region, and origin
- Use your camera or a saved photo to see likely fish matches
- Save tanks, update fish counts, and share your setup
- Unlock more fish, plants, and additional tanks with Pro
How it works:
1. Create your tank and choose the size
2. Add fish or start with a suggested setup
3. Review warnings before you buy and keep refining your aquarium
Whether you're planning your first freshwater tank or exploring a saltwater setup, My Aquarium Guide helps you make more confident fishkeeping decisions with less guesswork.
Download My Aquarium Guide and plan your aquarium with more confidence.

Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Current subscription may not be cancelled during the active subscription period. You can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your account settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00175855:ios.description:
Device Tracker – Bluetooth Finder & AirPods Locator
Lost your AirPods, Apple Watch, headphones, or another Bluetooth device? Device Tracker helps you find them fast.
Device Tracker is a powerful Bluetooth Finder and BLE Scanner designed to help you locate nearby Bluetooth devices using real-time signal strength. Whether your device is hidden under a couch, left in your car, or misplaced somewhere nearby, Device Tracker guides you to it quickly and easily.
No complicated setup. No technical knowledge required.
Features
• Find nearby Bluetooth devices in seconds
• Real-time Bluetooth signal strength tracking
• Smart device locator and proximity radar
• Fast Bluetooth device detection
• Simple and intuitive interface
• Supports most Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices
Find Devices Such As
• AirPods, AirPods Pro, and AirPods Max
• Apple Watch
• Apple Pencil
• iPhone and iPad
• Beats headphones and earbuds
• Fitbit devices
• Bluetooth speakers
• Wireless headphones and earbuds
• Tile trackers
• Most BLE-enabled devices
How Device Tracker Works
1. Open the app and allow Bluetooth access
2. Scan for nearby devices
3. Select the device you’re trying to find
4. Follow the live signal strength indicator
5. Move toward the strongest signal
As you get closer to the device, the signal becomes stronger, helping you locate it faster.
Perfect For
• Finding lost AirPods
• Locating misplaced Bluetooth headphones
• Tracking nearby Bluetooth devices
• Finding your Apple Watch around the house
• Detecting Bluetooth trackers and accessories
• Locating wireless earbuds and speakers
Tips for Better Results
• Ensure the device is powered on
• Bluetooth must be enabled on the device
• Move slowly while monitoring signal strength
• Remove AirPods from the charging case when searching
• Search within Bluetooth range for best results
Bluetooth Range
Device Tracker can detect Bluetooth devices within approximately 330 feet (100 meters) under ideal conditions. Walls, furniture, and other obstacles may reduce the effective range.
Important Information
Device Tracker locates devices by detecting their Bluetooth signal. The device must be powered on, actively broadcasting Bluetooth, and within detectable range.
Need Help?
Questions or feedback?
Contact us at:
sandya.leelarathne@gmail.com
We’re happy to help.
Subscription Information
Enjoy a free trial and unlock all premium features.
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID account upon purchase confirmation
• Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current billing period ends
• Manage subscriptions and disable auto-renewal in Apple ID Account Settings
• Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited when a subscription is purchased
Available Plans
• Monthly Subscription
• Annual Subscription (Best Value)
Privacy Policy: https://paddyviewfoundry.com/devicetracker/privacy
Terms of Use: https://paddyviewfoundry.com/devicetracker/terms

bluejetty:00040521:ios.description:
Sticky Password helps you log in instantly and stay protected from breaches, phishing, and infostealers - without trade-offs. Your data is encrypted on your device first, and you choose how (and if) it syncs: secure cloud or local Wi-Fi (no cloud). Only you can unlock it.
What you can store securely
* Passwords + passkeys
* Payment cards
* Secure notes (IDs, licenses, recovery codes)
* Shared logins for family and teams
Features:
PASSWORD MANAGER & AUTOFILL
* Create and use passkeys for instant and safe sign-ins.
* Save and autofill passwords so you don't have to remember them.
* Unlock with one Master Password, biometrics, or PIN.
* Enhanced two-factor authentication.
* Offline access to your vault.
* Autofill in browsers and supported apps.
CONTACTLESS CONNECT
Log in securely on any browser or platform without installing Sticky Password there and without typing your Master Password. Your smartphone becomes the Authenticator for passwords, so you can get instant access to your accounts wherever you work.
SYNCHRONIZATION & BACKUP
* Sync across devices when you want to.
* Choose secure cloud sync or local Wi-Fi sync (no cloud) - you stay in control.
DARK WEB AND BREACH MONITORING
* Detect leaks early with dark-web scans.
* Alerts when a service you use has been reported breached.
* Get notified if your credentials appear in breach databases.
SECURE SHARING
* Share passwords safely with family or colleagues.
PASSWORD GENERATOR
* Create strong, unique passwords instantly.
* Identify weak, old, or reused passwords.
DIGITAL WALLET
* Store payment cards securely in your encrypted vault.
SECURE NOTES
* Store passports, IDs, licenses, and more.
* Access secure notes across mobile, tablet, and desktop.
Why Sticky Password?
* Trusted for over 20 years.
* Used by over 2 million people.
* Partnerships and deployments with industry leaders.
* Your privacy comes first: local encryption before syncing.
Sticky Password is always free for one device.
Go Premium to protect everything across all your devices* Cloud sync & backup.
* Local Wi-Fi sync.
* Secure password sharing.
* Priority support.
* Lifetime (perpetual) license option available.
Plus, every Premium license helps support the non-profit Save the Manatee Club.
Supported languages
* English
* German
* French
* Czech
* Russian
* Japanese
* Ukrainian
* Dutch
* Brazilian Portuguese
* Spanish
* Polish
* Italian
Important links
* Homepage: https://www.stickypassword.com/
* Support: https://www.stickypassword.com/help
* Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/stickypassword
* Twitter: https://twitter.com/stickypassword

bluejetty:00186335:ios.description:
Peech – Turn Anything Into Audiobooks!
Meet Peech, your personal AI-powered reading sidekick that transforms all your text - PDFs, web articles, physical books, and more - into crystal-clear audiobooks. Whether you’re racing through study notes, catching up on blog posts, or diving into that spicy new novel, Peech has you covered.
The Magic of AI Voices
 • Smart Voice Matching: Peech’s advanced AI picks the perfect voice for each genre - whether it’s serious academic reading or a lighthearted romance.
 • Natural & Lifelike: Our voices are so real, you might forget you’re listening to an app.
 • World-Class Voice Library: Pick from a wide, diverse range of premium voices — different accents, tones and reading styles to match any text.
Effortless Content Scanning
 • Lightning-Fast OCR: Snap a pic of any page or book, and Peech instantly converts it to audio. No more manual typing!
 • Web & PDF Parsing: Just paste a link or upload a file to start listening - perfect for busy pros, students, and anyone who prefers ears over eyes.
 • Your E-Book Library: Bring in books from popular e-book apps and stores, and listen to them hands-free.
Speedy Reading, On-the-Go
 • High-Speed Playback: Devour your favorite content up to 5x faster - perfect for power-learners or those who want to binge-listen on the run.
 • Playlists & Autoplay: Build custom playlists to keep the stories rolling, so you can multitask like a boss.
One App, All Languages
 • Automatic Language Detection: Peech seamlessly identifies and narrates in 60+ languages.
 • Global Accessibility: Great for language learners, busy professionals, and anyone with reading challenges.
Why Peech?
 • Students: Turn textbooks into engaging audio lectures - study smarter, not harder.
 • Busy Professionals: Catch up on news, memos, or trade articles during your commute.
 • Accessibility: An empowering reading solution for users with visual or reading impairments.
 • Content Lovers: From classics to your favorite steamy novels - Peech reads it all.
Free Trials & Subscriptions
Experience Peech with our flexible subscription plans, some offering free trials. Dive into unlimited content and see how Peech revolutionizes your reading routine - no commitment, no hassle.
Ready to transform your reading life? Give Peech a try and unlock the power of AI-driven audio today!

bluejetty:00137032:ios.name: EventLive－Live Stream Event
bluejetty:00137032:ios.summary:
Share your event with anyone who can’t attend physically. EventLive will bring your event to your guests, family and friends. It is as easy as recording a video on your iPhone.
Your guests don’t have to download our app, register, or sign
bluejetty:00137032:ios.description:
Share your event with anyone who can’t attend physically. EventLive will bring your event to your guests, family and friends. It is as easy as recording a video on your iPhone.
Your guests don’t have to download our app, register, or sign in to watch. 
Unlike other streaming platforms, EventLive allows you to pause and resume your event as many times as you want. You can use it to livestream the entire day including getting ready, processional, ceremony, cocktail hour, first dances, speeches, and even the entire reception.
Invite unlimited guests and they will be notified when you go live. Your family and friends won’t miss it!
You can invite them by sharing a link on a private message, email, or by typing their email address inside the app. Whatever is easiest for you and your guests.
If live streaming your wedding isn’t enough, the video will also be saved automatically to your device: iPhone or iPad. You can watch the replay for an entire year. We will store a version of your video on our servers: your memories are safe with us.
Afraid of going live? You can do this. It is as easy as opening the app and tapping Record to go live.
As traveling might still be difficult, you need to use a reliable platform to stream your important event in gorgeous, HD quality. EventLive is the right platform for you.
• TEST LIVE STREAMING FOR FREE
Try the app before the big day for free. If you aren’t sure how our app works, you can download and test EventLive now for FREE. Testing also helps you plan ahead of your wedding day and assign a person that can operate the app for you. Test as many times as you want to make sure everything is going well on your special day!
• CHOOSE WHO CAN ATTEND
Unlike social platforms such as Facebook and Instagram, you can choose exactly who sees your private live stream by sending them a simple private link via text, email, WhatsApp or carrier pigeon, the choice is yours!
• HD QUALITY LIVE STREAM
Enjoy the highest quality video and sound in your live stream way beyond what free services provide.
• SAFE AND PRIVATE
No intrusions, nobody ruining your event, and no ads. You don’t have to worry about safety, privacy issues, and other security issues that are plaguing social networks and meeting platforms.
• YOUR VIDEO IS SAFE
Your event will be saved on our server so you can rewatch it again. Your guests who are “late” to the event or can’t connect to the live stream can also access the recording on our server to watch it. You can enjoy the recording for years to come! 
• STORED ON YOUR PHONE
A top-quality video will also save to your phone, so you can watch it, share it and post it over and over again.
• REMINDERS FOR YOUR GUESTS
Make sure your guests will attend your special event! We send out email reminders to them before and when your event starts.
• QUICK AND EASY TO SET UP
Don’t let us distract you from planning your perfect day. You don't have to organize and remind people to join. Set everything up fast and easily.
• GO LIVE THROUGHOUT THE WEDDING DAY
Pause and resume your live stream to show the ceremony, cocktail, and reception. Feel free to pause the live stream as many times as you wish. We will notify your viewers!
• TRY EVENTLIVE AT YOUR VENUE
You can do a test run at your wedding venue to verify that the internet connection is working properly.
BY UNLOCKING YOUR EVENT, YOU’LL GET:
- Unlimited viewers and devices
- Automatic reminders: nobody will miss your event
- Guestbook
- Livestream video is saved online for 1 year
- High-resolution streaming
- Stream up to 24 hours
- Setup and share the link in advance
- No advertisements
Livestreaming your event has never been so easy!

• Track your location using GPS & share it with your broker representative or shipper via FourKites portal
• Upload BOL, POD, Invoice, Scale Tickets and Lumper receipts to initiate the payment process
CarrierLink - Take the new road to smarter communication for logistics and supply chain!

bluejetty:00119075:ios.description:
A Bíblia Sagrada foi originalmente traduzida por João Ferreira de Almeida.
Este é um aplicativo gratuito que permite visualizar toda a sabedoria da Bíblia com apenas alguns cliques e sem a necessidade de conectar-se à Internet e pesquisar por livros ou por testamentos. A Bíblia Sagrada tem todos os capítulos do Antigo Testamento e do Novo Testamento. A tradução utilizada por pessoas de língua portuguesa, versão Bíblia Sagrada foi originalmente traduzida por João Ferreira de Almeida.
 Totalmente Offline (funciona sem internet)
- Possibilidade de busca
- Copia versículos
- Compartilha versículos
- Funciona em celular
- Opção para aumentar e diminuir a fonte dos versículos através
- Habilidade para percorrer os botões de volume
Guia de usuario:
Cada item do menu é um livro separado, e cada página separada em um dos livros é a cabeça.
Coloque o cursor em vez do número do capítulo e introduza o número do capítulo. Assim, você não terá que se deslocar todos os capítulos, a seleção de interessante.
Terms of Use - http://apple.nsource.by/terms-of-use.html
Privacy Policy - http://apple.nsource.by/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00070464:ios.description:
Do you want to create your own girl or boy characters? Do you enjoy dressing them up and making stylish combinations? Then, download the Dollicon Doll Maker Game and have fun creating your original doll avatar now! Discover numerous personalization features to customize your character's eyes, lips, hairstyles, clothes, accessories, and even pets, and unleash your creativity! Personalize your girl or boy doll character and make an amazing avatar of yourself that you can use as a profile picture for social media or as a gaming logo. Now you can enjoy creating and dressing up the cutest characters ever! Hurry up, get the Dollicon Doll Maker Game today, design your own avatars, and have so much fun!
Features:
** Choose a female or male avatar or customize two avatars at the same time
** Create pairs of dolls - make love couples, best friends, brothers, sisters, your entire family – the choice is all yours
** Pick the background that perfectly suits your dolls
** Select from many eye colors, skin tones, eyelashes, face makeup styles and cool hairstyles
** Color your character’s hair just the way you like it - in one color or more
** Dress your character in trendy clothes to express your style
** Add fancy accessories like earrings, hats, necklaces and other decorations
** Express emotions on your avatar's face with different eye shapes, eyebrows and mouth positions
** Choose some of the cutest pets that go along with your avatars
** Name your characters the way you like
** Save your dolls in your gallery or share them with your friends on social media
** Apply fantastic filters for photos
** The app supports the following languages: German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Dutch, Swedish, Thai, and Vietnamese
If you like dressing up characters, this avatar maker app is perfect for you! Now you can make thousands of different style combinations, each and every unique in its own way! You can also choose features similar to yours and voilà – what you get is a cute character that will represent you in the digital world! With this brand new avatar creator you will never be bored again! What are you waiting for? Download Dollicon Doll Maker Game now and have fun creating the most stylish doll avatars ever!
----------

bluejetty:00171560:ios.description:
- Building a professional hotel service
Welcome friendly guests who love to travel to different countries, travel around the world and wish to have the best vacation in the hotel room service games. They need to book at a 5-star hotel where they can relax and feel comfortable with special service. It's time to serve your guests to your hotel and make them satisfied.
- Serving hotel by all your heart
Your guests enjoy the food service from the dream hotel. They want to enjoy the yummy meals of the hotel. Coffee, Cake, Hamburgers, Pizza ... any dishes are cooked by yourself and served immediately when requested. Collect likes when they are satisfied and you can also make extra money from this hotel service.
- Managing hotel with best staff teams
Of course, not only you, you are owned best staff teams. Including: doorman, waiter, receptionist,... they will make a true dream hotel together with you. It's easy to tap fast to manage your staff and run the best hotel operations.
- Making your dream hotel business bigger
Do you wanna be a hotel tycoon? You can completely develop your hotel business in this hotel simulation game offline. Earn money and upgrade hotels, kitchenwares, food services, cleaning room services, ... as soon as you have enough coins and gems. Not only money, more likes, more customers will be attracted to your dream hotel.
- Special challenges only at hotel room games with 150+ levels
With hotel games for free, time-management is so important! During rush times, the number of guests coming to your hotel is too crowded, do not forget the boosters. They can help you boost serving speed and finish hard challenges, grand hotel mania, craze hotel, doorman story
+ Come to Dream Hotel and write your own dream hotel story games for girls & boys! Become a hotel tycoon with the biggest hotel chains?
-> Download now! Manage your hotel by your own way!

bluejetty:00021815:ios.summary: The Christmas Gift List is an absolute must-have for the upcoming holiday season! This handy app offers everything you will ever need to create a list of people whom you can’t leave without gifts, make a list of gifts you are going to buy a
bluejetty:00021815:ios.description:
The Christmas Gift List is an absolute must-have for the upcoming holiday season! This handy app offers everything you will ever need to create a list of people whom you can’t leave without gifts, make a list of gifts you are going to buy and keep your Christmas budget under control. The program lets you add people from your Contacts with a couple of taps and efficiently plan your spending for all of them. The Christmas Gift List offers best-in-class budgeting and analysis tools that are a breeze to use! 
The app features convenient data visualization and sorting tools, which makes it super-easy to find all people without a present or people that you don’t have a gift idea for. For better understanding of your current progress towards making everyone happy, the app visualizes your gift shopping statistics in the form of charts. Finally, you can do your Christmas planning on any of your iOS devices – thanks to the integrated support of iCloud, all Christmas List data are synchronized between devices even if devices have different Apple IDs. 
Don’t forget anyone, keep your spending under control make sure everyone gets exactly what they dreamt of – The Christmas Gift List will help you make this a snap!
Program features:
• Add people from Contacts
• Add people and gifts from past years
• Track Budgeting and Analytics to get all the information you need
• Sort people by groups: Family, Friends, Co-workers, etc.
• Track gifts by status: Idea, Need to Make, Need to Buy, Made, Bought, Shipping, Received, Wrapped, Sent, Presented
• Sort gifts by stores
• Use 14 filters to quickly find the information you need
• Collect gift ideas to easily use them later
• Photos of people and gifts
• Countdown until Christmas or New Year
• Optional password protection
• Support for Touch ID and Face ID
• Archive lists for past years
• Export list to PDF for printing or sharing
• Configure PDF: organize list by people or gifts, configure columns, apply filters
• Sync data across iOS devices via iCloud 
• Sync data across devices with different Apple IDs
• Countdown widgets for Lock Screen and Home Screen

bluejetty:00175232:ios.description:
IndyStar has been Central Indiana’s news source for more than 120 years. From in-depth investigations that hold the powerful to account to authoritative coverage of Indianapolis sports, culture and entertainment, we cover the news that shapes our communities.
Our mobile app lets you personalize how you get the news that’s most important to you.
Watchdog reporting and expert analysis on Indianapolis government and Indiana’s political scene? It’s in the app.
Insider access to the Colts, Pacers, Fever, and college and high school sports? It’s in the app.
Your best options to take in Central Indiana’s arts and entertainment scene? It’s in the app.
Local news from Central Indiana’s trusted news source, plus national news from across the USA TODAY Network are all in the palm of your hand with the IndyStar app.
APP FEATURES:
• Real-time breaking news alerts
• A personalized feed on the all-new For You page
• The eNewspaper, a digital replica of our print newspaper
Subscription Information:
• The IndyStar app is free to download and all users can access a sampling of free articles every month.
• Subscriptions are charged to your account at confirmation of purchase and automatically renew each month or year, unless turned off in your account settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. See "Subscription Support" in the app's Settings for more details and customer service contact information.
MORE INFORMATION:
• Privacy Policy: https://cm.indystar.com/privacy/
• Terms of Service: https://cm.indystar.com/terms/
• Help Center: https://help.indystar.com

bluejetty:00087434:ios.description:
■ PlanMaker
► The only complete Office spreadsheet program for your Excel files
► Work on your Excel spreadsheets wherever and whenever you want.
► When working on the go, take advantage of a feature set that you would otherwise only know from your PC or Mac.
► Almost all features can be used permanently free of charge.
The complete set of features that you know from Microsoft Excel or PlanMaker on your Mac or PC is now offered by PlanMaker on your iPhone and iPad.
Compatibility without compromise: PlanMaker uses the Microsoft Office XLSX format as its native format. This guarantees seamless data exchange. You can open your spreadsheets directly in Microsoft Excel without having to convert them.
Intuitive operation on iPhone and iPad: PlanMaker always provides an ideal user experience, regardless of whether you're using it on your iPhone or an iPad. On an iPhone, you can use the practical toolbars with just one finger. On an iPad, you work with ribbons similar to those on your Mac or PC.
Save locally or in the cloud: PlanMaker not only enables you to open and save documents stored on your device, but it also allows you to access your files in iCloud, Dropbox, OneDrive and all other cloud storage services.
The PlanMaker user interface is available in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian and more than 20 other languages.
PlanMaker brings the features of a desktop spreadsheet program to your iPhone and iPad. You shouldn't settle for less.
■ Working with files
► Worksheets can be losslessly exchanged with PlanMaker for Windows, Mac and Linux.
► Open and save XLSX and XLS files with full fidelity from Microsoft Excel 5.0 to 2021 and Excel 365, also with password protection
► Import and export assistant for text files
■ Extensive calculation capabilities
► More than 430 calculation functions
► 1 million rows and 16384 columns
► Complex numbers and array functions
► AutoSum, AutoProduct, AutoFill, etc.
► External references
■ Editing and formatting
► Conditional formatting
► Format painter for the rapid transfer of formatting
► Borders, shading, fill patterns
► Cell styles
► Forms with input fields, checkboxes, dropdown lists, etc.
► Syntax highlighting
► Input validation (data validation)
► Sheet, workbook and document protection with encryption
■ Analyzing data
► AutoFilter
► Data grouping (outliner)
► Detective ("formula auditing") for troubleshooting worksheets
■ Comprehensive graphics functions
► Draw and design directly in the worksheet
► Excel-compatible AutoShapes
► Insert images
► Crop pictures, change brightness, contrast and gamma
► TextArt function for striking font effects
■ Presenting and visualizing data
► More than 80 types of 2D and 3D charts, for example, column and pie charts
► Impressive effects on charts: soft shadows, rounded edges, etc.
■ Other features
Almost all features of PlanMaker for iOS can be used free of charge. The following additional features are available to you via an inexpensive subscription:
► Printing
► Export to PDF and PDF/A
► Pivot tables
► Distributing text to cells
► Scenarios
► Data consolidation
► Sharing documents directly from PlanMaker
► Free customer support
A single subscription unlocks these features simultaneously in PlanMaker, TextMaker and Presentations for iOS.
License agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00025259:ios.description:
Spokies is Oklahoma City’s only bike share program and one of the best ways to cruise around downtown and many of the city’s most exciting neighborhoods.
Spokies bikes are uniquely designed to be sturdy and durable. Spokies offers riders two bike options – classic pedal and electric-assist bikes. Spokies bikes are located throughout the central Oklahoma City area, including Midtown, Automobile Alley, Arts District, City Center, Deep Deuce, Bricktown, Paseo, Plaza District, OU Medical, Oklahoma State Capitol, and Capitol Hill.
Bikeshare is a greener, healthier way to get around Oklahoma City. Whether you use it as your daily commute option, running errands, grabbing lunch, or exploring the city, it’s the most affordable way to travel in and around OKC.
The Spokies app gives you access to bicycles in your area – find bikes, unlock them, and pay directly from the app.
As a member of the EMBARK family of transit services, Spokies aims to provide riders with a healthy, affordable, eco-friendly transit option in Oklahoma City.

bluejetty:00040137:ios.name: Moodi - Mood Journal & Tracker
bluejetty:00040137:ios.summary: Moodi is simple and effective psychological exercises that can help if you are struggling with anxiety, stress, depression, low self-esteem, and other psychological difficulties. In addition, they improve mood, increase awareness, strengthe
bluejetty:00040137:ios.description:
Moodi is simple and effective psychological exercises that can help if you are struggling with anxiety, stress, depression, low self-esteem, and other psychological difficulties. In addition, they improve mood, increase awareness, strengthen mental health, and have an anti-stress effect.
A psychological diary is the best practice for independent work, which has many positive qualities:
- Helps you better understand yourself, your thoughts, feelings, and reactions.
- Allows you to express emotions and experiences, rather than suppressing them, which contributes to better emotional regulation and stress reduction.
- Helps you approach problem-solving and decision-making mindfully.
- Improves personal development and growth.
- Helps you identify sources of stress and anxiety and find ways to cope with them.
- Allows you to better understand yourself and your relationships with people.
Almost every psychologist recommends keeping a personal diary: it can be an emotions diary, a mood journal, a CBT journal, or free-form entries.
What practices do we offer?
Negative situations diary
The Negative Situations diary is a very effective technique for solving psychological problems. The goals of this diary are to help you learn to cope with and experience painful and anxious moments more easily, understand how some events affect your emotions, feelings, and mood, and teach your brain to develop action strategies in similar situations in the future.
It is easy to keep a Negative Situations diary. You need to make entries about every negative moment, track your thoughts, mark emotions, and choose a cognitive distortion. This will allow you to better understand yourself, your behavior, and feelings associated with this event, free your mind from negativity, and feel much better. By changing your approach to solving negative situations, your reaction to them will also change.
Positive moments diary
The Positive Moments diary (Gratitude Journal) is a journal where you note all the positive events, emotions, positivity, and gratitude. It helps you pay attention to the pleasant moments that we often don't notice, as well as reduce stress and other negative factors.
You need to write down all the good and positive moments, thoughts, situations, and mark the emotions you experienced. Write down literally everything: it can be a significant event or something fleeting, the main thing is to pay attention and write down everything that causes positive emotions.
Morning diary
The Morning diary is a technique that helps you set yourself up for the day ahead, free your mind from unnecessary worries, anxious thoughts, and negativity. By practicing, you will notice how motivation and energy rise, creativity, awareness, and self-development develop.
You need to write down your emotions, feelings, experiences, plans, tasks, goals, and even desires every day, immediately after the alarm goes off. In general, everything that seems important to you at that moment.
Evening diary
The evening diary technique involves recording emotions, feelings, and thoughts at the end of the day, right before bed. This allows you to analyze the day, free yourself from stress and tension, helps you let go of worries and worries, relax, which will improve your sleep, help you recover and provide quality rest.
Before bed, write down the events and impressions of the past day, describe in detail your emotions, feelings, and reactions, self-esteem, and physical condition. Write down what lesson you can learn from this day. Don't try to write "correctly," just be honest and write what you think is important.
---

bluejetty:00086563:ios.summary: VPN Hero is a no-log VPN ready to serve you! That’s right! Very few VPN companies actually do not collect, or “log” information transmitted through their network. VPN Hero is one of those “hero” VPN companies keeping their promise of ensuri
bluejetty:00086563:ios.description:
VPN Hero is a no-log VPN ready to serve you! That’s right! Very few VPN companies actually do not collect, or “log” information transmitted through their network. VPN Hero is one of those “hero” VPN companies keeping their promise of ensuring privacy and security in an absolute way.
VPN Hero offers more than 9000 IP addresses which are updated frequently by the developer team, in order to make your internet connection more secure and hard to track for prying eyes. Malevolent organizations and people are unfortunately trying to access and read data which are originally not theirs, including the passwords and even credit card information. So the data transmission of yours should stay untraceable and dynamic in order to avoid anyone achieving such malicious goals. As VPN Hero we are getting consultancy from white hat hackers (cool way of saying IT security experts) on a regular basis to be one step ahead of black hat hackers (thieves on the internet).
There are lots of reasons to use a VPN. The most popular reasons are privacy, data security, better mobile gaming, changing your location. VPN Hero is well aware of the various reasons, and optimized its servers for such different use cases. In terms of privacy and security, one of the most important reasons to use a VPN is securing the connection while using public WiFi. One should always remember that connecting WiFi networks in restaurants, cafes, and airports always comes with its risks. As the name public WiFi suggests, anyone can connect those networks including the ones who want to access your data. It is highly recommended to activate your VPN before connecting such public WiFi networks to secure yourself. At this point another feature of VPN Hero comes into play. VPN Hero offers the “kill switch” feature! 
The “kill switch” feature basically means preventing your phone from reconnecting to the network automatically, when your connection via VPN is disrupted for some reason. If it wasn't the case and if it tries to connect automatically, there may be 1 or 2 seconds without the VPN shield, and that 1 or 2 seconds may cause a security hole. This is how VPN Hero has been thought out, and prepared in such detail! We recommend always to pay attention for the “kill switch” feature in the VPN you will choose.
Change your location easily! VPN Hero offers international locations from different countries, and even continents!
Usually people search for virtual private networks with different prominent features e.g. fast VPN, reliable VPN, secure VPN, better VPN, best VPN, private VPN, speed VPN, gaming VPN. What if we told you that VPN Hero is named Hero for a reason? VPN Hero is a hero because it combines all these highly wanted features! Try VPN Hero now, and see its unlimited performance for yourself!
About VPN Hero Premium Subscription:
*The subscription covers VPN usage.
*VPN Hero subscription period alternatives are 1 week or 1 year. 
*Based on your plan every 1 week or 1 year your VPN subscription renews. 
*Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at only your confirmation.
*VPN Hero subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off.
You can cancel your VPN Hero subscription anytime via this URL:
https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
VPN Hero’s terms of use can be found via this URL on VPN Hero’s official website:
https://www.vpnhero.app/terms

bluejetty:00161027:ios.name: Track My Journey - Travel Log
bluejetty:00161027:ios.summary:
Turn Every Journey Into a Memory You Can Track, Save, Retrace and Relive Anytime
Track My Journey is a powerful route recorder and tracker for logging trips, route history, and travel reports designed to record, store, revisit, and retrace
bluejetty:00161027:ios.description:
Turn Every Journey Into a Memory You Can Track, Save, Retrace and Relive Anytime
Track My Journey is a powerful route recorder and tracker for logging trips, route history, and travel reports designed to record, store, revisit, and retrace your travel history. Perfect for travelers, drivers, parents, and outdoor explorers.
Featured in Canada, United States, United Kingdom, Australia, and New Zealand
Track Your Trips with One Tap
Start and stop your journey instantly. This trip tracker and travel tracker records your routes in real time, building a detailed route history so you can revisit every trip anytime.
Real-Time GPS Route Tracking
Capture every detail with accurate GPS tracking. View full route history, attach photos to locations, share live location, and automatically log trips with precision. Perfect as a road trip tracker, mileage tracker, travel map tracker and GPS logger.
Retrace Any Journey
Go back the way you came with one tap. Retrace any saved route and follow your exact path again — perfect for hikers, road trippers, boat riders and daily commuters who want to repeat a journey or find their way back.
Notes, Reports and GPX Export
Take your trips further with powerful trip management tools. Add notes to your journeys, download trips in multiple formats including GPX export and detailed reports, and keep organized records for personal or professional use. Ideal for users looking for trip reports, GPX export, and mileage logs.
Import Photos After Your Trip
Forgot to add photos during your journey? You can now import images after your trip ends and attach them to your route easily.
Dark Mode Support
Enjoy a smooth tracking experience day or night with full dark mode support.
Trip Studio Cloud Storage
Your journeys do not stay only on your device. With Trip Studio Cloud Storage you can sync and back up trips securely, access your Trip Dashboard at trackmyjourney.net, and view interactive maps, stats, downloadable reports, and photos anytime.
Access Your Trips Anywhere
View and manage your trips across devices. Your travel tracker data is always available when you need it.
Intelligent Trip Data Correction
Advanced processing improves accuracy by filtering GPS noise and optimizing your routes. Pauses are smoothly connected for a clean and complete journey view.
Privacy Comes First
Your data stays on your device unless you enable cloud sync. When enabled, your trips are encrypted and securely stored.
Relive Every Journey
Track daily drives, road trips, or outdoor adventures. Analyze stats, revisit places, retrace your routes, and relive your experiences anytime.
Always Improving
We continuously improve the app with features like route history tracking, route retracing, mileage reports, GPX export, and cloud sync. Have feedback? We would love to hear from you.
Enjoying Track My Journey? Please consider leaving a review on the App Store. Your support helps us grow.
Privacy Policy: https://trackmyjourney.net/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://trackmyjourney.net/terms-conditions

bluejetty:00131808:ios.summary:
Unlock the full potential of your DJI drone with Litchi, everyone's favorite flight app
With over 5000 successful daily flights, Litchi is the most trusted flight app for your DJI drone
Compatible with: DJI Mini 2, Mini SE (version 1 only
bluejetty:00131808:ios.description:
Unlock the full potential of your DJI drone with Litchi, everyone's favorite flight app
With over 5000 successful daily flights, Litchi is the most trusted flight app for your DJI drone
Compatible with: DJI Mini 2, Mini SE (version 1 only), Air 2S, Mavic Mini 1, Mavic Air 2, Mavic 2 Zoom/Pro, Mavic Air/Pro, Phantom 4 Normal/Advanced/Pro/ProV2, Phantom 3 Standard/4K/Advanced/Professional, Inspire 1 X3/Z3/Pro/RAW, Inspire 2, Spark
This app is *NOT* compatible with the latest DJI drones (Mini 3, Mini 4, Mini 5, Mavic 3 Enterprise, Matrice 4 etc). For these, you will need to use Litchi Pilot instead
Purchase Litchi today and get a 30% off coupon towards your Airdata.com subscription, exclusive to Litchi pilots, refer to https://flylitchi.com/airdata for more info
Feature highlights:
- Waypoint mode
Whether you are a professional or beginner, Litchi offers the most intuitive yet powerful waypoint engine. Our waypoint planner is available on all platforms including PC/Mac with seamless flight plans syncing across all your devices
- Panorama mode
Easily shoot horizontal, vertical and 360 spherical panoramas. And when you're done shooting, stitch on-the-go up to 130 megapixels panoramas on iPhone (up to 220MP on iPad Pro). Say goodbye to using additional expensive PC/Mac stitching software!
- Track mode
With Litchi's Track mode, your DJI drone now understands what it sees. Using state of the art computer vision algorithms, Litchi keeps your selection perfectly framed while you fly the drone. Don't want to fly manually? That's ok too, start an autonomous Orbit or Follow and watch Litchi take care of everything
- Follow mode
The drone follows your every move using the mobile device GPS and altitude sensors
- VR mode
By harnessing the power of your mobile phone, the Virtual Reality mode brings you the most immersive FPV experience. Watch your autonomous flight in VR mode, or fly manually for added thrills. Requires goggles sold separately
- Focus mode
Litchi assists you by taking control of both the gimbal and the drone's yaw axis, so you can concentrate on horizontal movements
And much more including...
- Orbit mode to circle around a subject with advanced settings and real time controls
- Livestream your drone's video feed to Facebook or to a RTMP server
- Stream the video feed to a nearby device running the Litchi Vue app
- Custom RC keys functions allow you to create flight plans as you fly them and much more
- Human readable flight logs (CSV format), which can be automatically uploaded to Airdata UAV
- Voice feedback for important warnings
- Automatic video recording
- Support for bluetooth controllers
Visit our website for more information: https://flylitchi.com
How to connect Litchi to your drone: https://www.flylitchi.com/help 
Make sure to check out the Litchi Hub at https://hub.flylitchi.com

bluejetty:00083433:ios.description:
Pixel Tribe: Viking Kingdom is a strategy RPG with retro pixel art graphics where you build and upgrade a tribe of Vikings. 
As the chief, you must build your kingdom, raise a tribe of Vikings, craft weapons and armor, and send your Vikings on epic turn-based raids. 
Craft items and resources, upgrade your kingdom and improve your Vikings fighting skills.
Build, farm, raise animals, decorate, upgrade and customize your own Viking Kingdom. 
Craft weapons and armor for your Vikings to give them a fighting chance against the toughest enemies in Midgard!
PIXEL TRIBE: VIKING KINGDOM FEATURES
CRAFT, BUILD & UPGRADE
● Craft and upgrade weapons and armor.
● Build and upgrade buildings like the Weaponsmith, Viking ship, Church and more.
● Craft resources to earn gold and upgrade your kingdom.
● Craft items and gear to upgrade your Vikings fighting skills.
● Upgrade your farm to craft food and more valuable resources.
FIGHTING
● Earn rewards by fighting and raid your enemies! 
● Level up your Vikings and upgrade your fighting skills!
● Fighting lets you specialize your Vikings as tanks, fighters, archers or mages.
● Top the Leaderboards by fighting your way to glory!
FARM, BUILD & UPGRADE
● Build a farm and craft food to heal your Vikings.
● Plant and harvest crops.
● Build your kingdom and raise animals.
● Farm and feed your animals to produce eggs, wool, and milk.
MULTIPLAYER
● Clans with Raids, Orders, and Buffs
● PVP battles
● Leagues and Leaderboards
● Visit other Players villages

bluejetty:00079017:ios.name: Age of Empires Mobile
bluejetty:00079017:ios.summary:
Age of Empires Mobile combines the familiar elements of Age of Empires with strategic gameplay crafted specifically for the mobile platform to give fans of the genre a brand-new way to enjoy the beloved franchise.
Experience exhilarating g
bluejetty:00079017:ios.description:
Age of Empires Mobile combines the familiar elements of Age of Empires with strategic gameplay crafted specifically for the mobile platform to give fans of the genre a brand-new way to enjoy the beloved franchise.
Experience exhilarating gameplay with swift and intense battles, rapid resource gathering and military building, defending against waves of enemies, and forming alliances with hundreds of players to aid in your cause to build a dominant empire.
Immerse yourself in an epic adventure featuring detailed real-time controls, breathtaking visuals, and legendary historical heroes on grand battlefields. Command your empire, unite allies from around the world, and restore your once radiant glory. Embark on a conquest unlike any other!
FEATURES
[EXPERIENCE A NEW AGE OF EMPIRES]
Familiar elements from the classic Age of Empires games merged with brand-new and mobile-specific gameplay. Engage in rapid resource management, develop unique technologies, and train diverse armies to build and defend your kingdom from scratch.
[DOMINATE IMMERSIVE BATTLEFIELDS]
Explore glorious medieval cities transformed into battlegrounds. Strategize meticulously, aiming at archer towers, breaching gates, and seizing central structures. Participate in epic alliance battles with thousands of players worldwide in real-time combat within dynamic, interactive cities, for an authentic medieval battlefield experience on your mobile devices.
[BUILD MIGHTY CIVILIZATIONS]
Choose from 8 civilizations, the magnificent Chinese, the grandiose Romans, the elegant French, the glittering Byzantines, the mystical Egyptians, the solemn British, the exquisite Japanese, and the vibrant Koreans. Each civilization has its corresponding types of troops. With even more civilizations set to debut, experience the medieval era with high-definition graphics and richly detailed environments.
[USE REALISTIC WEATHER AND TERRAIN]
Explore and conquer a vast, vibrant, and realistic medieval world where the weather shifts unpredictably with the seasons. Various weather conditions and terrains will impact your strategic decisions. Torrential rains and droughts can alter the landscape, affecting troop movements. Lightning can damage your armies and structures, while fog obscures vision, hiding potential enemies. Skillfully harness the weather and terrain to enhance your battle effectiveness!
[COMMAND TROOPS & WEAPONS IN REAL TIME]
Lead up to five troops, maneuvering them freely across expansive maps and intense battlegrounds. Control a variety of powerful siege weapons such as trebuchets, alliance towers, battering rams, escalades, and airships to support your alliance in gaining the upper hand in fierce combat. Mastering the controls is crucial!
[DEPLOY LEGENDARY HEROES]
Select from over 70 epic heroes representing various civilizations. Legendary figures like Joan of Arc, Leonidas, and Julius Caesar are joined by intriguing new allies such as Miyamoto Musashi, Hua Mulan, and Rani Durgavati. Combine the unique attributes of these heroes and lead diverse troop types to create your own powerful and unique force!
The game has a level of detail way beyond what I was expecting, with several empires fleshed out with unique heroes, unit designs, city designs, and siege weapons. —TheGamer
Even in its new handheld home, that unique Age of Empires brand of spectacle is still spectacular. —Pocket Tactics

bluejetty:00130963:ios.summary:
Established in 2017, Bad Monday began as a self-funded project out of Mark’s Garage. Mark’s wife (Alice) was starting maternity leave with their second child and they needed a little cash injection to survive the coming months. 
Bad Monday
bluejetty:00130963:ios.description:
Established in 2017, Bad Monday began as a self-funded project out of Mark’s Garage. Mark’s wife (Alice) was starting maternity leave with their second child and they needed a little cash injection to survive the coming months. 
Bad Monday was only born in October of 2017, but to this date (November 2018) has generated over 35 Thousand orders. From the beginning of June, we started outsourcing our print and production and have seen a turnover increase of over 300%, finally being able to meet the demand the brand brings. 
Mark wanted to create a brand that was not only inspired by the tattoo culture, but also merged other art influences whilst still respecting more traditional styles. A brand that cared about their quality and also offered great premium designs but without the premium price. 
We are a small Independent family run brand, but we are growing and growing all thanks to your support. We hope this has given you a little more of an insight into our business and how it all started!

Game Fea
bluejetty:00138486:ios.description:
Welcome to Age of Pomodoro, the revolutionary game that combines the productivity of a Pomodoro timer with the excitement of a civilization-building idle game. Age of Pomodoro transforms your focus sessions into a thriving empire!
Game Features:
Focus and Expand: Use your focus minutes effectively to expand your empire. The more you focus, the more your civilization grows!
- Build and Boost: Construct various buildings to boost your economy. From farms to marketplaces, every structure contributes to your empire's prosperity.
- Attract Residents: Develop your city to attract new residents. A larger population means more productivity and faster progress.
- Wonders of the World: Build magnificent wonders to showcase your empire’s glory. Each wonder provides unique benefits and showcases your civilization’s advancement.
- Diplomacy and Trade: Foster diplomacy with other civilizations. Engage in trade to obtain valuable resources and strengthen your empire’s relationships.
Why Age of Pomodoro?
- Productivity Meets Gaming: Turn your productive focus sessions into a game. Achieve your real-life goals while expanding your virtual empire.
- Idle Gameplay: Perfect for those who love idle games. Your empire continues to grow even when you’re not actively playing.
- Beautiful Graphics: Stunning visuals bring your empire to life. Watch as your city evolves from a small settlement to a grand civilization.
- Engaging and Educational: Learn about the importance of time management and strategic planning while having fun.
Download Age of Pomodoro now and start building your empire, one Pomodoro at a time. Focus, build, conquer – your civilization awaits!

bluejetty:00126762:ios.description:
Solicita un Vehículo a través de nuestra aplicación y un conductor privado te recogerá en pocos minutos.
¿Cómo es la experiencia WayCali?
Es tener un conductor privado a tu disposición en toda tu ciudad en servicio 5 estrellas. Tu seguridad y comodidad son lo más importante: un excelente conductor, un vehículo en óptimas condiciones.
Los mejores conductores
Porque todos ellos han sido seleccionados uno a uno. Han sido capacitados y están dispuestos a ofrecerte la mejor experiencia posible.
Características:
- Podrás ver el historial de rutas tomadas, mostrando origen-destinto, conductor, Km, tiempo y valor.
- Se puede seleccionar una ubicación diferente a través de la barra de búsqueda que ofrece la tecnología de Google maps.
- Si la ubicación arrojada por Google maps no es tan precisa, por ejemplo si se ubica en una avenida pero no exactamente en la salida de una casa o edificio, podemos mover el pin o marcador en el mapa hasta la ubicación exacta.
- Una vez que el usuario envía la solicitud de servicio, el sistema busca automáticamente el Conductor más cercano.
- Una vez que se confirme el servicio, se envía una notificación al pasajero indicando algunos datos como la marca, el modelo, la placa, color, número celular, tiempo de llegada.
- El conductor puede avisar al pasajero en el momento que ha llegado a buscarlo.
- Puedes pagar con tarjeta de crédito. Se cargará automáticamente a través de la aplicación, pero a una 1 sola Cuota, evitas pagar al banco intereses por tus viajes.
- En caso de escoger el pago en efectivo el conductor debe continuar y confirmar que el pago se ha realizado.
- Te mandaremos un recibo a tu e-mail cuando el viaje haya terminado.
- Se permite calificar al pasajero y al conductor.
¿WayCali está en mi ciudad?
Nacimos en Cali, por ahora sólo aquí Ve!
Ansiosos de crecer gracias a ti y poder brindar nuestro servicio a más Colombianos.

bluejetty:00129176:ios.description:
Esta aplicación ha sido diseñada para facilitar el acceso y gestión de su información médica del Portal del paciente.
¿Qué es el Portal del Paciente?
El Portal del Paciente es un espacio personal desde el que podrá acceder a su historial médico, pruebas diagnósticas, informes clínicos, gestionar citas médicas y tener un seguimiento sin esperas ni desplazamientos.
Está destinada a los pacientes del grupo Quirónsalud o a cualquier usuario que desee darse de alta como nuevo paciente.
El grupo Quirónsalud se preocupa de su salud y bienestar, por ello ha lanzado esta aplicación con la intención de acercar y estrechar la relación paciente médico para poder proporcionar un servicio de mayor calidad.
Las funcionalidades principales de esta App son:
- Solicitar cita previa pudiendo consultar los huecos disponibles para cada médico.
- Consultar, modificar o cancelar las citas concertadas.
- Notificaciones y recordatorio de citas.
- Consultar y cumplimentar las tareas pendientes que su médico le haya programado, cómo pedir cita online o rellenar formularios.
- Consultar y descargar los resultados e informes de sus pruebas. 
- Consultar y visualizar imágenes diagnósticas
- Consultar sus informes clínicos e históricos de formularios realizados pudiendo filtrarlos por fecha o especialidad.
- Comunicación directa con su médico.
- Calculadoras y herramientas de salud.
- En la sección Bienestar puedes consultar la evolución de tus indicadores de salud y estilo de vida y permite sincronizarse con tus datos de actividad física de HealthKit app (Salud). Se solicitará el permiso de acceso de lectura de HealthKit.
La aplicación requiere conexión a internet para poder acceder a sus datos. De momento no todos los hospitales del grupo se encuentran activos, aunque se irán incorporando a corto / medio plazo.

bluejetty:00043816:ios.name: Speak Out Kids: Learn to Talk
bluejetty:00043816:ios.summary:
Give Your Child the Power to Communicate, Learn & Grow.
Is your child starting their language journey? Looking for a fun way to accelerate learning, from first words to full sentences? Speak Out Kids is a powerful, all-in-one learning plat
bluejetty:00043816:ios.description:
Give Your Child the Power to Communicate, Learn & Grow.
Is your child starting their language journey? Looking for a fun way to accelerate learning, from first words to full sentences? Speak Out Kids is a powerful, all-in-one learning platform designed to make speech development, literacy, and even learning a new language a joyful adventure for EVERY child.
Born from a father's mission to help his autistic son, our app was built to overcome the toughest communication challenges. This robust foundation makes it an incredibly effective tool for all children, whether they are neurotypical toddlers, preschoolers, or children with unique learning needs.
A COMPLETE LEARNING ECOSYSTEM:
 ACCELERATE SPEECH & BUILD SENTENCES:
Go beyond flashcards! Our unique sentence builder allows kids to combine images and phrases ("I want," "I see") to form real sentences, transforming their ability to express themselves. Perfect for toddlers, speech delays, and AAC users.
 MASTER READING & ALPHABET (ABC's):
From our Alphabet Board to interactive, narrated stories with quizzes, we make literacy exciting. Watch your child's confidence soar as they learn to recognize letters, sound out words, and understand stories.
 LEARN A NEW LANGUAGE:
With support for English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, and more, Speak Out Kids is a fantastic tool for bilingual families or for introducing a child to their first foreign language in a fun, natural way.
 PLAY & LEARN WITH PURPOSE:
Our library of educational games (Memory, Puzzles, "What Sound Is This?") is designed by learning experts to develop crucial skills like memory, motor skills, and comprehension while your child is just having fun.
FEATURES THAT PARENTS & THERAPISTS LOVE:
- Fully Customizable: Add your own photos, words, and voice to make the app a reflection of your child's world.
- Track Real Progress: Our new statistics dashboard provides clear, data-driven insights into your child's learning, perfect for sharing with teachers and therapists.
- Take It Offline: Print any card as a PDF to create physical learning tools and activities, reducing screen time.
- Always Growing: We constantly add new stories, games, and features to keep the learning journey fresh and exciting.
Whether your goal is to support speech development, kickstart literacy, introduce a new language, or simply give your child a fun, educational head start, Speak Out Kids is your partner in learning.
Download today and unlock your child's full potential.
Terms of Use (EULA):
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00165463:ios.description:
Laundry, we get it. Clothes wash services, dry cleaning, ironing, and duvet cleaning. All in one place.
Short on time but still want to remain fresh? No need to worry, with free collection & delivery in less than 24 hours, you'll have clean laundry and peace of mind, so that you can spend more time on the things that you love.
Services
• Wash
• Wash & Iron
• Ironing
• Dry Cleaning
• Duvets & Bulky Items*
How It Works
1) Schedule a collection time
2) Pack your laundry
3) Track our partner driver
4) Delivery in 24 hours with real-time order tracking
Location Availability
• United Kingdom - London, Manchester, Birmingham, Edinburgh, Coventry
• United States - New York City, Jersey City, Boston, Chicago, Los Angeles, San Francisco, San Jose, Dallas, Washington D.C, Miami
• Ireland - Dublin
• Netherlands - Amsterdam, Rotterdam, The Hague
• France - Paris
• Denmark - Copenhagen
• United Arab Emirates - Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah
• Saudi Arabia - Riyadh, Jeddah
• Qatar - Doha
• Kuwait - Kuwait City
• Bahrain - Manama
• Singapore - Singapore
• Malaysia - Kuala Lumpur
• Peru - Lima
• Colombia - Bogota
Frequently Asked Questions
• How does Laundryheap work?
Simply select the required services and choose the dates for collection & delivery, leaving any additional instructions for the driver. Following this, we'll take care of everything else with the help of our partner cleaning facilities.
• What is the turnaround time?
For standard laundry and dry cleaning services, we have a monthly average of collecting and delivering within 24 hours. Note* duvet and bulky items may require additional time. We will always do our best to let you know in advance if you have included items that will require a longer processing time, or if there are any delivery changes to your order.
• Where do you clean my clothes?
After your items are collected by our driver, they are taken to one of our local partner facilities. Each order is processed separately - Laundry orders are weighed and cleaned, while all other services are individually itemized and processed.
• Can I provide my own detergent?
At this time, we do not offer the option for customers to provide their own laundry detergent, but please let us know if you are allergic to a certain type so we can make sure to avoid it.
• Do you wash my clothes with other people's clothes?
Absolutely not. Each order is washed separately so no need to worry about that. Your clothes are safe with us!

bluejetty:00126230:ios.description:
Track expiration dates in seconds with BEEP.
Just scan a barcode to add products and get reminders before they expire. BEEP makes it easy to track expiration dates and manage food in your fridge, pantry, or storage. Whether you're at home, running a restaurant, or managing retail inventory, BEEP helps you stay organized, reduce food waste, and keep everything fresh.
BEEP Features:
- Scan a product’s barcode to quickly add it to your team’s inventory. BEEP fills in the name and image so you only need to enter the expiration date.
- Invite others to your team to track items together. Great for families, coworkers, or anyone managing shared inventory.
- Get notifications before items expire. Choose when you want to be reminded so you can use things up on time.
- Organize products into categories like snacks, frozen foods, or cleaning supplies. Set different alerts for each to stay in control.
- Search or scan to find any item fast. Check what’s expiring soon with just a quick tap.
- Your data stays safe and synced. Even if you change devices or reinstall the app, your info is always backed up.
Get started in seconds:
1. Download BEEP and create an account.
2. Scan a barcode or enter product details yourself.
3. Set an expiry date and receive custom alerts.
Join thousands of users keeping their products fresh and reducing waste with BEEP.
Download now!
Need help or have questions?
- Support: support@beepscan.com
- BEEP Official: https://www.beepscan.com
- BEEP User Guide: https://docs-en.beepscan.com

bluejetty:00095540:ios.summary:
Snap a photo of your meal — Snacky helps you count calories, protein, fat, and carbs. Keep a food diary, track water and weight, and talk about your nutrition with an AI assistant that takes your entries and goals into account.
LOG FOOD YO
bluejetty:00095540:ios.description:
Snap a photo of your meal — Snacky helps you count calories, protein, fat, and carbs. Keep a food diary, track water and weight, and talk about your nutrition with an AI assistant that takes your entries and goals into account.
LOG FOOD YOUR WAY
Take a meal photo, choose one from your gallery, or simply describe what you ate. For packaged foods, scan the label or look up the barcode. You can also search the food database — choose the easiest way to log each meal.
CREATE AND SAVE YOUR OWN DISHES
Build a dish from ingredients or enter calories and macros yourself. AI can help generate an ingredient list from the dish name and create an image. Add your own photo or an emoji, save favorites, and quickly find dishes in your history.
UNDERSTAND YOUR NUTRITION
See calories and macros for each dish and ingredient. Edit ingredients, portion weight, and nutritional values, or ask AI to update the details. Get a dish rating on a five-point scale, explanations, and suggestions for improving it.
KEEP A DIARY WITH LESS EFFORT
Organize dishes by meal, choose the entry date, and revisit previous days in the calendar. Daily totals show how much you have eaten and what is left toward your calorie and macro goals.
SET GOALS THAT FIT YOU
Choose to lose, gain, or maintain weight. Snacky calculates daily targets based on your personal details and activity. Set calorie and macro goals and choose your eating style: balanced, low-carb, keto, vegetarian, vegan, paleo, or Mediterranean.
TALK NUTRITION WITH YOUR AI ASSISTANT
“What should I have for dinner?” or “How can I get more protein today?” — ask questions with your diary as context. Get meal and swap ideas, save suggested dishes to your diary, and revisit past chats. You decide whether to accept the assistant’s suggested goal changes. Choose a tone that suits you: caring, scientific, ironic, or strict.
REFLECT ON YOUR DAY
Get an evening nutrition review based on your logged meals: how the day went, what worked, and what to focus on tomorrow. Continue the conversation with your assistant right in the chat.
NOTICE YOUR PROGRESS AND HABITS
See calories, macros, water, steps, weight, and BMI in one overview. Explore charts across different periods, your weight history, and progress toward your goal. Detailed insights help you compare weeks and months, explore calorie and protein sources, meal timing, and weight changes. Discuss findings with AI directly from insight cards.
TRACK WATER AND ACTIVITY
Log water by the glass, bottle, or milliliter, and set daily water and step goals. Connect Apple Health to read your step count and sync water entries.
KEEP WHAT MATTERS IN SIGHT
Add Snacky widgets to your Home Screen and Lock Screen. Check calories, macros, water, and steps in a format that works for you, without opening the app.
SAVE AND SHARE YOUR DIARY
Export entries for a day, a week, or a selected period as a PDF, image, Markdown, or CSV for Excel. Keep the report for yourself or share it.
Start with your next meal — take a photo or add it manually.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.nukimo-app.com/privacy-policy-snack-sense
