bluejetty:00063279:ios.summary: Dot to Dot Puzzles & Coloring is an amusing and relaxing app for young and adults, for the whole family, with an amazing world of handmade digital dot to dot puzzles, to reveal pictures with different complexities and various themes. Discov
bluejetty:00063279:ios.description:
Dot to Dot Puzzles & Coloring is an amusing and relaxing app for young and adults, for the whole family, with an amazing world of handmade digital dot to dot puzzles, to reveal pictures with different complexities and various themes. Discover what is hidden behind, connecting dots by number. Once jigsaw puzzle is solved, pictures can be customized by coloring, as well as adding textures to the surfaces, changing lines colors and background color. Images to draw by connecting the dots are classified into Art, Landmarks, Landscapes, Mandalas, Animals, Vehicles, People, Nature, Sports, Mazes, Fantasy, Faces, Celebrations, Christmas and Others.
Features:
- Two game modes: An Easy mode and the Classic one.
- More than one million seven hundred thousand dots to connect by number in lots of puzzles games.
- Includes a wide variety with more than a thousand of pictures containing from 17 to more than 15,000 dots.
- Completely free puzzle game to connect the dots with a lot of images from 35 to more than 6,000 dots.
- The content will be updated periodically to have new puzzle pictures to connect the dots and relax.
- Palette with 34 colors to connect dots by number.
- Palette with 34 colors for coloring the final drawings.
- Palette with 34 textures to personalize your creations.
- Option to customize background with a 34 color palette, during the puzzle game or in final picture.
- Dark mode by default, both in menu and in game.
- Option to switch to white mode.
- Option to disable assist arrow and dot explosion effect.
- Improve hand-to-eye motor skills.
- Creative, anti-stress and relaxing activity.
- Share your dot to dot creations on social networks with family and friends by picture or by animation.
- Free to play game.
- Enjoy and play offline connecting dots puzzle.
- It has 5 free aids and the option to purchase hints packages.
- A free hint for each 1,000 connected dots.
Exclusive payment content with Premium+ tag, with an annual subscription or single payment for lifetime, version without advertising, which in addition to the Premium puzzles includes:
- Six dot to dot game modes: Simple, Extreme, Relax, Mystery and two combined modes.
- 8 extra effects for dots explosion.
Terms of use: https://www.ocigrup.com/sub_app_terms_of_use.html
Privacy Policy: https://www.ocigrup.com/sub_app_ios_privacypolicy.html

Count every step and see your health at a glance — right on your Home Screen, Lock Screen and Apple Watch, without ever opening the app.

bluejetty:00126722:android.summary: Welcome to Farm City Simulator, the ultimate farming game for mobile! In this immersive and realistic simulation, you'll embark on an exciting journey to build and manage your own farm city. Plant and harvest crops, raise animals, trade goo
bluejetty:00126722:android.description:
Welcome to Farm City Simulator, the ultimate farming game for mobile! In this immersive and realistic simulation, you'll embark on an exciting journey to build and manage your own farm city. Plant and harvest crops, raise animals, trade goods, and customize your farm to create a thriving agricultural empire.
With stunning graphics and easy-to-use controls, Farm City Simulator provides an enjoyable gameplay experience for players of all ages. Grow a variety of crops, from sunflowers to strawberries, and tend to them carefully as they grow from seeds to mature plants. Feed and care for your livestock, including cows and chickens, to ensure they are healthy and productive.
As you progress, you'll need to manage your resources wisely to optimize your farm's productivity. Invest in farm equipment, vehicles, and buildings, and use advanced farming techniques such as fertilizing and irrigation to maximize your crop yields. Keep an eye on changing weather conditions and market prices to make informed decisions and stay ahead in the competitive farming industry.
Farm City Simulator also offers a dynamic world to explore, with bustling markets where you can trade your goods and participate in events for rewards. Connect with other players in multiplayer mode, join a supportive farming community, and complete quests to unlock special bonuses and opportunities.
But farming is not all about hard work! Farm City Simulator provides a fun and rewarding gameplay experience, with a wide range of activities to enjoy. Take part in exciting events and competitions, decorate your farm with various decorations, and interact with other characters in the game to uncover hidden surprises.
With its captivating gameplay, realistic farming mechanics, and vibrant world to explore, Farm City Simulator is the ultimate farming game for mobile. Live the life of a farmer, build your dream farm city, and experience the joys and challenges of farming in this addictive and immersive simulation game!

bluejetty:00185969:ios.description:
Every birthday, age, and special moment at a glance.
Age Counter is your personal birthday calendar for friends, family, and pets. In one clear list, instantly see who has a birthday coming up, how old the people you care about are today, and which special day is next.
Tap any entry for the full story: an exact age in years, months, weeks, days, and even seconds. It is a delightful way to make every birthday feel a little more special.
YOUR HIGHLIGHTS
• Keep birthdays for friends, family, and pets in one place
• View precise ages in years, months, weeks, days, and seconds
• Get birthday reminders so you never miss an important day
• See upcoming birthdays at a glance with the Home Screen widget
• Import birthdays from your iOS contacts with one tap
• Respectfully record a loved one's or pet's passing date; birthday reminders stop automatically
• Sync your data securely across Apple devices with iCloud
• Automatically discover the zodiac sign for every birthday, with its element, quality and matching signs
• Reach milestones together: 1,000 days, 100 weeks, a half birthday — each with its own reminder
• Share a birthday card in one tap: “Mia is 1,000 days old today”
• See what a birthday means elsewhere: the Chinese zodiac animal with its element, the weekday's colour in Thailand and its guardian animal in Myanmar
• Show birth dates in a second calendar — Hijri, Chinese lunar, Buddhist, Hebrew, Persian or Indian — and celebrate a birthday by it
Whether it is your best friend's birthday, a family milestone, or your pet's special day, Age Counter makes it easy to stay close to the people and animals that matter most.
Enable iCloud in Settings to keep your data up to date across your devices. Allow notifications to receive timely birthday reminders.

- Chat using "DroidCam Webcam" on your computer, including sound and picture (more below).
- Direct OBS Studio integration with the DroidCam OBS plugin (see below).

- Simple, efficient, and trusted by millions of users worldwide.
PC WEBCAM – droidcam.app
Get the DroidCam PC Client to use your phone as a webcam. The client is available for Windows & Linux systems, and works with Zoom, Skype, Discord, and most other programs.
→ Go to droidcam.app on your computer to download and install the DroidCam Client, and to learn more about usage.
OBS CAMERA – droidcam.app/obs
Use DroidCam directly in OBS Studio by getting the DroidCam OBS plugin, no need for a separate client!
The DroidCam OBS plugin is available for Windows, Mac and Linux (Flatpak) systems, and seamlessly integrates your phone into your setup.
→ Go to droidcam.app/obs on your computer to download, install, and learn more about usage.
Bonus: You can use the 'OBS Virtual Camera' for Zoom/Skype/Discord integration, still no need for extra client software!
SIMPLE & EFFICIENT
DroidCam is designed with simplicity and efficiency in mind. What you see is what you get. The app is free to use at standard definition with no time limits. You can try HD video, but will need to purchase the pro upgrade to remove watermarks.
PRO FEATURES
The pro upgrade includes more than just HD video. Use Ultrawide and Telephoto lenses on iPhone 11+, adjust camera remotely from the computer, remove advertising, and more. Check the in-app Upgrade and Settings pages for more.
With optimized power usage and low-latency video transfer, DroidCam can replace webcams and capture cards saving you $100s. Use it for remote work, remote learning, teaching, and content creation.

Disfruta de todas las prestaciones de nuestra App, que además de ser rápida, efectiva y superfácil de usar, cuenta con la garantía de haber sido aprobada por el Gobierno de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires.

1. PEDÍ EL TAXI
Establecé tu ubicación en el mapa, elegí el horario de búsqueda y seleccioná el tipo de móvil preferido.

2. CONOCÉ SU UBICACIÓN
Confirmado tu pedido, accedé a los datos del chofer y móvil. Visualizá cómo se acerca a tu posición.

3. VIAJÁ SEGURO
Recibí una notificación cuando el taxi llegó a tu puerta, evitá desencuentros y viajá a tu destino con total seguridad.

bluejetty:00096419:ios.description:
COUNT DOWN IN A CHARMING CHRISTMAS VILLAGE
Your favourite Advent Calendar app is back and updated for 2026. This December, we’re building a quaint Christmas village, piece by piece, every day of Advent! Model Christmas villages have been a festive tradition for centuries and this year we’re bringing them to life with daily stories, games and activities! 
WHAT’S IN THE CHRISTMAS VILLAGE ADVENT CALENDAR
- Christmas countdown: keep track of the festive season with 25 numbered ornaments which reveal a daily surprise starting 1st December until Christmas Day.
- Festive fun: enjoy a new animated story, activity or game each day as you count down to Christmas.
- Scavenger Hunt: there’s a cheeky elf hidden somewhere in the village every day, can you find them all?!
- A cosy cottage: decorate your own Christmas cottage to your taste! 
- Christmas games: inside your cottage you’ll find books, jigsaw puzzles and even more games!
START YOUR CHRISTMAS VILLAGE COUNTDOWN NOW
From the moment you download the Christmas Village Advent Calendar app, you’re plunged into a world of festive fun. Even before 1st December, there’s all sorts of games, activities and exploring to do! Once Advent begins, your Christmas Village will begin to build itself. Every day you’ll see a new building arrive, alongside a new Christmassy surprise and a host of games, activities, digital crafts and more! Accompanied by heartwarming festive music, it’s a wonderful way to spend the season.

bluejetty:00149913:ios.description:
Welcome to the ultimate slicing experience! Get ready for an adrenaline-pumping adventure where your precision and skill will be put to the test. In this addictive mobile game, your objective is simple yet immensely satisfying: cut through a myriad of obstacles and objects with finesse and style.
Equipped with a collection of razor-sharp katanas, you'll embark on a journey filled with thrilling challenges. But there's a twist - you can stack your katanas and use them to glide through the air, reaching your target with unparalleled grace. Strategize your approach, time your cuts perfectly, and watch as the objects shatter into a spectacular explosion of fragments.
Immerse yourself in a captivating world of visual delight, as each slice and dice is accompanied by stunning visuals and immersive sound effects. The more precise your cuts, the more points you'll earn, unlocking exciting new levels and unlocking a variety of powerful katanas along the way.
With intuitive controls and an addictive gameplay loop, this game will keep you coming back for more. Challenge yourself to achieve the highest score, compete with friends, and become the ultimate slicing master. Are you ready to experience the sheer satisfaction of slicing through obstacles with unmatched precision? Get ready to embark on an exhilarating slicing frenzy today!

bluejetty:00015427:ios.description:
Make It lets teachers, families and students create their own learning games and quizzes in minutes, and play them on any device.
CREATE
- More than 20 kinds of activities: quizzes, true or false, drag and drop, connect, memory, word and letter games, put in order, missing word, maths and more
- Hundreds of pictures and sounds in the library, or your own photos and voice recordings
- Templates, fonts, timers, music and rewards to make every game your own
- Start from the ready-made demos and change them as you like
SHARE AND PLAY
- Share any project with a code or a link: students play it on any device, without an account
- Classrooms: students join with a code and play what you share with them
- Rankings, results and statistics for each student and each quiz
EVERYWHERE
- Your projects in sync on all your devices.
- In 35 languages, including Arabic and Hebrew from right to left
- Try it without creating an account
- Student mode for classroom devices
FOR SCHOOLS AND SPECIAL NEEDS
Make It is used in classrooms, at home and by special education teachers: short, visual activities with pictures and sounds, made to fit each student.
SUBSCRIPTION
- Make It Premium is a subscription that lets educators create, share and sync their own interactive learning material without limits.
- While the subscription is active you have unlimited access to everything in the app, on any device.
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase.
- The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for the renewal within the 24 hours before the end of the period.
- You can manage the subscription and turn off auto-renew in your Apple Account settings after purchase. Cancelling takes effect at the end of the current period.
- Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://makeit.app/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://makeit.app/terms-and-conditions
Questions or ideas? Write to us at support@learnyland.com — we'd love to hear from you.

bluejetty:00179952:ios.description:
The Calm Nursery Rhymes & Lullabies App for Babies and Toddlers
TinyBee is a gentle, ad-free baby songs app designed for babies, toddlers, and preschoolers. With soothing nursery rhymes for babies, calming lullabies, bedtime music, and simple learning activities, TinyBee helps your little one learn and grow — without overstimulation.
Unlike fast-paced kids' content, TinyBee is built around calm screen time for toddlers. Every video, song, and activity is slow, gentle, and intentional — perfect for developing minds.
 Gentle Nursery Rhymes & Baby Songs
A carefully selected collection of timeless nursery rhymes for babies and toddlers, presented in a calm and reassuring way:
- Twinkle Twinkle Little Star – Soft and soothing
- The Wheels on the Bus – Familiar and comforting
- ABC Song – Slow-paced letter introduction
- Old MacDonald Had a Farm – Gentle animal sounds
- Itsy Bitsy Spider – Simple and playful
These baby songs support language development, listening skills, and emotional security — without loud sounds or rapid visuals. New nursery rhymes and toddler songs added regularly.
 Calming Lullabies & Bedtime Music
Help your baby relax and feel safe with calming lullabies and bedtime sounds:
- Soft lullabies for babies and bedtime music
- Gentle sleep sounds that comfort and soothe
- A peaceful, ad-free environment for wind-down time
- Ideal for nap time, bedtime, or quiet cuddles
TinyBee is the perfect baby lullaby app and toddler bedtime app for healthy sleep routines.
 Simple, Low-Pressure Learning Activities
TinyBee includes baby-friendly activities that encourage curiosity at your child's own pace:
 - Tap & Play Sounds – Explore music calmly
 - First Words & Sounds – Early language exposure for toddlers
 - Colors & Shapes – Simple matching activities
 - Easy Puzzles – Support coordination and focus
 - Sing-Along Mode – Familiar repetition builds confidence
No timers. No scores. No pressure. Just gentle toddler learning designed for tiny hands.
 Why TinyBee Is Different
Most kids' apps are loud, fast, and overstimulating. TinyBee is the opposite — a calm kids app built around:
- Slow, predictable animations
- Soft colors and gentle transitions
- Familiar, comforting melodies
- Simple interactions made for babies and toddlers
- Perfect for quiet play, wind-down moments, or bedtime routines
TinyBee is the ideal low-stimulation baby app for parents who care about mindful screen time.
 Safe, Private & Parent-Approved
 - No Ads, Ever – A completely ad-free baby app with no distractions
 - Curated by Educators – Every nursery rhyme, lullaby, and game is handpicked
 - Kid-Safe Environment – No external links or surprises
 - Parental-Friendly Design – Simple and intuitive for parents
 Why Parents Choose TinyBee
- Calm, low-stimulation screen time for babies and toddlers
- Gentle introduction to music, nursery rhymes, and learning
- Supports calm focus and emotional regulation
- The ad-free toddler app designed for developing minds
- Safe, private, and trusted by families
 Download TinyBee Today
Give your child a calmer way to enjoy baby songs, nursery rhymes, and lullabies. TinyBee is perfect for parents who value balance, simplicity, and mindful screen time for toddlers.
MagikBee is committed to reimagining kids' screen time by creating safe, private, and thoughtful digital experiences that support healthy development.

bluejetty:00186802:ios.description:
Classroom Mosaic is the leading platform for classroom observations, walkthroughs, learning walks, teacher evaluations, and more. Join 30,000+ educators.
The Classroom Mosaic Platform helps instruction leaders improve instructional practice by transforming observation data into actionable insights for monitoring educator growth and targeted professional development.
With Classroom Mosaic, you can:
- Accelerate Educator Growth
- Strengthen School Culture
- Increase Teacher Retention
WALKTHROUGHS & LEARNING WALKS & OBSERVATIONS
Classroom observations are simple and effective in Classroom Mosaic. You can create forms with rubrics, scripting notes, photos, and more. During an observation, you can navigate your form quickly and your data saves automatically. After completing an observation, your feedback instantly goes to the teacher and they can start a dialogue with you right from their inbox. Then you can use the dashboards and reports to identify trends, spot strengths and weaknesses, and understand instructional practice by combining all observations from your school or district.
TEACHER EVALUATION
The Classroom Mosaic platform makes teacher evaluation straightforward and efficient. All tasks, documents, and forms are in one spot for each of your evaluations. Along the way, helpful reminders are automatically sent to you and your teachers to complete items on time. You can easily stay on top of what you need to do and even add eSignatures when the time comes. With our evaluation tools, you can focus on coaching and don’t have to worry about compliance.
REPORTING
The dashboards and reports transform your data into something you can understand and use. All data captured is automatically aggregated and reported based on your forms. You can drill deep into your observation data to understand trends, identify strengths and weaknesses, and implement continuous improvement practices.
ABOUT US
We build helpful tools for instructional leaders. Our goal is to make you more efficient and effective. Over the last decade, our platform has helped tens of thousands of educators capture over 5 million minutes of instructional time. We’ve worked with individual schools to districts with more than 100,000 students. Sign up for a demo to learn more.

bluejetty:00088380:ios.name: Smart Battery Widget
bluejetty:00088380:ios.summary:
Understand your battery. Know your storage. Keep track of your data.
Smart Battery Widget combines AI-powered resource insights, practical usage estimates, and beautifully designed widgets to help you understand your iPhone and iPad at a gl
bluejetty:00088380:ios.description:
Understand your battery. Know your storage. Keep track of your data.
Smart Battery Widget combines AI-powered resource insights, practical usage estimates, and beautifully designed widgets to help you understand your iPhone and iPad at a glance.
■ AI INSIGHTS, POWERED BY APPLE INTELLIGENCE Make sense of your device’s recent battery, storage, and network activity with Resource Insights.
Get short, relevant observations based on recorded metrics, with practical suggestions when the data supports them. See whether network findings relate to Wi-Fi, cellular, or both. Insights focus on meaningful findings, keeping your summary clear and useful.
AI analysis runs privately on your device.
■ BATTERY ESTIMATES FOR EVERYDAY ACTIVITIES Go beyond a battery percentage. Explore estimates of how much usage time your current charge could provide for everyday activities.
Check your battery level, review recorded battery history, and keep useful estimates within reach through your widgets.
■ SEE WHAT YOUR STORAGE CAN HOLD Turn available space into something easier to understand. Explore estimates of how many photos, videos, audio files, or podcasts could fit on your device.
View total, used, and free storage to help plan your next download or recording.
■ FOLLOW YOUR WI-FI & CELLULAR USAGE Monitor uploads, downloads, and current transfer speeds in the app. Review network activity and track usage against your data package allowance.
■ WIDGETS THAT KEEP YOU INFORMED Choose the information and layout that suit your day:
• 3 battery widgets showing battery status and usage estimates 
• 3 storage widgets showing available space and storage estimates 
• 4 network graph widgets for data activity
 • 2 data package widgets for tracking your allowance 
• 2 Fusion Widgets combining battery, storage, and network metrics 
• 2 sets of Lock Screen widgets for battery level and history, plus available storage and graphs
Designed for iPhone and iPad. Some widgets require an in-app purchase.
PLEASE NOTE:
 AI insights require iOS 26 or later on a supported device with Apple Intelligence enabled and its model ready. Resource metrics remain available without Apple Intelligence.
Battery and storage estimates are approximate; actual results vary. AI-generated insights may be inaccurate. Widget refresh timing is managed by iOS.
We’d love to hear your ideas: 
smartbattery@smartbits-studio.com

bluejetty:00178092:ios.description:
تطبيق بوبيان مُصمّم ليوفّر لك أفضل الخدمات المصرفية أينما كنت. مع أكثر من 15 خدمة وميزة يتم إطلاقها لأول مرة في الكويت، يبقى تطبيق بوبيان في مركز الريادة في مجال الخدمات المصرفية الرقمية في الكويت.
كل خدمات الحسابات والبطاقات والودائع والتمويل في متناول يدك أينما كنت 
باستخدام التطبيق، يمكنك على الفور الاطّلاع على معاملات حساباتك، وتغيير رمز PIN الخاص ببطاقتك، ودفع أقساط التمويل، وإدارة الودائع، وحتى فتح حساب أو وديعة جديدة.
إرسال واستقبال الأموال في أي مكان وأي وقت 
يمكنك تحويل الأموال إلى أي مكان في العالم باستخدام التحويلات المصرفية العادية أو ويسترن يونيون. يمكنك أيضًا إرسال الأموال إلى أي حامل بطاقة مدنية كويتية واستلام المدفوعات فورًا من أي حامل بطاقة سحب آلي كويتية ببساطة من خلال مشاركة رابط الدفع معه.
سحب الأموال دون استخدام البطاقة المصرفية 
خدمة السحب بدون بطاقة متوفرة في جميع أجهزة الصراف الآلي لبوبيان في جميع أنحاء الكويت. اختر المبلغ من خلال التطبيق واستلمه من جهاز الصراف الآلي.
استبدال بطاقة مفقودة أو إصدار بطاقة جديدة
يمكنك ببساطة طلب بطاقة جديدة من خلال تطبيق بوبيان واستلامها من جهاز صراف آلي لبوبيان على مدار الساعة طوال أيام الأسبوع.
تعرّف على مساعد
تعرّف على مساعد، مساعدك الرقمي للخدمات المصرفية الشخصية. تحدّث معه واكتشف كل الخدمات التي يمكنه أن يقدمها لك.

" أفضل خدمة عملاء في الكويت" – Service Hero
The Boubyan App is designed to provide you with best-in-class banking service wherever you are. With over 15 services and features available for the first time in Kuwait, the Boubyan App continues to set the standard for digital banking in Kuwait.
Your accounts, cards, deposits, and financing at your fingertips
Using the App, you can instantly view your accounts transactions, change your card’s PIN code, make finance payments, manage your deposits, and even open a new account or a fixed deposit. 
Send and receive money anywhere and anytime
Transfer money to any place in the world using normal bank transfers or Western Union. You can also send money to any holder of a Kuwaiti Civil ID and receive payments instantly from any holder of a Kuwaiti debit card simply by sharing a payment link with them. 
Withdraw cash without using your card
The cardless withdrawal service is available at all Boubyan ATMs throughout Kuwait. Set the amount through the App and pick it up at the ATM.
Replace a lost card or issue a new one 
Simply request a new card through the Boubyan App and pick it up at a Boubyan ATM 24/7.

bluejetty:00136088:ios.description:
The Eko App turns every patient encounter into an early detection opportunity for heart and lung disease. It fits seamlessly into your physical exam workflow when connected to a compatible digital stethoscope.
Use the Eko App to:
 - Flag the presence of structural murmurs in as little as 5 seconds.
 - Flag the presence of AFib*, tachycardia, and bradycardia.
 - Run guided, multi-point exams to systematically assess a patient’s heart and lung sounds.
 - Listen wirelessly through a Bluetooth-enabled audio device.
 - Auto-connect to your stethoscope to capture recordings while keeping your phone tucked away.
 - Play back, annotate, and save stethoscope sounds and ECG*.
 - Build patient profiles to flag changes in a patient's condition across visits.
 - Organize exam data by room number, follow-up status, recording source, or any custom label.
 - Securely store exam recordings for future reference.
 - Generate and share PDF reports or a direct link to a recording with trusted colleagues or upload to compatible EHRs.
 - Aid in medical education and patient engagement.
*Available with the CORE 500™ Digital Stethoscope.
Select features may require a paid Eko+ membership and feature availability may vary by country. Visit ekohealth.com to learn more about compatible devices. Have questions or feedback? Contact us at support@ekohealth.com.
The Services are for informational purposes only and should not replace advice from a licensed healthcare provider for any medical condition or treatment. Please consult a licensed and qualified health care provider before making any medical decisions.

bluejetty:00150398:ios.description:
Simplify your everyday household routines with the smart power of the Maytag™ App.
Power through your daily tasks with the Maytag™ App by staying in control and efficiently managing your appliances from anywhere with smart features. With Maytag™ Smart Appliances, you can stay on top of tasks with notifications, select custom cycles, and remotely manage with your smartphone or voice commands using a Google Assistant or Alexa-enabled device.
Available Features 
* Real Time Notifications: get notified when a cycle has ended
* Favorites: create & save customized cycles
* Remote Start: start or stop your appliance from anywhere
Laundry Appliances Features
* Schedule Wash Cycle: get laundry done on your time by scheduling your wash cycle
* Stain Guide: steps to tackle everyday tough stains
* Specialty Cycles (select models only): access additional cycles like activewear & sleeping bags(Laundry)
* Assign a Task: keep laundry moving through customized texts to family members
Kitchen Appliances Features
* Smart Presets: simplify mealtime with Smart Presets that automatically set the right temp to saute, simmer, sear and more
* Remote Preheat: remotely preheat your oven from your smartphone or tablet so it's ready when you are
[PLEASE NOTE]
* Some mobile devices and operating systems may not be supported
* 2.4GHz router required
*Appliances must be set to remote enable. Compatible connected appliance required. Features subject to change. Details & privacy info at maytag.com/connect
*Google, Alexa and certain other trademarks are owned by their respective companies.
[REQUIRED PERMISSIONS]
* Location: find Wi-Fi networks to connect
* Bluetooth: allows for easy connection process
* Local network: allows for easy connection process
[OPTIONAL PERMISSIONS]
* Camera: scan QR codes for easy connection process
* Notifications: enables multiple app features like Cycle Notifications and Troubleshooting

bluejetty:00041944:ios.description:
When your friend, an Irish mythology expert, wants to check out a new Leprechaun museum of hidden object adventure games and artifacts, you’re both off to Ireland! But your luck quickly turns when her wish transports her through a pot of gold to the World of Leprechauns! Someone’s using magic to lure humans to their realm with mystery games, and only you can find out why. Do you have what it takes to uncover their sinister plan and rescue your friend in time? Find out in one of our sensational hidden objects games!
This is a special Collector’s Edition version of adventure games, which contains some extra materials that you won’t find in the standard version. The Collector’s Edition gives you lots of bonuses!
· STOP ANOTHER LEPRECHAUN IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
Join the quest in our hidden object games for ipad to capture Aaron McDawdle, failed student of magic. Magic has overwhelmed him! Keep him from assembling the Worlds Crown and the Drake Amulet. Restore the Taming Staff - and bring Aaron out of the magic trance!
· FIND HIDDEN OBJECTS AND TONS OF MIRACULOUS COLLECTIBLES!
Search for flying fairies, leprechaun figures, and Celtic crosses hidden throughout the detective games! You’ll be well rewarded for finding hidden pictures!
· REPLAY YOUR FAVORITE MYSTERY ADVENTURE GAMES - AND EARN EVEN MORE ACHIEVEMENTS!
Enjoy and save the extra wallpapers, concept art and music!
· KEEP YOUR ADVENTURE ON TRACK WITH THE STRATEGY GUIDE!
Stuck while playing search & find games and looking for items? The accessible Strategy Guide is always at hand! Use it whenever you don’t know what to do.
This game has a free trial part. You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.
-----

Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigame

bluejetty:00073025:ios.name: APEX Pro (Legacy)
bluejetty:00073025:ios.summary: APEX Pro is powerful, cost effective, data acquisition for motorsports. APEX Pro's mission is to lower the barrier to quality data acquisition by providing simple to use standalone hardware, controlled by your Apple/ iOS device, and the NEW
bluejetty:00073025:ios.description:
APEX Pro is powerful, cost effective, data acquisition for motorsports. APEX Pro's mission is to lower the barrier to quality data acquisition by providing simple to use standalone hardware, controlled by your Apple/ iOS device, and the NEW APEX Pro Lap Timer feature that does not require hardware.
 The APEX Pro Hardware uses a 9 Axis IMU, a 10HZ GPS and machine learning to model the track and your vehicle's capabilities. APEX provides real-time feedback via LED's while in car and extensive information on the app post driving session. 
 Who is APEX Pro for? APEX helps drivers learn to drive the car at the limit of the tire's grip. Whether you are a racer, track day driver, or autocrosser, that is a valuable skill to have. It is a Grip Gauge that shows you where extra grip is being left on the table. APEX Pro customers participate in all types of four wheeled motorsports: Road Racing, Autocross, Rally, Track Days/ HPDE, Time Attack. 
 What does APEX offer with the APEX Pro Hardware? 10 x GPS accuracy and frequency of the smartphone GPS, APEX’s proprietary machine learning model (APEX Score) for real-time, in-car analysis, MPH/KPH selection, Crew View: Access Live Feed posting of User Records, Ability to post laps to “Top Ten” record board, Extensive post-session analysis, Overlay APEX Score, Speed, Lat G, Long G, OBDII channels (with OBDII hardware), Yaw Rate on GPS image, histogram plots, X,Y chart, and Scatterplot, Lap Replay, Interactive Speedometer, Light Bar replay, AirDrop Data sharing, Overlay laps from different days or sessions at the same track. Gain/ Loss Time overlay on GPS Satellite image. 
 What does the App offer with APEX Pro OBDII? 
 For everyday use: Gage cluster for live engine data. Check engine light (MIL) diagnostic codes. Zero-to-sixty MPH timer. 
 For racing: High quality GPS Lap Timing with Phone GPS, Access to Crew View Live feed, GPS Satellite image overlay with heat maps showing Speed and Long. G, Speed trace and histogram plots for further analysis, OBDII data channels recorded, Lap replay function with interactive speedometer, AirDrop data sharing for data overlay with other drivers on the same track, Auto track selection at hundreds of official tracks around the world. Toggle “Enable Phone GPS Logging” to use the app with no APEX Pro Hardware.
 What does the App offer with 'Lap Timer Plus' subscription?
 After your first lap on track, the timer can be used to show your predicted lap time or the delta between your current lap and your best so far. This allows competitive drivers to quickly identify the effect of changes in the driving line or the effect of traffic. For review, the track can be split into sectors and a theoretical best lap calculated to set goals for your next session. Video can be recorded during a driving session and then rendered with data overlays after the session.
Please visit www.apextrackcoach.com for detailed information, FAQ’s / documentation, videos and more.
Follow @officialapexpro on Facebook and Instagram!

bluejetty:00021953:ios.name: Mandel Draw
bluejetty:00021953:ios.summary:
Mandel Draw is an application that allows you to enjoy fractals, Mandelbrot sets and filled Julia sets, in a fast and comfortable way.
The app allows you to draw an infinite number of fractal images from up to 80 different functions, 20+α
bluejetty:00021953:ios.description:
Mandel Draw is an application that allows you to enjoy fractals, Mandelbrot sets and filled Julia sets, in a fast and comfortable way.
The app allows you to draw an infinite number of fractal images from up to 80 different functions, 20+α color palettes, and freely configurable Julia parameters.
Operation is simple. Drag to move, pinch to zoom in and out. Double- and triple-tap operations are also available.
Convenient settings are also available.
- Use DF64 operation: Double the float operation to make it possible to zoom in more. (Disabled in the Appendix 1,2)
- Select render version: Two types of rendering methods can be selected.
- Display coordinates and magnification: The current coordinates and magnification will be displayed on the screen.
- Output detailed information: Add detailed information to the text when sharing.
- High-resolution output: Outputs at 4 times the vertical and horizontal resolution when sharing.
- iCloud Sync: Share favorites and My Palette with another iPhone or iPad.
In addition, all functions are available when unlocked with in-app purchase.
1) All functions are selectable
2) All palettes can be selected
3) Up to 2000 favorites can be saved
4) Maximum number of My Palettes that can be saved is now 30.
Now, please enjoy the wonderful and mysterious world of fractals.
What is a fractal?
Simply put, a fractal is a self-similar figure that does not lose its complexity no matter how much it is enlarged.
(Though computers have their limitations.)
There are various fractal shapes, such as the Koch curve, Sierpinski's gasket, and Menger's sponge.
The Mandelbrot set and the filled Julia set are fractals drawn computationally on the complex plane.

bluejetty:00158314:ios.summary:

Built for school admi
bluejetty:00158314:ios.description:
Car rider dismissal, done right. Carline Hound is the fast, safe, and stress-free school car rider line app that turns chaotic afternoon carpool pickup into a smooth, coordinated dismissal across your entire building.
Built for school administrators and staff — not parents — Carline Hound takes the frustration out of organizing students for the car rider line, so dismissal moves faster and kids get to the right car, safely.
WHY SCHOOLS CHOOSE CARLINE HOUND
- One low-cost subscription covers your whole school — No per-user or per-student fees.
- A fraction of the cost of competing carline and school dismissal software.
- Dismiss car riders from the classroom or a central assembly point — you choose.
- Show the live pickup list on any TV or Smartboard so staff, teachers, and students see upcoming cars and student names in real time.
KEY FEATURES
- Bulk-import your car riders from an XLSX spreadsheet (names, carpool numbers, and teachers).
- Set the number of pickup spots in your school's car line.
- Move forward and back through the dismissal list at any time.
- Email-verified, password-protected accounts to protect student privacy and safety.
- School-approved access — new users must be approved before they can join.
HOW CARLINE HOUND WORKS Each car rider family is assigned a number and displays it on arrival (up to 4 carpool numbers per vehicle). Four synced roles keep dismissal moving:
Walker — records the numbers shown by each car as it pulls into the pickup line.
Marshal — watches names appear in the assembly area and dismisses groups of students to their cars.
Classroom View — shows each teacher which of their students are up next, so they know exactly when to send a child to the pickup point.
Large Display — broadcasts upcoming groups to a big screen so the whole room stays ready.
Every view advances automatically as the Marshal dismisses each group — keeping classrooms, marshals, and walkers perfectly in sync.
Speed up dismissal, cut the chaos, and keep students safer — for a fraction of the cost of the competition.
Download Carline Hound and make car rider dismissal the easiest part of your school day.
EULA — https://carlinehound.com/eula/ 
Privacy Policy — https://carlinehound.com/privacy-policy/

Welcome to this exciting bubble shooter world and enjoy the fun of cool bubble shooting!
Bubble shooter! Ball blast is an addictive bubble pop game, offline and fun, with thousands of relaxing puzzle levels! Get ready to aim, shoot bubbles along the board!
Train your brain in this game!
Choose the colorful balls, and launch the bubble! Match colors, solve puzzles, enjoy and relax! If you can't distinguish the color, then look for the same pattern to match! Train your brain and kill boredom!
Features of Bubble shooter! Ball blast:
- Once you shoot, you don't want to stop! The bubble shooter game is a time killer!
- Accept the challenge, click and shoot! Pop bubbles! Break through the bubble wall and enjoy endless shooting!
- Thousands of great levels! The most classic bubble shooting game that can train your brain!
- Well-designed and wonderful effects! Perfect to enjoy and relax this fun bubble blitz game in a fantastic pop bubbles world!
- No wireless network! No internet! Pop up on the go! Enjoy offline bubble shooting anytime, anywhere!
- There are new bubble burst, fantastic boosters, fireballs and cool special elements!
How to play Shooter Bubble blasting bubble game?
- Enter any challenge level and switch the colorful bubbles you need!
- Swipe your finger to find the right angle, release to shoot! Or aim carefully and click to shoot bubbles of the same color!
- Match 3 or more bubbles and make all bubbles explode! Find the most efficient way to clear the level!
- Complete levels to unlock new achievement missions and get extra bubble shooter rewards!

bluejetty:00016465:ios.description:
Slime fun？We love it. How about add some rainbow colors glitter into your slime and then have crazy fun with it? Now it’s the chance. “Glitter Slime Maker” helps you make fluffy glitter slime at home. The game has all the make and play features which not only demonstrates you how to make glitter slime but also teaches you how to make slime fulfilling its purposes to be part of learning. Let’s get started.
Features:
- Rainbow Glitter Dumpling Squishy Slime
- Golden Dumpling Slime
- Unicorn Glitter Slime
- Glitter Slime at Night

- Choose the glitter you like to make.

- Pour the borax mixture to the glitter and mix them slowly. 
- Add until the slime is ok to play.
- Have fun with your glitter slime, Wow, endless fun.
Come on now, Let’s have fun together.

MULTI-TABBED BROWSING

SYNC FOLDERS AUTOMATICALLY

BACKUP FOLDERS
Backup folders, such as the Camera Roll to a network or cloud folder. Changes are automatically uploaded.
SECURITY AND ENCRYPTION
FileBrowserGO securely stores your passwords in the iOS keychain and uses iOS file encryption features.

bluejetty:00034561:ios.name: mood.camera
bluejetty:00034561:ios.summary: mood.camera is a point-and-shoot camera that captures natural photos full of character, straight out of your iPhone, without any editing. Instead of chasing ever-sharper and perfectly exposed images, mood.camera focuses on making photograph
bluejetty:00034561:ios.description:
mood.camera is a point-and-shoot camera that captures natural photos full of character, straight out of your iPhone, without any editing. Instead of chasing ever-sharper and perfectly exposed images, mood.camera focuses on making photography fun and giving your photographs soul.
The custom image processing pipeline gives you photos with realistic film grain, cinematic halation and a rich colour palette. mood.camera also has no live "filter" preview or editing tools within the app, encouraging you to enjoy taking photos without worrying about flipping between effects or making the perfect edit.
mood.camera wasn't built to evoke nostalgia, it was built to bring character and serendipity back to the mobile photography experience.
—
“This Camera App Gives Your iPhone Photos Soul.” - New York Times
"It’s Hard to Believe the Photos From Mood.Camera’s New Portrait Mode Were Shot on iPhone" - PetaPixel
"mood.camera emulates the feeling of taking photos on camera film" - Tech Radar
—
TRY FOR 7 DAYS FREE
Please note, mood.camera is not free. We offer a 7-day unrestricted free trial for new users, no subscription required. After your trial you can continue to use the app for free but you will be limited to the “random” emulation mode. To continue using the full version of the app after your trial period you can either purchase a lifetime membership or pay a monthly subscription.
EXPRESSIVE COLOUR EMULATION
Each of the 14 colour emulations have been meticulously crafted to give every photo character and a rich colour palette.
FILMIC DYNAMIC RANGE
Naturally compressed shadows and highlights create images with more contrast, more atmosphere, and a look that feels closer to film.
REALISTIC FILM GRAIN
Film grain algorithms modelled on the physical development process, add texture and physicality to your photos whilst retaining detail.
CUSTOM PRESETS
Add a touch of warmth to your favourite preset, or start from scratch to create an original style.
NEXT LEVEL PORTRAITS
Choose from 7 lenses, each modelled on the physical properties of real optics, producing unique bokeh shapes, swirl and aberration. (Available on iPhone 11 or newer).
DOUBLE EXPOSURE MODE
7 unique ways to blend photos unlocks new creative possibilities with your photography. 
CINEMATIC HALATION
Using the iPhone’s dynamic range gain map to accurately identify the brightest highlights, creating a realistic halation effect. (Available on iPhone 12 or newer).
CUSTOM FRAMES
Elevate your photos with a custom frame, automatically added when you snap a photo.
LESS TWEAKING, MORE SNAPPING
Mirroring the classic film camera experience, there is no live preview of your selected film, letting you focus on capturing the moment instead of flipping between filters. After each capture, the element of suspense as you reveal the processed photo is another nod to the analog experience.
INTUITIVE CONTROLS FOR CREATIVITY
At its core, mood.camera is designed to echo the ease of use of a point-and-shoot camera but retains some controls to inspire creativity and personal expression:
- Set the default focal lengths for each lens, giving you quick access to your favourites.
- An on-screen exposure dial, makes it easy to achieve different styles with under and over exposed images.
- Select from multiple aspect ratios to suit the scene.
- An optional grid & level indicator gives you confidence when composing.
- High resolution 24MP photos on compatible devices. (Available on iPhone 14 Pro, 15 Pro & 16 Pro).
- Customise the dynamic range of your camera. (Available on iPhones capable of ProRaw capture).
More info: https://mood.camera
Privacy Policy: https://mood.camera/privacy 
End User Licensee Agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00180217:ios.description:
The Driver App that works the way you do. Samsara Driver gives professional drivers everything they need to stay safe, complete daily tasks faster, get recognized for their work, and stay connected—no matter where the job takes them. Whether you’re managing Hours of Service (HOS) compliance, completing vehicle inspections, or navigating to your next stop, Samsara Driver brings your most important workflows together in one easy-to-use app.
Stay on track with your Compliance
 • Log and certify your Hours of Service directly in the app
 • Receive alerts for upcoming breaks and potential violations
 • Access and share inspection reports with roadside officials in a second
Stay safe on the road
 • See safety scores, active coaching tasks, and key performance trends.
 • Review and acknowledge safety events directly in the app.
 • Complete training in short, mobile-friendly formats.
Complete everyday workflows
 • Access tasks, documents, routes, and forms in just a few taps.
 • Submit DVIRs and inspections with a few clicks and no paper.
 • Reduce skipped steps with guided, tile-based workflows.
Get recognized & stay motivated
 • View scorecards, badges, and streaks.
 • Receive kudos for great driving.
 • Track milestones and climb the leaderboard.
Access help when it matters
 • Get routing guidance and real-time navigation.
 • Message managers or dispatch without leaving the app.
 • Use SOS to call for help or flag emergencies.
Why drivers love Samsara Driver
 • Easy access to the tools and workflows you use every day.
 • End-of-day recaps reinforce safe habits and recognize achievements.
 • Built-in gamification keeps you engaged and motivated.

bluejetty:00148433:ios.description:
First Mobile Banking Application for SME
We know that you love doing everything on your phone from fixing plans with your friends to get the latest news updates to shopping for your favorite brand. So when you live this digital life, why should banking be any different?
Presenting the all-new Mobile banking app for SMEs, JuicePro By MCB – your go-to mobile banking app for SMEs that seamlessly combines the thrill of modern living with the utmost professionalism and advanced security for your everyday banking needs.
JuicePro By MCB brings the power of a bank branch directly to your fingertips, offering an array of services that are not only safe and secure but also incredibly user-friendly. Here's a taste of what you can expect:
Quick & Secure Login: Access the app securely with your biometrics or MPIN.
Account Overview: Get a quick snapshot of all your account balances.
Transaction History: Swipe through your most recent transactions for quick reference.
Loan Insights: Dive into the details of your repayments and interest rates.
Effortless Payments: Swiftly transfer funds between MCB accounts and other local banks.
Multi-Signatory Approvals: Streamline transactions for companies with multiple signatories.
Scan-to-Pay: Effortlessly make on-the-go payments with a simple scan.
Beneficiary Management: Easily manage and locate beneficiaries with our handy search bar.
Overdraft Solutions: Obtain an overdraft within five working days to manage unexpected cash flow challenges.
Foreign Currency Transfer: Transfer money around the world in multiple currencies, safely and seamlessly.
And that's just the beginning! We're continually enhancing your banking experience with exciting new features.
How to join us and be a part of #JuicePro?
Just log in with your username and password. Create your MPIN and voila, now you are part of #JuicePro, enjoy all the amazing features of our app. 
Don’t have a username yet? We’ve got you covered. Just create one within our app with your Card details.
Become a #JuicePro member.
Embrace the future of banking with #JuicePro. Download the app now and simplify your life!!

bluejetty:00165289:ios.description:
Margins is a beautifully designed app for people who love books.
- App of the Day in 20+ countries
- 4.9 rating (40,000+ reviews)
- Featured in USA Today, BookRiot, and more
TRACK YOUR READING
 - Log books, series, authors, recommendations, and more
- Track Strava-style goals, stats, and streaks
- Curate lists of books you care about
SEARCH BOOKS BY VIBES
- Search books by mood, plot, setting, vibe, and more
- Try things like “books like 1920s Paris,” “thriller with a love triangle,” or “indie romantasy”
- You can even turn images from Pinterest or your camera roll into book recommendations
BLOCK DISTRACTING APPS
- Block social media, notifications, and other apps while you read
- Use meditation reading timer for soothing rain sounds
CHOOSE YOUR COVERS
- Pick the cover that matches your version of the book
- Curate covers to fit your aesthetic
- Sort your library by color
CUSTOMIZE YOUR PROFILE
- Turn your picture into a sketched portrait you’d see in a book
- Show off your favorite books
SEE WHAT FRIENDS ARE READING
- Find and follow other book lovers
- See what they’re reading in Stories
- Enjoy gorgeous, hand-illustrated monthly recaps
INVITE YOUR BOOK CLUB
- Schedule gatherings
- Suggest and vote on books
- Log your club’s history
LEAVE GOODREADS FOR GOOD
- Import from Goodreads, StoryGraph, and Fable
- Half-star ratings
- Support a small, indie team
WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING
“LOVE this app! so easy to import data from goodreads. it excels where others fail. like letterboxd for books. Really glad there’s finally a good book app out there, i’ve been waiting for something like this!” — scruffythejanitor01
“I love the UI of this app, easy to use and aesthetically pleasing. Also, I've been struggling getting back into reading and the screentime feature has helped me loads. I haven't been able to read this much since 4 years ago. Thank you Margins” — mitakaluvr
“The search by vibes is so cool. I am a WWII buff, but this search popped up a two-book WWII saga I had never even heard of, much less read. It ended up being my top read of 2025.” —Michigancolt
FREE TO USE
Almost all features are free to use. An optional subscription unlocks premium features and priority support. 
FOLLOW US
Instagram: @readwithmargins 
TikTok: @margins
TERMS OF USE
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Margins Terms of Service: https://margins.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://margins.app/privacy
“Without the margins, writing is just words on a page. But with them, each of us is invited to leave our mark in the endless conversation between books and the people that love them.” — Excerpt from the Margins manifesto

bluejetty:00022478:ios.name: Hiking and Skiing - PeakVisor
bluejetty:00022478:ios.summary: PeakVisor will make you a champion of mountain navigation, putting state-of-the-art Peak Identification, 3D Maps, Trails, and outdoor GPS tracking into the palm of your hand. Our app is a one-stop shop for all your mountain adventures: hiki
bluejetty:00022478:ios.description:
PeakVisor will make you a champion of mountain navigation, putting state-of-the-art Peak Identification, 3D Maps, Trails, and outdoor GPS tracking into the palm of your hand. Our app is a one-stop shop for all your mountain adventures: hiking, skiing, climbing, mountain biking, and more. But PeakVisor is more than just another outdoors app; it’s an immersion into a carefully crafted 3D world that will give you an unprecedented understanding of the nuances of a mountain’s terrain. 
“PeakVisor uses your iPhone’s camera and augmented reality (AR) technology to display names and elevations of nearby peaks. The information will appear on your phone like magic.” 
- App Store, Take the Trail Less Traveled
Here’s a brief orientation on the tools we offer to get oriented in the mountains:
● 3D Maps
As human athletic achievement progresses in the mountains, so does the technology to assist your adventures. With PeakVisor, you unlock the topo maps of the future; our cutting-edge technology with high-precision terrain modeling offers deep insight into the mountain landscape of your choice. With one glance, you be blessed with years of knowledge about an area’s terrain.
● Identify Peaks
Identify more than a million mountains, hills, buttes, spires, and more from all over the world, with a detailed profile for each of them! Our app shows you altitude, topographic prominence, mountain range, national parks or reserves, as well as photos and additional Wikipedia articles.
● Plan Hiking Routes
A vast network of worldwide hiking trails and walking pathways included in PeakVisor’s 3D Maps will help you compose a hiking route which includes evaluating the distance you can expect to hike as well as a route’s elevation profile and estimated time for completion.
● Skiing
In winter mountain sports, PeakVisor’s topographic 3D Maps allow a visual understanding of the terrain and provide detailed information about mountain lifts, ski resort trails, and backcountry ski touring routes. The app also offers features such as winter mode and a slope steepness overlay to identify avalanche terrain on your route.
● Cable Cars and Mountain Huts are inlaid onto our 3D Maps, complete with schedules. This is especially useful in Europe, where many objectives involve a cable car ride to gain some altitude, lest you want to do some genuinely punishing climbs. And you haven’t experienced the old-world mountain culture until you’ve had a memorable meal and night at a rustic mountain hut in the high country. 
● Peak Bagging
The app offers monthly climbing challenges and Peak Bagging competitions to keep the motivation where it needs to be…UP. 
● Animated Flyover Videos
You can even initiate a ‘Flyover,’ our visually stunning animations that give you a token video of your route to show family and friends or inspire some memories down the road.
● GPS Tracking
Track any outdoor adventures, whether hiking, skiing, mountain biking, etc. Post-adventure, you can visualize your route in the miniature 3D world, check out stats like distance and elevation gain, and export a GPX file of your new route.
● Lock-Screen Navigation
● All Features Work Offline
PeakVisor is the Swiss army knife for outdoor adventure, one that you will soon find indispensable while in the mountains. With so many features at your fingertips, you’ll find value from the app whenever you're on the trail.
PeakVisor PRO is a premium subscription that allows you to use the app without any limitations. By subscribing to PeakVisor PRO you make it possible for us to focus on the continued development of the app. PeakVisor PRO is available as a monthly or annual subscription. We have no advertising on the app; all revenue comes from our user subscriptions. We constantly modify the app and offer an update each week, always with new features and fewer bugs. You may find more details in our Terms and Privacy Policy by the link → https://peakvisor.com/en/terms.html

Fashion Glow: Where Style Dress Up Meets Stardom! 
Step into the glamorous world of Fashion Glow, where your creativity and styling skills shine! Become a trendsetting fashion icon as you design stunning looks, dominate fashion challenges, and steal the spotlight at every fashion show. Whether you're passionate about fashion design, experimenting in a makeup salon, or creating jaw-dropping looks, this is your ultimate destination for style and sophistication.
As a rising fashion designer, transform models into dazzling fashion idols with chic outfits and bold makeup styles. Compete in thrilling fashion battles, craft your unique fashion story, and prove yourself as the ultimate super stylist. Get ready for an exciting fashion adventure that’s packed with glamour and creativity!
Why Fashion Glow is Perfect for You
- Unleash Your Style: Mix and match outfits and accessories to create glamorous looks.
- Be the Best: Dominate fashion challenges and earn your place as a top fashionista.
- Master Makeup & Hair: Experiment with bold makeup styles and chic hairstyles in the makeup salon.
- Live the Dream: Dive into the world of high fashion and rise as a renowned makeup stylist.
- Challenge Yourself: Embark on exciting fashion adventures and express your creativity.
- Offline Fun: No internet? No problem! Enjoy the game anywhere, anytime.
Key Features
- Style models with a wardrobe full of glamorous outfits and stunning accessories.
- Unlock and explore bold makeup styles in the makeup studio.
- Compete in fashion battles to climb the style leaderboard and prove your talent.
- Showcase your fashion design skills with unique pieces for the runway.
- Experience a captivating fashion story with thrilling challenges.
- Shine at the fashion show and claim the title of Fashion Glow.
Why You'll Love It
If you're a fan of dress up games for girls, this is your chance to become a fashion icon and rule the world of high fashion. From creating the perfect glam look to competing in exciting fashion challenges, Fashion Glow lets you express your creativity, show off your fashion designer skills, and live your ultimate fashionista dreams.
Are you ready to become the ultimate Fashion Glow? Download Fashion Glow now and start your glamorous journey!

bluejetty:00048363:android.description:
A very simple and comprehensive application that will teach you all that is necessary for self-development and building self-confidence, as well as raising strength
Personal.
Building self-confidence is not very difficult, it is only a simple exercise periodically that will enable you to build self-confidence and personal strength.
You will notice that the application combines the advice advised by Dr. Ibrahim Al-Feki and Dr. Ahmed Emara. All these tips are summarized for you in less than 40 minutes of reading only and will help you boost your self-confidence.
An application development team hopes that our application will help in developing your self-confidence.
The application can also save you from searching again for the best self-confidence books or books on self-development and self-confidence because it is more comprehensive and shorter at the same time.
Self-confidence building app will help you develop self and build personal strength
Self-confidence is a thoughtful inner security in which the individual depends on his aptitudes, capabilities and skills, and the extent to which he is able to implement all his goals by relying on his self-confidence. This means achieving psychological and social harmony. It can also be defined as the individual's perception of his abilities, qualifications, self-confidence, ability and employability in facing all the problems and obstacles that he encounters in the form of the individual.
Self-confidence is a mixture of self-efficacy and self-respect, and self-confidence is an important part of the human character of every individual.
 Self-efficacy is the belief and the inner feeling that a person enables him to achieve various goals and tasks in this life. bluejetty:00093523:ios.description:
Get the official AIA Events app! It’s your go-to digital conference companion for all AIA events, including the AIA Conference on Architecture & Design, Women’s Leadership Summit, and AIA Leadership Summit.
Designed to enhance your experience and make the most of your time, this app gives you the tools to navigate your event effectively and efficiently.
Through the AIA Events app, you can:
• Access the full conference schedule including dates, times, and locations
• Build your personal schedule, including CE sessions and one-on-one meetings
• Get real-time updates to stay informed about changes and fun surprises
• Connect with and get to know fellow attendees and speakers
• Share your conference experience out on social media
About AIA events: Browse AIA’s full event calendar at aia.org/community/events, including conferences, webinars, and educational sessions on topics across the built environment. With events throughout the year, you can connect with and learn from the AIA community and the greater AEC industry on a variety of topics.
About the AIA Conference on Architecture & Design: The AIA Conference on Architecture & Design is the premier AEC industry event. It brings together the architecture and design communities to network, share knowledge, spark creativity, and uncover new solutions to design a better world. Through keynotes, education, events, tours, and the industry’s largest expo, the annual conference fosters cross-industry collaborations and solutions to showcase the strength of the AEC industry.
About Women’s Leadership Summit: WLS is a premier leadership experience that brings together the industry’s largest network of women who are breaking down barriers, making themselves visible, and manifesting the careers they want—while making a difference in the world. It’s three days of high-impact programming, networking, education, community, and inspiration designed to help create gender equity for women in AEC.
About AIA Leadership Summit: AIA Leadership Summit is the premier advocacy and leadership training event for AIA chapter leaders. One of AIA’s best attended leadership events, it offers attendees a unique platform to engage in critical policy discussions with lawmakers in Washington, D.C. while enhancing their leadership skills.

bluejetty:00149548:ios.description:
RequestBox is an app that enables you to manage song requests at events and venues.
Hosting an event?
Use RequestBox to create a box for your guests to drop their song requests in. You can create a box to get song requests in advance to help prepare a setlist. Or create a box during the party and receive live requests.
Guest at a party?
As a guest, you can influence the music by dropping song requests or by voting on other guests requests. You can also create an account to follow your favorite hosts/DJs and be the first to know when they create a new box.
Note: RequestBox does not manage music playback. It is up to the host to use their preferred platform to source and play the music.
Main features:
• No sign ups required for guests. Just download the app, search for the box and request away.
• Search for your favorite songs with the help of Spotify search
• Boxes can be opened for up to 48 hours. You can also set a pin code for access, modify the request interval per guest and much more.
• Optional Spotify playlist integration for your box.
* Spotify features may be limited to territories and regions where Spotify is available

bluejetty:00118952:ios.description:
DialMyCalls is your go-to solution for mass communication. Send mass text messages, voice broadcasts, and emergency alerts in seconds. Whether you're a business, school, church, or community leader, you have the tools to communicate quickly, clearly, and affordably.
What You Can Do
Send high-volume text messages using our intuitive mass texting platform.
Broadcast voice messages to thousands with our voice broadcast app
Use the free version to message up to 25 contacts weekly — perfect for small groups
Schedule automated text messages and voice calls for future delivery
Set up auto-reply texts and SMS auto-response messages
Group your contacts to send targeted SMS and voice messages
Access mass calling features with voicemail drop if calls go unanswered
Use Cases
Schools and Educators - Share emergency notifications, closure alerts, and event reminders with parents, staff, and students using our school text messaging tools
Businesses and Enterprises - Send time-sensitive SMS alerts for internal updates, shift changes, and operations
Churches and Faith Groups - Notify members of service times, fundraisers, or prayer meetings with group texts and automated voice calls
HOAs and Residential Communities - Share maintenance notices, event updates, or urgent alerts with mass SMS and voice messages
Events and Conferences - Manage guest lists and send reminders or updates for weddings, conferences, and local gatherings
Emergency Services - Distribute emergency notifications instantly with our mass call and text broadcast features
Healthcare Providers - Send appointment reminders, health updates, and vaccination alerts using SMS and auto-reply messaging
Marketing and Promotions - Promote flash sales, special offers, and new products with mass text campaigns
Contractors and Service Providers - Keep customers informed with text alerts for appointments, updates, and service delays
Training and Workshops - Notify attendees of schedule changes, materials, and logistics with group texting and auto-response features
How It Works
Type or record a message. Select your contacts. Send or schedule instantly. Unanswered voice calls go directly to voicemail.
Flexible Access
Everything syncs in real time across mobile and desktop.
Secure and Private
DialMyCalls keeps your data safe. We never sell your contact information. All communications are encrypted and compliant with leading data standards.
Why We’re Different
Free to get started — message up to 25 contacts weekly
Pay-as-you-go pricing with no subscriptions or contracts
Works as a business texting platform or emergency notification system
Includes voicemail drop, push-to-talk, and press-1 calling options
Supports message scheduling, auto-replies, and two-way texting
Works with landline texting and web-to-phone broadcasting
Offers real-time delivery reports, opt-out management, and voice logs
Trusted by over 40,000 organizations nationwide
US-based support available 7 days a week
Need help? Call 1-800-928-2086 or visit DialMyCalls.com to learn more.

WowApp

bluejetty:00087119:ios.description:
WowApp
Win. Share. Do Good
WowApp is a FREE revolutionary platform that allows you to win rewards as a result of your daily activities. Once you have received rewards with WowApp, the choice is yours: you can either cash out for yourself or choose to do good for others by donating to one of the 2,000 supported charities, in over 110 countries.
Income inequality is the defining challenge of our time! Based on the Wowism ideology, WowApp was born as a solution to this problem. Through Universal Basic Income (UBI), we want to create a world where every human being is empowered and has access to a daily income. 
Our logo is a visual reminder of our attempt to initiate a movement that transfers wealth from those who don’t need it to those who need it. We do this by introducing a New Sharing Economy where the majority of economic benefit is shared with the community.
Inside the WowApp sharing economy, you can win rewards from the many activities that you were doing before for free. With WowApp, you can get rewarded from:
• UNIVERSAL BASIC INCOME (UBI): Collect your daily digital incomes
• GAMES: Win Rewards and Do Good by playing your favorite games
• SHOPPING ONLINE: Get Cashback and Do Good when purchasing from over 10,000 online shops, worldwide
• TALK: Win Rewards and Do Good by getting cashback if you need to make paid calls at super low rates
• INSTANT EARN: Win Rewards instantly and Do Good from our daily offers
• STORE CREDIT: Do Good and Get Cashback that you can convert to gift cards 
WowApp is free! Our community members do not pay anything in order to get rewarded. 
And most importantly, every day you use WowApp, you do good in the world because a part of your daily rewards from each activity is automatically donated to the charity of your choice. Imagine a world where each and every one of us is a benefactor every single day!
Invite your friends to join you in WowApp and use together the many great features of the app daily. The more active you and your network members are, the more rewards you receive!
The power is in your hands. Join the WowApp community and start Earning Sharing Doing Good!
(*)
Some chat features such as Share Location are location based.
For the best chat experience, WowApp requires access to Notifications, Address Book and Gallery/Camera.
Microphone access is required in order to use the Calling feature.

This is the official mobile app of the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. Make your iPhone or iPad a unique part of your Buccaneers gameday experience. Want to catch breaking news of the team, get real-time statistics for every drive, watch video-on-demand clips of press conferences and player interviews, and follow postgame stories and pregame previews of each matchup?You can get all of this and more! Stay in touch with the Buccaneers anytime, anywhere, on your iPhone or iPad.FEATURES include:- News: Real-time breaking news from the Buccaneers, previews of upcoming matchups, postgame stories

• Photos: Gallery of game-time action
• Audio: Podcasts and radio shows
• Stats: Real-time statistics and scores from the official NFL stats engine, head-to-head stats of the matchup, player stats, drive-by-drive stats, box score, out-of-town scores around the league
• Standings: Division and conference standings
• Depth Chart: Shown by offense, defense and special teams
• Schedule: Upcoming games, scores/stats of previous games from the season, and ticket purchases
• Concessions: Interactive map of the stadium with searchable concession stands and amenities
• Problem Reporting: Reports of various problems and issues around the stadium
• Brand new home screen design
• Personalized experiences based off location and membership
• Secure Digital Ticketing
• Krewe Card

Emojinate - Funny Emoji Maker
Craft unique emojis to add your personal flair to every message!
Our Emojinate seamlessly integrates with popular chat apps like iMessage, Telegram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and more, ensuring your custom emojis shine across all platforms.
Get ready to elevate your messaging game with Emojinate, the ultimate tool for unleashing your creativity in digital conversations. Customization Galore: Dive into a world of endless possibilities with our extensive library of facial features, accessories, and backgrounds. Mix and match to your heart's content, creating emojis that perfectly capture your mood, expression, or message.

Seamless Sharing: Share your emojis directly from the app to your favorite messaging platforms or save them to your device for later use. Spread smiles and laughter with your personalized creations wherever you go.
With Emojinate, your messages will never be boring. Transform ordinary texts into vibrant expressions of your personality and creativity. Download now and let your imagination run wild!

Feel the power of SmartSolve as it completely redefines how you study, write, learn languages, summarize texts, rewrite content, venture into coding, and more. Download now and experience the future of learning and creativity!

bluejetty:00144975:ios.name: Liftin' - Gym Workout Tracker
bluejetty:00144975:ios.summary:
Liftin' is the gym tracker for people who lift. Log a set with one tap, let your weights progress automatically, and build the program you want with AI, on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch.
TRACK WITH ONE TAP
• A clean workout screen that
bluejetty:00144975:ios.description:
Liftin' is the gym tracker for people who lift. Log a set with one tap, let your weights progress automatically, and build the program you want with AI, on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch.
TRACK WITH ONE TAP
• A clean workout screen that puts your next set front and center. Log it, let the rest timer run, move on.
• Live Activity and widgets keep the current set and the rest timer on your Lock Screen.
• 300+ exercises with illustrations, plus your own custom exercises.
• Plate calculator, warmup sets, supersets, notes, and a rest timer that follows you to the watch.
PROGRESS AUTOMATICALLY
• Set a progression rule per exercise and Liftin' adjusts the weights from your results: linear progression, 5/3/1 training max cycles, double progression, deloads.
• Start from a built-in program: StrongLifts 5x5, Wendlers 5/3/1, nSuns, GZCLP, Push Pull Legs, Upper/Lower, PHUL and Full Body. Or build your own from scratch.
• Charts for every exercise, estimated one rep max, volume, body measurements and progress photos, plus a calendar of your training.
AI THAT KNOWS YOUR TRAINING
• Describe the workout or program you want in your own words and Liftin' generates it with Apple Intelligence.
• Liftin' in ChatGPT and Claude: ask how your bench press is progressing, add 2.5 kg to every deadlift set next week, or have a 3-day strength program built, from the assistant you already use. Works with any MCP client.
APPLE WATCH
• Track a whole workout from the watch alone, or mirror the workout running on your iPhone live on your wrist.
• Heart rate and workouts go to Apple Health and fill your rings.
INTEGRATIONS
• Apple Health and Strava: your strength workouts land where the rest of your training lives.
• Import your history from Hevy. Export everything as CSV whenever you want.
• iCloud sync keeps iPhone, iPad and Mac on the same page.
LIFTIN' UNLIMITED
Liftin' is free for up to five workouts a month. Liftin' Unlimited removes the limit and unlocks all progress charts and progress photos, as a yearly or monthly subscription with a free trial, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Current prices are shown in the app.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before that period ends. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in your App Store account settings after purchase.
Terms of use: https://liftinapp.co/terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://www.iubenda.com/privacy-policy/67887263
Liftin' is made by one person in Stockholm. Questions and ideas are welcome at feedback@liftinapp.co. Good luck with your Liftin'!

This is our app with World Cup Football 2026 schedule. In this app you will see World Cup 2026 schedule in Bengali. You can find out more about Football World Cup 2026 points table, find out which country will play in which group team in World Cup 2026, and learn more about all the stadiums of 2026 World Cup from this app.

bluejetty:00131955:ios.name: Teen Counseling
bluejetty:00131955:ios.summary: Teen Counseling lets you connect with a licensed therapist who specializes in helping teens like you. Whenever you need and wherever you are, just text your therapist or schedule a video or phone call. Your therapist is here to help you thr
bluejetty:00131955:ios.description:
Teen Counseling lets you connect with a licensed therapist who specializes in helping teens like you. Whenever you need and wherever you are, just text your therapist or schedule a video or phone call. Your therapist is here to help you thrive!
HOW DO I START?
Invite your parent(s) to sign up. They fill out a consent form for you (required by law)
Once your parent subscribes, you will be matched with a licensed therapist and invited to your own therapy room
Your therapist will communicate with you on the Teen Counseling app using text, phone, and video
WHY DO I NEED PARENTAL CONSENT?
As required by law, a parent or legal guardian must fill out a consent form before you can receive online therapy services.
HOW DOES THERAPY WORK?
You and your therapist will get your own “room.”This will be your place to communicate with your therapist day or night. You can access this room from any internet connected device, wherever you are.
You can write about yourself, the things going on in your life, ask questions and discuss the challenges you’re facing. Your therapist will login to the same room and respond with feedback, insights and guidance.
Together you’ll work towards making a positive change in your life, accomplishing your goals and overcoming your troubles.
IS WHAT I SHARE WITH MY THERAPIST PRIVATE?
Your parent will not have access to this room. You can talk to your therapist about anything, but there are a few things that they would be required to share with either your parents or other adults. If you share any of the following issues with your therapist, they would have to break confidentiality for your protection or the protection of others:
• If you are seriously contemplating severely harming yourself or someone else.
• If you share with your therapist that you are being abused or neglected, or know of another individual under 18 who is being abused or neglected.
• If you share with your therapist that you know of an elderly person who is being abused or neglected.
Please consult with your therapist about what kind of information and updates your parent(s) may get regarding your work with your therapist.
WHO ARE THE THERAPISTS?
We require every Therapist providing services on the Platform to be an accredited, trained, and experienced licensed U.S. psychologist (PhD / PsyD), licensed marriage and family therapist (LMFT), licensed clinical social worker (LCSW), licensed professional counselor (LPC), or similar applicable recognized professional certification based on their state and/or jurisdiction. Therapists must have a relevant academic degree in their field, at least 3 years of experience and at least 1,000 hours of hands-on experience.

bluejetty:00096395:ios.description:
