bluejetty:00024184:ios.description:
Pregnancy Test Quiz is an app, which will help you to know whether you are pregnant, thanks to a series of questions based on different pregnancy symptoms.
In addition to a complete pregnancy calculator, you will find different sections with relevant information concerning signs of early pregnancy in the app. You will find a section with a variety of home pregnancy tests, in addition to a wide range of tips, information about the pregnancy stages, first signs of pregnancy, teenage pregnancy, etc.
Important! To ensure that you are pregnant you should see a doctor or use a pregnancy test calculator from the pharmacy, since this app is merely informational based on different symptoms of pregnancy, but it doesn’t provide exact results.
How to use the app Pregnancy Test Quiz:
It is very easy to learn how to use this pregnancy test.
1.- Once you have downloaded and opened the app, you will find 3 different options in the main menu of the app. On the one hand, you will find an online pregnancy test and on the other hand, 2 sections about home pregnancy tests and also tips about pregnancy signs.
2.-Pregnancy quiz: This is the main tool of the app. Therein, you will have to answer a series of questions related to early pregnancy symptoms. At the end of the test we will show you a result based on the answers you have chosen. As we have already mentioned, this result is not fully reliable, this is why it is important to see a doctor to do a reliable pregnancy test.
3.-Home testing: In this section we have prepared lots of articles related to home pregnancy tests that were used in the past.
4.-Tips: Finally, we have prepared some articles with advice, tips and recommendations to make your pregnancy more bearable: which kind of food you should avoid during pregnancy, false pregnancies, when to take a pregnancy test, early symptoms of pregnancy, what to do when you are pregnant, etc.
Main characteristics of the app Pregnancy Test Quiz:
If you use this app, you will surely ask yourself: How do I know whether I am pregnant? 
- This app enables you to do a pregnancy test online, quickly and easily. It is important not to confuse it with the pregnancy calculator. In this case it is a test to know whether you are pregnant or not. Doing this test is an option to have a rough idea, but if you really want to know whether you are pregnant it is important to see your doctor or to go to the pharmacy to do a reliable test.
- You will find various tips related to pregnancy week by week and early signs of pregnancy, which will be very helpful.
Premium options:
- Advanced Pregnancy Test: Gain access to a more detailed and refined test.
- Fertility Test: Discover your potential fertility status based on key symptoms and patterns.
- Ad-Free Experience: Enjoy the app without interruptions or distractions.
We hope that you find this app helpful and that you liked it. In this case we would appreciate if you could give this app 5 stars. Please contact us if you can find any mistake or if you have any suggestions for improvement.
Information note: This tool should be used as informational assistance, but it should never be considered as a reliable result, since its effectiveness is not scientifically proven and the result is not precise.
Service Terms: https://reticode.com/terms/terms-of-service-pregnancy-test.html
Privacy Policy: https://reticode.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00120179:ios.description:
Hello Piano is the easiest way to learn playing keys like a pro. Your personal piano tutor for free. Download it now to find out how to comprehend theory and practice in the form of fancy games!
With Hello Piano app you can learn how to play piano well and study the theory without difficulties. Interactive learning process consists of daily challenges, which include educating games and theory lessons. The curriculum focuses on 4 main skills necessary for any piano player: rhythm, ear training, playing technique, and music sheets. By using the app for just 15 minutes a day you will get tangible results and enough skills to play the real piano.
Hello Piano is saying hello to personalized courses and video lessons! Now, you’ll be able to dive into authentic piano lessons that cater directly to you. Explore the ‘Beginners 15 Day Challenge’ and the ‘Music Fun Course,’ our first two courses complete with comprehensive video and audio guidance! Through this system, the app adapts the 'Today's Practice' module to meet your exact needs. Stay tuned because more lessons are coming soon!
***Hello Piano features***
Songbook - play to your favorite tracks, while you learn essential piano skills. It’s time to get back to the keys.
Games Mode - 4 types of games to master your piano skills
- Rhythm games for improving your sense and knowledge of rhythm: Bird Beat, Notes Value and Rhythm Time;
- Music Sheets games - Key Factor and Notes Names: match the notes to the keys and notations in the right way! 
- Playing Technique games - Play by Memory and Virtuoso: see the keys pushing and listen the notes, try to memorize and reproduce them in the right order! 
- Ear Training games - Melody Match and Note Pool: listen to the musicians playing musical instruments and try to reproduce their composition in an appropriate order. 
Theory Mode - contains all the necessary theory lessons for you to understand how to read music sheets, including notes names and length, key chart, beat types, measure, playing exercises and more.
My Stats Mode - track your learning progress with daily score stats and piano skills charts. Play hard and unlock dozens of fun achievements.
Today’s Practice mode - get your daily tasks for bringing your piano skills to the next level.
Video lessons - Comprehensive video guides to help you forge essential piano technique!
Set off on the most exciting and fun musical journey with Hello Piano! 
Privacy Policy: https://gismart.com/music-privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://gismart.com/terms-of-service

- The account is charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period.

- The cost of renewal is equal to the value that “Apple’s App Store Matrix” determines as the equivalent of the subscription price in $USD.

bluejetty:00131134:ios.description:
Unlock the power of multiple AI models in one sleek app. Apollo’s Multi-Model AI Chat Engine gives you instant access to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more — all in a single, easy-to-use platform. Switch between your favorite AI engines seamlessly and get smarter answers faster.
** Core Features **
• Access top AI models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and others.
• Use one app to test, compare, and combine multiple LLMs.
• Customizable prompts and settings tailored for pros and enthusiasts.
• Seamless chat experience with quick switching between AI engines.
• Perfect for developers, researchers, and AI power users.
** Example Uses **
• Product & marketing copy - websites, SEO, adverts, product descriptions, online listings & more.
• Creative Writing - Essays, blogs, articles, poetry, songs, resumes & anything else creative!
• Social Content Generation - Generate unique & engaging social posts in seconds
• Business Growth & Operations - Customer service, emails, quoting, invoices, sales pitches, contract preparation, etc
• General Q&A - Ask (literally) anything and get insight answers
• Daily Life - Accelerate tasks - emails, texts, workout routines, even recipes and meal plans!
• Grammar Analysis - Reviews & corrects grammatical errors in blocks of copy
• Text Summarization - Summarize large text, or simplify for a given audience
• Code Generation & Tools - Text-to-code, code explanation, bug fixing, language translation & more
• Data Preparation & Analysis - Spreadsheet creation, predictive analytics and regression curve fitting
• Language Translation - Translate English text into French, Spanish and Japanese.
• Anything else you could possible think of!
** Key Features **
• Get answers to any query – the only constraint is your imagination! 
• Asking for something creative? Generate multiple variations for each request
• Save your favourite responses for easy later access
• 24/7 customer support

bluejetty:00088231:ios.name: Vyncs: Connected Car OBD v2.0
bluejetty:00088231:ios.summary: Do you want to make driving a safer activity? Hundreds and thousands of people enjoy riding their vehicles. Simultaneously, many owners think only about security before turning the ignition key. Vyncs is what they need, and if you’re one of
bluejetty:00088231:ios.description:
Do you want to make driving a safer activity? Hundreds and thousands of people enjoy riding their vehicles. Simultaneously, many owners think only about security before turning the ignition key. Vyncs is what they need, and if you’re one of them, you’ll benefit from it too.
With it at your disposal, owning and driving an automobile will become profoundly safer, smarter, and pocket-friendly. Powered by a patented connected car technology from the house of Agnik, Vyncs is one of the most successful connected-car products on the market.
Simply plug the Vyncs Link cellular wireless gadget into the OBD-II port, download the app, create your account, and you’re in! Our clients enjoy a boatload of services, including vehicle maintenance, driver scoring, recall notifications, coaching teen drivers, roadside assistance, and, of course, GPS tracking.
By paying the purchase price and activation fee of the service package of your preference, you will receive one Vyncs device, one year’s worth of associated services, one SIM card, one year’s worth of data plan on AT&T, and the T-Mobile network in the USA. It doesn’t have anything to do with the data plan you have on your iOS device.
Just don’t make the mistake of thinking you need a phone inside the car at all times! The Vyncs device will work without one. Furthermore, the user-friendly interface provides access to the reports it generates, as well as the web portal.
Forget about monthly fee payments! Whether you opt for Vyncs Basic, Vyncs Premium, or Vyncs Pro, you will receive a SIM card that doesn’t require you to pay a fee per month. Only pay once a year and a one-time activation fee.
Here’s a breakdown of what our app can offer you.
Keep tabs on your cars and drivers.
Get automobile health reports.
Determine driver behavior.
Conduct thorough vehicle diagnoses.
Locate your cars, wherever they are.
It runs without a battery.
Ascertain actual idling value based on OBD data.
Unlike other OBD trackers, Vyncs can detect when the engine is on, but the vehicle is not moving.
Zone creation is not limited to circular shapes.
Pinpoint gas stations to receive more in terms of fuel savings.
You will even have thirty days to try everything we have in store for you.
Find more information at the following links.
Vyncs Home Page: https://vyncs.com
 Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/vyncs 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/myvyncs
 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/vyncs

bluejetty:00015268:ios.name: Google Arts & Culture
bluejetty:00015268:ios.summary: Are you curious about what Van Gogh’s Starry Night looks like up close? Have you ever toured the ancient Maya temples or met the inspirational figures of Black history? Do you want to learn about Japan’s unique food culture or incredible In
bluejetty:00015268:ios.description:
Are you curious about what Van Gogh’s Starry Night looks like up close? Have you ever toured the ancient Maya temples or met the inspirational figures of Black history? Do you want to learn about Japan’s unique food culture or incredible Indian railways?
Google Arts & Culture puts the treasures, stories and knowledge of over 2,000 cultural institutions from 80 countries at your fingertips. From the suffragettes who fought for women’s rights, to performing arts at the Paris Opera, to NASA’s archive of stunning images, discover stories about our cultural heritage. It’s your doorway to explore the art, history, people and wonders of our world.
Highlights:
• Art Transfer – Take a photo and transform it with classic artworks
• Art Selfie – Discover portraits that look like you
• Color Palette – Find art by using the colors of your photo
• Art Projector – See how artworks look in real size
• Pocket Gallery – Wander through immersive galleries and get up close to art
• Art Camera – Explore high-definition artworks
• 360° videos – Experience culture in 360 degrees
• Virtual reality tours – Step inside world-class museums
• Street View – Tour famous sites and landmarks
• Explore by time and color – Travel through time and see the rainbow through art
• Art Recogniser – Point your device camera at artworks to learn more about them, even when offline (at select museums only)
More features:
• Exhibits – Take guided tours curated by experts
• Favorites – Save and group your favorite artworks into galleries to share with friends or students
• Nearby – Find museums and exhibitions near you
• Notifications – Subscribe to receive weekly highlights or favorite content updates
• Translate – Use the translate button to read about exhibits from around the world in your language
Permissions notice:
• Location: used to recommend cultural sites and events based on your current location
• Camera: used to recognize artworks and provide related information about them

bluejetty:00150602:ios.description:
Manage joint, muscle, and back pain with guided exercises, education, progress tracking, and clinician support.
More than 200,000 patients have used the Joint Academy app and 99% say they are satisfied.
Joint Academy helps you follow an evidence-based physical therapy program from home, between visits, or as part of care through a participating clinic, health plan, employer, or Joint Academy program.
The app is designed to support people with pain or reduced function in areas such as the back, neck, shoulder, hip, knee, hand, joints, or muscles.
With Joint Academy, you get:
– Video-guided exercise programs
– Chat and video calls with a clinician
– Interactive education and reminders
– Tools to track pain, goals, and progress
Joint Academy is built on evidence-based physical therapy principles, including exercise, education, and ongoing support. These approaches are commonly recommended for many musculoskeletal conditions, including osteoarthritis and persistent joint or back pain.
Depending on your program, Joint Academy may be used as a digital-first care experience, alongside in-person clinic care, or as continued support after treatment.
How it works:
1. Download the app
2. Sign up within minutes
3. Start your program
4. Follow your exercises
5. Track goals and progress
Access, services, and costs may vary depending on your health plan, employer, clinic, location, or care program.
Joint Academy is not intended for emergencies. Always seek urgent medical care if you experience severe, sudden, or worsening symptoms.

bluejetty:00041016:ios.description:
papergames.io is an interactive platform that lets you enjoy classic board games online, including Chess, Tic Tac Toe, Battleship, Connect 4, and Gomoku.
You can dive into a quick game as a guest or sign up to unlock the full experience and track your progress as you rise to the top!
Easily challenge a friend by sharing a simple game link, inviting them to a thrilling match with just one click.
Chat and friend system: Use the chat system to communicate with your friends directly during gameplay or invite them using game links. Build your network, challenge others to duels, and strengthen friendships while gaming together.
Leaderboard: Compete globally to climb daily leaderboards by scoring points in each game. Refine your strategies through "replays" and "live games" of other top players, and strive to improve your rank.
Private tournament: Create a private tournament that invites your friends into a lively competition. By customizing tournament parameters and sharing the invite link, you set the stage for an exclusive challenge.
Chess: Play Chess with friends or random opponents online. Hone your skills with advanced strategies and popular openings like Ruy Lopez and Queen’s Gambit, aiming to conquer the board and checkmate your opponent.
Checkers: A strategic board game where players move pieces diagonally across an 8x8 board, capturing opponents' pieces by jumping over them, to eliminate all enemy pieces or block their valid moves.
Tic Tac Toe: This classic game requires aligning three identical symbols to win. Challenge friends to private matches or join public tournaments. Enhance your chances of winning with tactics like corner positioning and defensive play.
Connect 4: A strategic game where players aim to connect four discs of the same color vertically, horizontally, or diagonally. This challenging game adds strategic complexity to familiar mechanics, and you can play in private matches or tournaments .
Battleship: In this naval warfare game, sink your opponent's fleet using grid targeting strategies and powerful weapons like nuclear strikes.
Gomoku: Similar to Tic Tac Toe, this game involves aligning five pieces instead of three on a larger 15x15 board. It requires a higher level of strategy due to the increased grid size, providing a stimulating challenge.
Shop: When you play, you can earn coins by playing games, which you can then use in the in-game shop to purchase unique avatars, expressive emojis, and boosters to enhance your gaming experience. These boosters are especially useful if you're looking to climb the public leaderboard more quickly, by multiplying the points you earn from games. The shop offers a fun way for you to customize interactions and increase your competitive edge on the platform.

Connect 4: A strategic game where players aim to connect four discs of the same color vertically, horizontally, or diagonally. This challenging game adds strategic complexity to familiar mechanics, and you can play in private matches or tournaments​ .

Battleship: In this naval warfare game, sink your opponent's fleet using grid targeting strategies and powerful weapons like nuclear strikes​.

Gomoku: Similar to Tic Tac Toe, this game involves aligning five pieces instead of three on a larger 15x15 board. It requires a higher level of strategy due to the increased grid size, providing a stimulating challenge​.

Shop: When you play, you can earn coins by playing games, which you can then use in the in-game shop to purchase unique avatars, expressive emojis, and boosters to enhance your gaming experience. The shop offers a fun way for you to customize interactions and increase your competitive edge on the platform.

apple-macos:6818062172.name: S3Deck
apple-macos:6818062172.description:
S3Deck puts AWS S3 and every S3-compatible storage on your iPhone — Cloudflare R2, MinIO, Backblaze B2, DigitalOcean Spaces, Wasabi, Ceph and any custom endpoint. Check a bucket, grab a file, share a link or fix a bucket setting without opening a web console.
BROWSE AND PREVIEW
• Folders and files laid out for the phone: tap to open, long-press to select several, ⋯ for every action.
• Preview photos, PDFs, video, audio and text right in the app.
• Filter a folder instantly, or search a whole bucket.
UPLOAD AND DOWNLOAD
• Upload from the Files app, iCloud Drive or any file provider.
• Downloads land in S3Deck's own folder, which you also find in the Files app under On My iPhone.
• A live transfer queue with retry and cancel; large files go up in parts.
MANAGE OBJECTS
• Create folders, rename, copy, move and delete.
• Edit metadata and headers, tags, storage class and permissions; browse and restore versions.
SHARE IN A TAP
• Presigned links with an expiry, public/private toggles and copy-ready object URLs.
• Open downloaded files in other apps through the share sheet.
BUCKET SETTINGS
• Bucket policy editor with validation and ready-made snippets.
• CORS rules, lifecycle rules, versioning, ACLs and access logging.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• S3Deck connects directly from your iPhone to your storage endpoint. Your files and credentials never pass through any server of ours — there isn't one.
• Secret keys are kept in the iOS Keychain.
• Mark production connections read-only to block every delete and overwrite.
• No analytics, no tracking, no account.
Works with the same connections as S3Deck for Mac, Windows and Linux. Available in English and Vietnamese.

apple-macos:6760254021.name: Cully - Photo Cleaner
apple-macos:6760254021.description:
Tidy up your photo library. Day by day.
Over 20,000 photos and no idea where to start? Cully turns that into something you can actually do.
The idea is simple: choose a random date and browse your photos from that day, from all years at once. A different slice of your life, every session. Keep the best, delete the rest. Five minutes a day, and your library feels lighter.
HOW IT WORKS
• Cully suggests a day. You instantly see all photos from that day, across all years. Not in the mood? Roll again or pick a date in the calendar, where sorted days are marked.
• Scroll through your grid. Select photos and zoom in for a closer look.
• Every deletion needs your confirmation. Photos go to Recently Deleted and can be restored for 30 days.
FEATURES
• Privacy first: No account, no server, no tracking. Your photos never leave your device.
• Smart random: Prefers days you haven't sorted yet.
• Albums: Send a selection straight to an album instead of deleting it.
• Finish a day: You decide when a day is done. Sorted days show up in your stats and calendar.
• Live Photos & videos: Play them right in the grid.
• Share originals: Long-press or right-click any photo to share it in full quality.
• Your stats: See how many photos you've deleted and how much storage you've freed up.
• Gentle reminders: Optional notifications to help you stay on track.
• Widgets: Your deletion stats at a glance.
• iPhone, iPad and Mac: Native apps for every screen, stats and settings in sync via your own iCloud.
• Free to try: Your first five sorting days are free, meaning five dates whose photos you sort, with no time limit. After that, one purchase unlocks unlimited days on all your devices. No subscription.
• Quick actions: Jump straight to a random day, today's date or the last 7 or 30 days.
WHY CULLY?
In photography, "to cull" means going through your shots and keeping only the best. We built Cully because we had the same problem: a photo library that kept growing, with no good way to clean it up.
No account. No AI. No analytics. No subscription. Just open it and get started.
Made in Berlin.

apple-macos:1453201757.name: Shared Shopping List: Tjatjie
apple-macos:1453201757.description:
Tjatjie is the grocery list your whole household shares. Everyone adds items from their own iPhone, iPad or Mac, and everyone gets notified: when something is added, when someone starts shopping and when they are done. It syncs through your own iCloud, so there is no account to create and no login. No group chats, nothing forgotten.
Ever come home from the supermarket only to discover you forgot the one thing you actually needed? Or that your partner added it right after you left? Wonder where all your grocery money went at the end of the month? Stare into the fridge asking, "What are we going to eat tonight?"
Tjatjie solves these everyday frustrations in one simple app.
Keep one shared grocery list that is up to date on every iPhone, iPad and Mac in the family. Turn recipes into shopping lists in a single tap. Track what products actually cost and discover where your grocery budget is going. Tjatjie helps you shop smarter, waste less, and save money without extra effort.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE TJATJIE
One Shared List for the Whole Household
No more forgotten items, paper notes, or endless family group chats. Everyone in the household adds products to the same list from their own phone, and it is up to date on every device the moment they do.
Everyone Knows the Moment Something Changes
Out of milk? Add it, and everyone at home gets a notification. When someone starts shopping, the rest of the family knows the groceries are being taken care of, and anything added while they are still in the store lands straight on their list. When they finish, everyone knows the shopping is done.
Know What Your Groceries Really Cost
Most people know what they spend at the checkout but not where the money goes. Tjatjie tracks prices per item and turns them into clear monthly and yearly insights. Discover spending patterns and identify opportunities to save.
Turn Recipes Into Shopping Lists
Found a recipe you want to make? Tjatjie instantly converts ingredients into a shopping list. Already have ingredients on your list? Tjatjie helps you find recipes that use them.
Stop Asking "What's for Dinner?"
Save your favorite recipes and keep meal inspiration close at hand. Planning meals becomes easier, faster, and less stressful.
Keep Bonus Cards Handy
Store photos of your supermarket loyalty and bonus cards so they're always available when you need them. No more searching through your wallet at the checkout.
Remember the Right Product
Add photos to grocery items to make them easier to find in the store or show to store employees when you're looking for a specific product.
Built for Families
Whether you're shopping for yourself, your partner, or an entire household, Tjatjie keeps everyone on the same page.
ON IPHONE, IPAD AND MAC
Add something on your iPhone in the kitchen, check the list on the iPad, plan the week on your Mac. Tjatjie is one app for all three, and the list is the same everywhere the moment it changes. Your household members use whichever device they have at hand.
FROM RECIPE TO RECEIPT
Plan meals, create shopping lists, track spending, and gain insight into your grocery budget—all in one place.
Download Tjatjie and start shopping smarter today.
Your opinion is greatly appreciated. Do you have any problems or suggestions? Feel free to contact us.
Tjatjie's grocery list requires a paid auto-renewable subscription (Tjatjie Pro) to use the app's features. You can choose a weekly, monthly, or yearly plan after installing.
